# Seamless Pattern / Surface Pattern Designer – Golf Apparel



**Company:** Kaipar Clothing  

**Website:** 
  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines

**Compensation:** Based on Experience

## About Kaipar Clothing



Kaipar Clothing is a golf apparel brand specializing in premium performance clothing inspired by the spirit of aloha. Our designs combine Hawaiian-inspired artwork, tropical patterns, vibrant colors, and modern styling with comfortable, high-performance golf apparel.



Our goal is to create unique, stylish golf clothing that stands out both on and off the course. We are looking to expand our creative team with talented designers who can help us develop original artwork and patterns for future apparel collections.



We encourage applicants to visit our website at 
 to familiarize themselves with our products, design style, and brand identity.



## About the Position



We are looking for a talented and creative **Seamless Pattern Designer / Surface Pattern Designer / Textile Print Designer** with strong illustration skills and experience creating original repeating patterns for clothing and commercial printing.



The ideal candidate has a strong artistic background and can create unique illustrations, seamless repeating patterns, textile prints, and surface designs using Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, or Procreate.



This position requires more than general graphic design skills. We are specifically looking for someone who understands how to develop original artwork and transform it into beautiful, professional seamless patterns suitable for printing on golf polos and other apparel.



Our designs often incorporate tropical, Hawaiian-inspired, botanical, floral, geometric, abstract, and lifestyle themes. We are interested in working with someone who can develop artwork in a variety of styles, from sophisticated and subtle to bold, colorful, and detailed.



## Responsibilities



You will be responsible for creating original seamless repeating patterns and surface pattern designs for our apparel collections. This includes developing unique digital illustrations, hand-drawn artwork, tropical graphics, and repeating textile prints based on creative concepts, reference images, mood boards, and design direction.



You should be comfortable developing patterns from scratch, creating original artistic elements, and arranging them into perfectly seamless repeats without visible breaks or inconsistencies.



The role also involves developing coordinated pattern collections, experimenting with different color combinations, creating multiple colorways, and refining existing artwork to improve its visual appeal.



You will be expected to prepare high-resolution, print-ready artwork suitable for commercial fabric printing, including properly organized and editable source files.



You will also collaborate with our team to make design revisions, explore new creative directions, and help develop fresh patterns for upcoming clothing collections.



## Required Skills and Experience



Applicants should have proven experience in **Seamless Pattern Design, Surface Pattern Design, Repeat Pattern Design, Textile Print Design, or Apparel Print Design**.



Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop is highly preferred. Experience with Procreate, vector illustration, and digital drawing is also valuable.



We are looking for someone with excellent illustration skills who can create original designs rather than simply relying on stock images, premade graphics, or existing templates.



You should have a strong understanding of pattern repetition, composition, color theory

title: Amazon FBA Brand-Direct Sourcing VA
description:
AEX Direct is a new U.S.-based Amazon FBA wholesale business focused on establishing direct relationships with brands and manufacturers.



We're currently building our operation from the ground up and have capital available for inventory and growth. We're looking for an experienced Brand Direct Sourcing VA who can consistently identify profitable brands, research wholesale opportunities, and help establish supplier relationships.



Responsibilities



Find and research brands and manufacturers open to wholesale partnerships.



Identify profitable products using Keepa, SmartScout, AZInsight, and Seller Central.



Analyze sales velocity, Buy Box competition, pricing history, seller counts, and profit margins.



Find brand decision-makers and manage
 outreach and follow-ups.



Request wholesale catalogs, price lists, and account requirements.



Analyze wholesale price lists for profitable ASINs.



Calculate ROI, Amazon fees, landed costs, and potential profit margins.



Maintain organized records of brands, contacts, and sourcing opportunities.



Use Claude, ChatGPT, and AI tools to improve sourcing and outreach efficiency.



Provide regular updates on qualified leads, supplier responses, and potential deals.



Requirements



At least 1 year of Amazon FBA wholesale sourcing experience, preferably brand direct.



Strong knowledge of Keepa, SmartScout, and AZInsight.



Experience with brand outreach and wholesale supplier research.



Understanding of Amazon fees, ROI, margins, and Buy Box competition.



Strong written English and professional communication skills.



Proficiency with Google Sheets or Excel.



Ability to work independently and consistently find quality opportunities.



What We're Looking For



We need someone who understands how to find brands with profitable, replenishable products and establish legitimate wholesale relationships.



We care about quality over quantity. The goal is to find brands we can build long-term relationships with, not generate lists of random leads.



This is a long-term opportunity with room to grow as the company expands.



How to Apply



Please include:



Your Amazon wholesale and brand-direct sourcing experience.



Your experience with Keepa, SmartScout, and AZInsight.



Examples of successful brand outreach or wholesale accounts you've helped establish.



Your expected monthly salary and availability.



Note: We're looking specifically for brand-direct wholesale experience, not retail arbitrage, online arbitrage, or private label sourcing.

Job Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled video editor who can help create engaging, high-quality YouTube videos for a personal finance brand.



Social Links & Brand Bios

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/calltoleap

Great attention to detail (we expect high-quality work the first time)

Video Editor: HIRE ME - [Your First Name, Last Name]

Your full name

Upload your edited sample to Google Drive, YouTube (unlisted), or Dropbox, and include the link in your email.

Only applicants who follow ALL steps will be considered.

We’re a fast-growing brand that helps people build financial freedom. Our videos educate, inspire, and engage—and we need a talented editor to help us make them even better.



If you love editing, care about quality, and want to grow with a team, this job is for you!



Important Note

WE ONLY RESPOND TO APPLICANTS WHO EMAIL US!

title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & MARKETING SPECIALIST – HEALTHCARE
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & MARKETING SPECIALIST – HEALTHCARE



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Business Hours



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month



ABOUT RAVORA HEALTH



Ravora Health is a growing U.S.-based outpatient mental health practice providing psychiatric evaluation, medication management, ADHD treatment, and care for conditions such as anxiety and depression.



We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Business Development & Marketing Specialist to help us grow our patient base, develop relationships with healthcare referral partners, and execute marketing and growth projects.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys research, outreach, relationship building, marketing, and solving problems.



You will work directly with Ravora Health leadership and will be given meaningful projects to own.



We are looking for someone who can take an objective, figure out what needs to be done, organize the project, execute it, follow up, and report the results.



WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON



1. HEALTHCARE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT



A major responsibility will be helping Ravora Health build relationships with healthcare organizations that may refer patients to us.



Potential referral partners include:



* Primary care offices

* Therapy and counseling practices

* Psychologists

* Healthcare clinics

* Community organizations

* Colleges and universities

* Other healthcare professionals



Your responsibilities may include:



* Researching potential referral partners

* Finding the appropriate decision-makers and contacts

* Collecting accurate phone numbers and
 addresses

* Researching services and accepted insurance plans

* Calling and
ing healthcare offices

* Introducing Ravora Health and our services

* Explaining our accepted insurance plans and referral process

* Learning how potential partners currently handle psychiatry referrals

* Scheduling meetings when appropriate

* Following up with contacts

* Maintaining long-term relationships



This is relationship-focused business development, not high-volume call-center telemarketing.



2. LEAD GENERATION & RESEARCH



You will help identify new opportunities for Ravora Health.



This may include:



* Building targeted prospect lists

* Researching healthcare organizations

* Identifying decision-makers

* Researching competitors

* Finding community organizations

* Researching local businesses and employers

* Finding potential referral sources

* Identifying marketing opportunities

* Researching new patient-acquisition channels



We want someone who is very comfortable researching online and turning information into an organized action plan.



3. REFERRAL & CONTACT DATABASE MANAGEMENT



You will help create and maintain an organized database or CRM containing information such as:



* Organization name

* Contact person

* Phone

*

* Location

* Providers

* Accepted insurance

* Services offered

* Previous communication

* Relationship status

* Last contact

* Follow-up date

* Referrals generated



You will help make sure opportunities do not get forgotten and relationships are followed up consistently.



4. DIGITAL MARKETING & PATIENT ACQUISITION



You will also assist with marketing projects designed to bring new patients to Ravora Health.



Projects may involve:



* Google Ads

* Google Business Profile

* Local SEO

* Psychology Today

* Zocdoc

* Insurance directories

* Website landing pages

*
 campaigns

* Review-generation strategies

* Provider launches

* Referral campaigns

* Social media campaigns

* Patient acquisition tracking



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



However, you should understand digital marketing and be comfortable learning new platforms.



Google Ads experience is strongly preferred but not required.



5. NETWORKING & COMMUNITY OUTREACH



Help us identify and coordinate opportunities for Ravora Health to build relationships in the community.



Examples may include:



* Healthcare networking events

* Therapist networking events

* Mental health events

* Health fairs

* Chamber of Commerce events

* Local business networking events

* College events

* Community events

* Ravora-hosted networking events



Responsibilities may include:



* Finding opportunities

* Contacting event organizers

* Gathering pricing and participation information

* Coordinating registration

* Maintaining an event calendar

* Helping prepare marketing materials

* Tracking contacts made

* Following up after events



6. MARKETING PROJECTS



You will regularly receive projects directly from Ravora Health leadership.



Examples:



"Find therapy practices in our target area that could become referral partners."



"Research PCP offices that accept the same insurance plans we accept."



"Create a system for tracking our referral relationships."



"Find networking events Ravora should attend over the next three months."



"Help us launch and market a new provider."



"Research why a particular marketing channel isn't generating enough patients."



"Find new ways we can acquire patients locally."



We are looking for someone who does not need every project broken down into individual instructions.



You should be comfortable researching, asking good questions, creating a plan, and taking ownership of execution.



AI & TECHNOLOGY



We strongly encourage the use of AI and modern technology.



Experience with tools such as the following is valuable:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* Perplexity

* Canva

* CRM systems

* Google Workspace

* Project-management tools

* Automation tools



We want someone who looks for ways to use technology to make research, outreach, organization, and marketing more efficient.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you have experience in areas such as:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Marketing

* Healthcare

* Client relations

* Account management

* Partnership development

* Outreach

* Digital marketing

* Google Ads

* CRM management

* Project coordination

* Sales development



Experience working with a U.S. healthcare company is a strong advantage but is not required.



IMPORTANT QUALIFICATIONS



You should have:



* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Confidence speaking professionally on the phone

* Strong research skills

* Strong organizational skills

* Good follow-up habits

* Professional communication skills

* Ability to work independently

* Attention to detail

* Comfort with outbound outreach

* Ability to learn new tools quickly

* Ability to manage several projects

* Good judgment and problem-solving skills



You must be comfortable communicating with U.S. healthcare offices during U.S. business hours.



WHAT WE VALUE MOST



We are not searching for someone who already knows everything.



We are searching for someone who is:



* Resourceful

* Reliable

* Organized

* Curious

* Comfortable taking initiative

* Strong at communication

* Willing to learn

* Comfortable using AI

* Able to take ownership of assignments



If we give you a goal, we want you to be able to research it, create a plan, execute it, follow up, and show us what happened.



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



This is a full-time remote position.



Hours: 40 hours per week



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month depending on experience and skill level.



Because a significant part of this position involves communicating with U.S. healthcare offices, you must be available during a meaningful portion of U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



This is intended to be a long-term role.



Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed after the first 90 days based on performance, reliability, project ownership, and overall contribution.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words:



RAVORA GROWTH



Then include the following:



1. INTRODUCTION



Tell us briefly about your background and why this position interests you.



2. RESUME



Please include your current resume or CV.



3. VOICE RECORDING



Please provide a short 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself.



A major part of this role involves professional communication with U.S. healthcare offices, so spoken English is important.



4. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



Tell us about any experience you have with:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Healthcare

* Marketing

* Client outreach

* Google Ads

* CRM systems

* Project coordination



5. PROJECT OWNERSHIP



Tell us about one project where you were given a goal but not detailed step-by-step instructions.



What was the goal?



What did you do?



What was the result?



6. SHORT CASE STUDY



Imagine Ravora Health asks you:



"We want to build relationships with local therapy practices and primary care offices that could refer psychiatric patients to us."



Briefly explain how you would begin this project.



We are especially interested in how you would:



* Find potential partners

* D
 which organizations to prioritize

* Contact them

* Track your outreach

* Follow up

* Measure results



7. AI TOOLS



Tell us which AI tools you currently use and give us one example of how you have used AI to complete work more efficiently.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Ravora Health and become an important member of our business development and marketing team.

title: Business Development & Marketing Specialist – Healthcare
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & MARKETING SPECIALIST – HEALTHCARE



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Business Hours



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month



ABOUT RAVORA HEALTH



Ravora Health is a growing U.S.-based outpatient mental health practice providing psychiatric evaluation, medication management, ADHD treatment, and care for conditions such as anxiety and depression.



We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Business Development & Marketing Specialist to help us grow our patient base, develop relationships with healthcare referral partners, and execute marketing and growth projects.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys research, outreach, relationship building, marketing, and solving problems.



You will work directly with Ravora Health leadership and will be given meaningful projects to own.



We are looking for someone who can take an objective, figure out what needs to be done, organize the project, execute it, follow up, and report the results.



WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON



1. HEALTHCARE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT



A major responsibility will be helping Ravora Health build relationships with healthcare organizations that may refer patients to us.



Potential referral partners include:



* Primary care offices

* Therapy and counseling practices

* Psychologists

* Healthcare clinics

* Community organizations

* Colleges and universities

* Other healthcare professionals



Your responsibilities may include:



* Researching potential referral partners

* Finding the appropriate decision-makers and contacts

* Collecting accurate phone numbers and
 addresses

* Researching services and accepted insurance plans

* Calling and
ing healthcare offices

* Introducing Ravora Health and our services

* Explaining our accepted insurance plans and referral process

* Learning how potential partners currently handle psychiatry referrals

* Scheduling meetings when appropriate

* Following up with contacts

* Maintaining long-term relationships



This is relationship-focused business development, not high-volume call-center telemarketing.



2. LEAD GENERATION & RESEARCH



You will help identify new opportunities for Ravora Health.



This may include:



* Building targeted prospect lists

* Researching healthcare organizations

* Identifying decision-makers

* Researching competitors

* Finding community organizations

* Researching local businesses and employers

* Finding potential referral sources

* Identifying marketing opportunities

* Researching new patient-acquisition channels



We want someone who is very comfortable researching online and turning information into an organized action plan.



3. REFERRAL & CONTACT DATABASE MANAGEMENT



You will help create and maintain an organized database or CRM containing information such as:



* Organization name

* Contact person

* Phone

*

* Location

* Providers

* Accepted insurance

* Services offered

* Previous communication

* Relationship status

* Last contact

* Follow-up date

* Referrals generated



You will help make sure opportunities do not get forgotten and relationships are followed up consistently.



4. DIGITAL MARKETING & PATIENT ACQUISITION



You will also assist with marketing projects designed to bring new patients to Ravora Health.



Projects may involve:



* Google Ads

* Google Business Profile

* Local SEO

* Psychology Today

* Zocdoc

* Insurance directories

* Website landing pages

*
 campaigns

* Review-generation strategies

* Provider launches

* Referral campaigns

* Social media campaigns

* Patient acquisition tracking



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



However, you should understand digital marketing and be comfortable learning new platforms.



Google Ads experience is strongly preferred but not required.



5. NETWORKING & COMMUNITY OUTREACH



Help us identify and coordinate opportunities for Ravora Health to build relationships in the community.



Examples may include:



* Healthcare networking events

* Therapist networking events

* Mental health events

* Health fairs

* Chamber of Commerce events

* Local business networking events

* College events

* Community events

* Ravora-hosted networking events



Responsibilities may include:



* Finding opportunities

* Contacting event organizers

* Gathering pricing and participation information

* Coordinating registration

* Maintaining an event calendar

* Helping prepare marketing materials

* Tracking contacts made

* Following up after events



6. MARKETING PROJECTS



You will regularly receive projects directly from Ravora Health leadership.



Examples:



"Find therapy practices in our target area that could become referral partners."



"Research PCP offices that accept the same insurance plans we accept."



"Create a system for tracking our referral relationships."



"Find networking events Ravora should attend over the next three months."



"Help us launch and market a new provider."



"Research why a particular marketing channel isn't generating enough patients."



"Find new ways we can acquire patients locally."



We are looking for someone who does not need every project broken down into individual instructions.



You should be comfortable researching, asking good questions, creating a plan, and taking ownership of execution.



AI & TECHNOLOGY



We strongly encourage the use of AI and modern technology.



Experience with tools such as the following is valuable:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* Perplexity

* Canva

* CRM systems

* Google Workspace

* Project-management tools

* Automation tools



We want someone who looks for ways to use technology to make research, outreach, organization, and marketing more efficient.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you have experience in areas such as:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Marketing

* Healthcare

* Client relations

* Account management

* Partnership development

* Outreach

* Digital marketing

* Google Ads

* CRM management

* Project coordination

* Sales development



Experience working with a U.S. healthcare company is a strong advantage but is not required.



IMPORTANT QUALIFICATIONS



You should have:



* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Confidence speaking professionally on the phone

* Strong research skills

* Strong organizational skills

* Good follow-up habits

* Professional communication skills

* Ability to work independently

* Attention to detail

* Comfort with outbound outreach

* Ability to learn new tools quickly

* Ability to manage several projects

* Good judgment and problem-solving skills



You must be comfortable communicating with U.S. healthcare offices during U.S. business hours.



WHAT WE VALUE MOST



We are not searching for someone who already knows everything.



We are searching for someone who is:



* Resourceful

* Reliable

* Organized

* Curious

* Comfortable taking initiative

* Strong at communication

* Willing to learn

* Comfortable using AI

* Able to take ownership of assignments



If we give you a goal, we want you to be able to research it, create a plan, execute it, follow up, and show us what happened.



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



This is a full-time remote position.



Hours: 40 hours per week



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month depending on experience and skill level.



Because a significant part of this position involves communicating with U.S. healthcare offices, you must be available during a meaningful portion of U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



This is intended to be a long-term role.



Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed after the first 90 days based on performance, reliability, project ownership, and overall contribution.

description:
BENEFITS

• Paid 13th Month Bonus

• Paid Time Off

Philippines-based, independent contractor, full-time (40 hrs/week; hours may flex), $6-$8 USD/hr depending on experience. Mon–Fri with overlap 7am–7pm EST. TimeProof time tracking required.



About Murray Marketing Services



Murray Marketing Services is a growing U.S.-based digital marketing agency founded in 2021. We work primarily with service-based businesses throughout the United States and provide services including Google Ads, Meta Ads, website design, landing pages, SEO,
 marketing, CRM/automation, and conversion tracking.



We have a small remote team and are looking for a full-time GoHighLevel & Conversion Tracking Specialist based in the Philippines. You will support our Digital Marketing Support Specialist and take specialized technical work off his plate. This is not a replacement for that role — you will work alongside our Digital Marketing Support Specialist and own the deeper GoHighLevel, conversion tracking, integration, and reporting work.



This is a hands-on technical role. When a client is set up, you make sure everything behind the scenes is built, connected, tested, and tracking correctly. When something breaks, you find it and fix it. You will also write a setup doc for each client.



You will receive training, Loom tutorials, and SOPs for many of our processes, but we are looking for someone who already has strong GoHighLevel and conversion-tracking experience and can begin contributing quickly.



Core Responsibilities

These are the priorities for this role, in order.



1. Expert GoHighLevel Work (Priority #1)



Build and configure GoHighLevel subaccounts, snapshots, forms, calendars, pipelines, workflows, and booking setups

Handle GHL break-fix and CRM work when something stops working



Provide ongoing GoHighLevel support for our client Storage Caves, including builds, troubleshooting, and day-to-day GHL maintenance



2. Advanced Conversion Tracking (Priority #2)



Set up and maintain Meta Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, and GA4



Build and troubleshoot WhatConverts, offline conversions, and custom conversions



Set up and maintain Google Merchant Center tracking and related conversion setups



Test tracking after every setup or change, and fix broken, missing, or duplicate conversions



3. Zapier Integrations



Build, maintain, and troubleshoot Zapier integrations between GoHighLevel, tracking tools, and other client or internal platforms



4. AgencyAnalytics Dashboards & Report Builds



Build and maintain AgencyAnalytics dashboards and reports



Make sure dashboards are connected correctly and displaying accurate data



5. Claude and AI Tools



Use Claude and other AI tools to troubleshoot, document, and work more efficiently



Follow our processes for using AI tools carefully around live client accounts



6. End-to-End Testing, QA & Client Setup Documentation



Test every relevant form, workflow, integration, and conversion end to end before calling the work done



Write and maintain a clear technical setup doc for each client



Backup Duties (Not Core)

These are not the focus of the role, but you may be asked to help with them as backup support:



-
 and SMS automation

- Ad disapprovals and billing issues

- Simple tracking setup

- Lead form mapping

- A2P registration backup



What This Position Is NOT

You will not be responsible for:



- Ad strategy or optimization

- Media buying

- Client relationships or client calls

- Adding clients to ad accounts

- Website go-live, DNS/domain go-live work, or building websites from scratch

- Graphic design or video



We have specialists responsible for those areas. Your job is to support Bryan and the rest of the team by owning GoHighLevel, advanced tracking, integrations, reporting dashboards, testing, and documentation.



Requirements



- 2+ years of hands-on technical marketing experience at an agency or across multiple client accounts

- Expert-level GoHighLevel experience (builds, workflows, calendars, forms, snapshots, CRM, and break-fix)

- Practical experience with Meta Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advanced conversion tracking

- Experience with WhatConverts, Zapier, and AgencyAnalytics (or very similar tools, with a clear ability to ramp quickly)

- Comfortable using Claude and other AI tools to troubleshoot and work efficiently

- Strong written English and high attention to detail — you test your work before calling it done

- Able to manage tasks across many client accounts; reliable internet and computer

- A "figure it out" mindset, but no risky changes to live accounts without asking

- TimeProof time tracking is required



Valuable tools



GoHighLevel, Meta CAPI, GTM, GA4, WhatConverts, Zapier, AgencyAnalytics, Google Merchant Center, Claude, CallRail, Microsoft Clarity, Google Search Console, Make, Asana.



Hours & Compensation



• Rate: $6-$8 USD/hour, depending on experience

• Hours: Steady state is about 25+ hours per week. Hours may flex based on client work and launch volume.

• This is an independent contractor position.

• There is potential for additional hours, increased responsibility, and compensation increases as you grow in the position and as Murray Marketing Services continues to grow.

• The schedule is flexible, although we require regular availability Monday through Friday and some working-hour overlap with our U.S.-based team. Typically sometime between 7 am and 7 pm EST.

• TimeProof time tracking is required.



How to Apply



Please send:



- Your resume

- A short Loom introduction about yourself, why you're interested in this role specifically, and your GoHighLevel and tracking experience (REQUIRED)

- Examples / portfolio of relevant work (GHL builds, tracking setups, Zapier integrations, dashboards, or documentation)

- The word "MURRAY" at the top of your application so we know you read this.



And please answer the following questions (either written or via Loom):



1. Tell us about a GoHighLevel break-fix you solved. What was broken, how did you find the cause, and how did you fix it?



2. Which of the following have you personally used? Rate yourself from 1–5 for each: GoHighLevel (builds, workflows, CRM, break-fix), Meta Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, GA4, WhatConverts, Zapier, AgencyAnalytics, Google Merchant Center, Claude or other AI tools.



3. Describe a Meta Conversions API and/or Google Tag Manager setup you have built. What conversions were you tracking, and how did you test that they were firing correctly?



4. Have you used WhatConverts, Zapier, and AgencyAnalytics? For each one you've used, tell us what you set up or built.



5. How many hours per week are you currently working for other employers or clients? If hired, what hours would you be available for Murray Marketing Services?



6. Are you comfortable using TimeProof time tracking?

title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & MARKETING SPECIALIST – HEALTHCARE
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & MARKETING SPECIALIST – HEALTHCARE



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Business Hours



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month



ABOUT RAVORA HEALTH



Ravora Health is a growing U.S.-based outpatient mental health practice providing psychiatric evaluation, medication management, ADHD treatment, and care for conditions such as anxiety and depression.



We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Business Development & Marketing Specialist to help us grow our patient base, develop relationships with healthcare referral partners, and execute marketing and growth projects.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys research, outreach, relationship building, marketing, and solving problems.



You will work directly with Ravora Health leadership and will be given meaningful projects to own.



We are looking for someone who can take an objective, figure out what needs to be done, organize the project, execute it, follow up, and report the results.



WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON



1. HEALTHCARE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT



A major responsibility will be helping Ravora Health build relationships with healthcare organizations that may refer patients to us.



Potential referral partners include:



* Primary care offices

* Therapy and counseling practices

* Psychologists

* Healthcare clinics

* Community organizations

* Colleges and universities

* Other healthcare professionals



Your responsibilities may include:



* Researching potential referral partners

* Finding the appropriate decision-makers and contacts

* Collecting accurate phone numbers and
 addresses

* Researching services and accepted insurance plans

* Calling and
ing healthcare offices

* Introducing Ravora Health and our services

* Explaining our accepted insurance plans and referral process

* Learning how potential partners currently handle psychiatry referrals

* Scheduling meetings when appropriate

* Following up with contacts

* Maintaining long-term relationships



This is relationship-focused business development, not high-volume call-center telemarketing.



2. LEAD GENERATION & RESEARCH



You will help identify new opportunities for Ravora Health.



This may include:



* Building targeted prospect lists

* Researching healthcare organizations

* Identifying decision-makers

* Researching competitors

* Finding community organizations

* Researching local businesses and employers

* Finding potential referral sources

* Identifying marketing opportunities

* Researching new patient-acquisition channels



We want someone who is very comfortable researching online and turning information into an organized action plan.



3. REFERRAL & CONTACT DATABASE MANAGEMENT



You will help create and maintain an organized database or CRM containing information such as:



* Organization name

* Contact person

* Phone

*

* Location

* Providers

* Accepted insurance

* Services offered

* Previous communication

* Relationship status

* Last contact

* Follow-up date

* Referrals generated



You will help make sure opportunities do not get forgotten and relationships are followed up consistently.



4. DIGITAL MARKETING & PATIENT ACQUISITION



You will also assist with marketing projects designed to bring new patients to Ravora Health.



Projects may involve:



* Google Ads

* Google Business Profile

* Local SEO

* Psychology Today

* Zocdoc

* Insurance directories

* Website landing pages

*
 campaigns

* Review-generation strategies

* Provider launches

* Referral campaigns

* Social media campaigns

* Patient acquisition tracking



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



However, you should understand digital marketing and be comfortable learning new platforms.



Google Ads experience is strongly preferred but not required.



5. NETWORKING & COMMUNITY OUTREACH



Help us identify and coordinate opportunities for Ravora Health to build relationships in the community.



Examples may include:



* Healthcare networking events

* Therapist networking events

* Mental health events

* Health fairs

* Chamber of Commerce events

* Local business networking events

* College events

* Community events

* Ravora-hosted networking events



Responsibilities may include:



* Finding opportunities

* Contacting event organizers

* Gathering pricing and participation information

* Coordinating registration

* Maintaining an event calendar

* Helping prepare marketing materials

* Tracking contacts made

* Following up after events



6. MARKETING PROJECTS



You will regularly receive projects directly from Ravora Health leadership.



Examples:



"Find therapy practices in our target area that could become referral partners."



"Research PCP offices that accept the same insurance plans we accept."



"Create a system for tracking our referral relationships."



"Find networking events Ravora should attend over the next three months."



"Help us launch and market a new provider."



"Research why a particular marketing channel isn't generating enough patients."



"Find new ways we can acquire patients locally."



We are looking for someone who does not need every project broken down into individual instructions.



You should be comfortable researching, asking good questions, creating a plan, and taking ownership of execution.



AI & TECHNOLOGY



We strongly encourage the use of AI and modern technology.



Experience with tools such as the following is valuable:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* Perplexity

* Canva

* CRM systems

* Google Workspace

* Project-management tools

* Automation tools



We want someone who looks for ways to use technology to make research, outreach, organization, and marketing more efficient.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you have experience in areas such as:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Marketing

* Healthcare

* Client relations

* Account management

* Partnership development

* Outreach

* Digital marketing

* Google Ads

* CRM management

* Project coordination

* Sales development



Experience working with a U.S. healthcare company is a strong advantage but is not required.



IMPORTANT QUALIFICATIONS



You should have:



* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Confidence speaking professionally on the phone

* Strong research skills

* Strong organizational skills

* Good follow-up habits

* Professional communication skills

* Ability to work independently

* Attention to detail

* Comfort with outbound outreach

* Ability to learn new tools quickly

* Ability to manage several projects

* Good judgment and problem-solving skills



You must be comfortable communicating with U.S. healthcare offices during U.S. business hours.



WHAT WE VALUE MOST



We are not searching for someone who already knows everything.



We are searching for someone who is:



* Resourceful

* Reliable

* Organized

* Curious

* Comfortable taking initiative

* Strong at communication

* Willing to learn

* Comfortable using AI

* Able to take ownership of assignments



If we give you a goal, we want you to be able to research it, create a plan, execute it, follow up, and show us what happened.



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



This is a full-time remote position.



Hours: 40 hours per week



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month depending on experience and skill level.



Because a significant part of this position involves communicating with U.S. healthcare offices, you must be available during a meaningful portion of U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



This is intended to be a long-term role.



Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed after the first 90 days based on performance, reliability, project ownership, and overall contribution.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words:



RAVORA GROWTH



Then include the following:



1. INTRODUCTION



Tell us briefly about your background and why this position interests you.



2. RESUME



Please include your current resume or CV.



3. VOICE RECORDING



Please provide a short 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself.



A major part of this role involves professional communication with U.S. healthcare offices, so spoken English is important.



4. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



Tell us about any experience you have with:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Healthcare

* Marketing

* Client outreach

* Google Ads

* CRM systems

* Project coordination



5. PROJECT OWNERSHIP



Tell us about one project where you were given a goal but not detailed step-by-step instructions.



What was the goal?



What did you do?



What was the result?



6. SHORT CASE STUDY



Imagine Ravora Health asks you:



"We want to build relationships with local therapy practices and primary care offices that could refer psychiatric patients to us."



Briefly explain how you would begin this project.



We are especially interested in how you would:



* Find potential partners

* D
 which organizations to prioritize

* Contact them

* Track your outreach

* Follow up

* Measure results



7. AI TOOLS



Tell us which AI tools you currently use and give us one example of how you have used AI to complete work more efficiently.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Ravora Health and become an important member of our business development and marketing team.

title: Customer Support Associate (Remote)
description:
This is a fully remote position and may require shifting schedules, weekend coverage, and overtime based on business needs.



Who We Are



At Neuro, we empower better minds with innovative, science-backed formulas. Our products are accessible, portable, shareable, and designed to work fast, wherever life takes you.



We're a premium functional wellness brand helping people optimize focus, clarity, energy, and cognitive performance through clean, effective gum and mints.



Neuro has been featured by The Joe Rogan Experience, Fast Company, The New Yorker, and The Daily Beast, and our founders appeared on Shark Tank Season 11.



About the Role



We're looking for an experienced Customer Support Associate who genuinely enjoys helping people and thrives in a fast-paced environment.



This role goes beyond answering tickets - you'll be responsible for delivering an exceptional customer experience across phone,
, live chat, and social media while exercising sound judgment, solving problems independently, and representing the Neuro brand with professionalism and empathy.



The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who can think critically, prioritize effectively, and take ownership of customer issues from start to finish. We're looking for someone who communicates naturally not someone who relies on scripted responses. Clear writing, sound judgment, and genuine empathy are far more important to us than memorizing processes.



What You'll Do

- Deliver thoughtful, empathetic, and on-brand support across
, live chat, phone, and social media.

- Resolve customer inquiries related to orders, subscriptions, shipping, billing, products, and promotions.

- Prioritize multiple customer requests while maintaining accuracy and response quality.

- Investigate issues independently and determine the best course of action before escalating.

- Take ownership of customer concerns through resolution while keeping customers informed every step of the way.

- Communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently across all support channels.

- Maintain accurate documentation, tagging, and customer records within our CRM.

- Identify recurring customer issues and proactively suggest process improvements.

- Collaborate with Operations, Fulfillment, Marketing, and Ecommerce teams to resolve customer issues.

- Assist during product launches, promotions, and seasonal volume spikes.

- Adapt to changing priorities, workflows, and support channels based on business needs.

- Use AI-powered tools responsibly to improve efficiency while maintaining personalized customer interactions.



What We're Looking For

**Required Qualifications**

- 2+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, or another customer-facing role.

- Excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and the ability to communicate naturally and concisely.

- Professional verbal communication skills and confidence speaking with customers by phone.

- Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to prioritize competing tasks and remain organized in a fast-paced environment.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently while knowing when to seek guidance.

- Exceptional attention to detail.

- Customer-first mindset with empathy, professionalism, and accountability.

- Comfortable switching between phone,
, live chat, and social media support depending on business needs.

- Reliable internet connection and a distraction-free remote work environment.

- Willingness to work shifting schedules and overtime when required.



**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience using one or more of the following:

- Shopify

- Gorgias

- Zendesk

- Amazon Seller Central

- TikTok Seller Center

- Skio, Recharge, or other subscription platforms

- ShipHero or similar warehouse/order management systems

- AI tools that support customer service workflows



**What Success Looks Like**

You'll be successful in this role if you:

- Deliver accurate, thoughtful, and timely responses across every customer interaction.

- Know how to balance multiple priorities without compromising quality.

- Take ownership of customer issues instead of simply responding to tickets.

- Communicate with confidence, empathy, and professionalism.

- Make sound decisions independently while recognizing when escalation is appropriate.

- Continuously look for opportunities to improve the customer experience and internal processes.

- Represent the Neuro brand with every interaction.



**Why You'll Love Working at Neuro**

- Fully remote work environment.

- Opportunity to grow with one of the fastest-growing functional wellness brands.

- Collaborative, supportive, and high-performing team.

- Work that directly impacts our customers and business growth.

- A culture that values ownership, initiative, and continuous improvement.



**How to Apply**



If you're interested in joining the Neuro team, please
 the following to 

- A PDF copy of your resume.

- A 1–2 minute video introduction (Loom, Google Drive, or another shareable link) telling us a little about yourself, your customer support experience, and why you're interested in joining Neuro.

- Your response to the customer scenario below.



Customer Scenario



A customer
s the following:



Subject: Subscription Charge



Hi,



I was charged for my Neuro subscription again, but I was sure I canceled it last month. I'm pretty frustrated because I wasn't expecting this charge. Can you please refund me and let me know what happened?



Thanks.



Please draft the
 you would send to this customer.



**** We're looking for your natural communication style, problem-solving approach, and ability to deliver a thoughtful customer experience. Please complete this exercise using your own words.




 Subject Line



Rockstar CS – [Your Full Name]



***Please Note***

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Due to the high volume of applications, only candidates selected to move forward in the interview process will be contacted.

title: Property Manager / REO Coordinator
description:
Crown Realty Experts is a U.S.-based commercial real estate brokerage and investment company seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Property Manager / REO Coordinator to support our growing operations.



This role combines property management, REO coordination, bookkeeping support, and administrative operations. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with details, maintaining accurate records, coordinating multiple moving parts, and ensuring tasks are completed accurately and on time.



Key Responsibilities



Property Management & REO Coordination

• Manage property-related records, activities, and deadlines

• Coordinate with tenants, vendors, contractors, utility companies, and service providers

• Assist with REO property tracking, inspections, occupancy checks, and maintenance coordination

• Maintain accurate property files and documentation

• Monitor open tasks and ensure timely follow-up



Bookkeeping & Financial Support

• Track invoices, expenses, and vendor payments

• Reconcile transactions and verify account accuracy

• Maintain organized financial and property records

• Assist with reporting and documentation

• Ensure accurate recordkeeping and audit trails



Administrative Support

• Update property management software and databases

• Maintain spreadsheets and reports

• Follow up on outstanding tasks and action items

• Support daily operations and special projects



Required Qualifications



• Experience using Rentec Direct, Buildium, or AppFolio (required)

• Bookkeeping, accounting, finance, or property management experience

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

• Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses



Preferred Qualifications



• REO experience

• Property management experience

• QuickBooks Online experience

• Real estate industry experience

• Experience coordinating vendors and contractors



What We're Looking For



• Detail-oriented and highly organized

• Dependable and consistent

• Strong follow-through

• Professional and trustworthy

• Comfortable working independently

• A proactive problem-solver who takes ownership of their work



What We Offer



• Flexible remote work environment

• Long-term growth opportunity

• Ongoing training and development

• Opportunity to work directly with a growing real estate company

• Potential for increased hours and responsibilities based on performance

Your resume

Full-time, long-term role: 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday

PHP 30,000 during probation

13th month pay

A warm, easy-going Australian owner who is direct and friendly

Sort and answer the owner's
.

Must-Have





Impeccable, clear, slow English with a soft, neutral accent. This is the most important requirement. A strong accent or fast speech will not work for this role.

Able to work 8am to 4pm Queensland time (6am to 2pm Philippines time), Monday to Friday

Good critical thinking and problem-solving, and able to make sound judgment calls when the owner is unavailable

Caring but firm: kind and patient with older and NDIS clients, and firm with difficult customers and staff

A "yep, sure, I'm on it" attitude

Comfortable working mostly by
 with low supervision

CRM experience and quick learning of new systems

ShiftCare or Xero experience (we will train you)

Call centre or phone customer service experience

Booking, rostering or travel planning experience

Care, NDIS or home services experience

Recruitment experience

If you speak clearly and slowly, love being the organised one, and can say "yep, sure, I'm on it" to calls from older and NDIS clients, we would love to hear from you. Please confirm in your application that you can work 6am to 2pm Philippines time, Monday to Friday.

title: Part-Time Local SEO Specialist (5 Hours/Week, Room to Grow)

What You’ll Do



Build our local SEO process from the ground up: onboarding checklists, citation lists by industry, audit steps, QA checks, and reporting

Write clear SOPs so the process can be repeated and eventually handed to others

Do manual citation submissions on directories that tools don’t cover, including industry-specific and local directories

Find and clean up duplicate, outdated, or inconsistent listings across the web

Strong knowledge of Google Business Profile and how the map pack works

Good written English

Experience with GBP suspensions and reinstatements

Steady, long-term work

Flexible schedule

More hours and clients as you grow with us

The chance to build and own the local SEO side of an agency

A boss who values your judgment and gives clear feedback

Please send:



Your resume

One example of a local SEO win you were responsible for, and what you did to get it

A short description of a local SEO process or checklist you’ve built, or how you would build one

The days and hours you’re available each week (Philippine time)

Whether you’re open to a paid test task and a trial period

At least two references from past clients or employers

title: Video Editor for GTA 6 Compilation Channel (long-term, no-commentary)
description:
I’m starting a GTA 6 YouTube channel built on funny-moment compilations: ragdolls, NPC chaos, crashes, fails. I record all the gameplay myself. I need an editor who can turn raw footage into fast, meme-heavy videos on a regular schedule.



Style reference: 

Watch two or three of their videos before applying. That pacing and energy is what I want, applied to GTA 6.



What the edits need



Tight cuts with no dead air; every clip gets to the moment fast

Animated on-screen text that changes size, color and position to match the joke

Cartoon and meme sound effects on hits, falls, crashes and deaths

Meme inserts, zooms, freeze frames, slow-mo and instant replays on the best moments

A strong first 15 seconds that teases the best clips

Clip numbering or a countdown so the video has structure

No voiceover and no AI voices; text, sound and music carry the video

Copyright-safe music and sound effects only



What you’ll get from me



Raw GTA 6 gameplay (PS5 capture) with notes or timestamps for the best moments

A theme for each video, such as “bricks vs NPCs” or “worst crashes”

Fast feedback, usually within [24 hours]



Deliverables



7 videos per week, [10–15] minutes each, 1080p or 4K at 60fps

Turnaround of [24hrs] per video

Up to [2] rounds of revisions

Project files on request



Requirements



Experience editing gaming compilations or meme-style content

Your own library of sound effects and meme assets

Fluent written English, since all on-screen text is in English

Knowing GTA and its humor is a big plus



To apply, send



Two or three links to gaming videos you edited, ideally in this style

What you edit in (Premiere, DaVinci, After Effects, etc.)

One sentence on what makes the reference channel’s editing work, so I know you watched it

title: AI Video Creator - Realistic AI Avatar for Instagram Reels & Posts (Experienced)
description:
ABOUT US

Sendex is a fulfillment (3PL) company with warehouses in China, storing, packing and shipping orders for European e-commerce brands. We want a realistic AI avatar to become the face of our warehouse on Instagram.



THE ROLE

You will create and run a realistic AI avatar and turn our scripts into Instagram Reels and Instagram posts, in English.

We write the scripts and send you reference videos of formats that already work. Your job is to bring them to life with the avatar, matching their quality, hook and pacing.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build a consistent, realistic AI avatar (face, voice, outfit, settings): either a fully AI-generated character or a digital twin of a real team member

- Keep the avatar 100% consistent from one video to the next

- Turn our scripts into polished vertical Instagram Reels: avatar generation, voice, lip-sync, editing, captions, music

- Recreate the style, hook and pacing of the reference videos we send you

- Create Instagram posts (single images and carousels) featuring the avatar and the warehouse

- Mix AI footage with real warehouse footage we send you (packing, shelves, parcels)

- Stay up to date with new AI tools and suggest improvements



MUST-HAVE

- Proven experience (1+ year) creating realistic AI avatar and AI-generated videos. Portfolio required.

- Hands-on with HeyGen (or similar), ElevenLabs, at least one AI video generator (Kling, Veo, Sora, Runway, Higgsfield...) and AI image tools (Nano Banana, Midjourney...)

- Strong editing skills: CapCut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

- Natural lip-sync and voice, no "uncanny" or robotic look

- Strong sense of Instagram short-form: hook in the first seconds, retention, captions, trends

- Good English to understand our scripts and communicate clearly

- Reliable computer and internet, able to work independently

- No need to work European hours. We just need a few hours each day when we can communicate together.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with e-commerce, logistics or B2B content

- Motion graphics / After Effects

- Experience with Meta ads



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term full-time position

- We pay for the AI tool subscriptions needed for the job

- Freedom to test new tools and creative ideas



HOW TO APPLY (applications missing any point will be ignored)

1. Subject line: "SENDEX AVATAR - [Your Name]"

2. Links to at least 3 AI avatar or AI-generated videos YOU made (Drive, YouTube, Instagram...)

3. The AI tools you use every day

4. Your expected monthly salary



Shortlisted candidates will do a short paid test: an Instagram Reel with an AI avatar presenting a fulfillment warehouse, based on a script we will send.

title: OPERATIONS MANAGER (REAL ESTATE EXP IS A MUST!)
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly efficient Operations Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our growing organization. Because we rely heavily on AI to multiply our output, this is not a traditional middle-management position—we need a generalist leader with broad operational capability who can build systems, execute AI-driven projects, organize complex data, and lead a team of Virtual Assistants (VAs).



You will own the mechanics of how our business runs: from architecting our lead funnel and customer-touch processes to troubleshooting daily bottlenecks and coaching our team for maximum efficiency.



Key Responsibilities



AI Leverage & Project Execution: Identify high-impact opportunities to integrate AI tools and automation into daily workflows. Take AI initiatives from concept to full operational deployment, ensuring tools actually save time and improve output quality.



Funnel & Customer-Touch Architecture: Build, optimize, and maintain our end-to-end lead funnel. Design and document seamless customer-touch processes—from initial inquiry through onboarding and ongoing client communication—so nothing falls through the cracks.



VA Team Leadership & Coaching: Directly manage, mentor, and coach a team of Virtual Assistants. Drive coaching efficiency by creating clear SOPs, running tight feedback loops, and holding team members accountable to clear performance metrics.



Systems, Data & Operational Fixes: Maintain clean, structured, and accessible company data across our tech stack. Act as the primary problem-solver for operational breakdowns—stepping in to execute quick fixes while designing permanent system improvements to prevent repeat issues.



Qualifications



Proven Operational Range: Demonstrated experience in an Operations Manager, Chief of Staff, or senior integrator role where you wore multiple hats across systems, marketing operations, and client delivery.



High AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using modern AI tools (LLMs, workflow automation platforms like Zapier/Make, AI-assisted data tools) to streamline business operations—not just surface-level prompting.



Funnel & CRM Experience: Practical background building or managing lead pipelines, CRM workflows, and multi-channel customer touchpoints.



Remote Team Leadership: Track record of successfully managing and upskilling remote teams or Virtual Assistants, with a sharp eye for workflow efficiency and clear delegation.



Data & Systems Mindset: Strong organizational skills with the ability to audit messy processes, clean up databases, and build scalable, repeatable workflows.



Please include "Leverage Agent - Operations Manager" in the subject line.

title: Outbound Customer Service Representative
description:
Outbound Customer Service Representative



Work Hours: 



Monday to Thursday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Pacific Time, with a 30-minute break



Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 30-minute break



Job Overview: 

We are seeking an Outbound Customer Service Representative to manage customer communications and coordinate outbound order processing for a third-party logistics (3PL) and fulfillment operation. This role is responsible for processing and monitoring customer orders, verifying inventory availability, coordinating shipments with warehouse teams and carriers, and providing timely updates on order status and shipping activities. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and experienced in customer service, with a good understanding of warehouse operations, inventory management, and shipping processes.



This position is part of the Warehouse Operations / Customer Service Department and reports directly to the Operations Manager / Customer Service Manager.



Key Responsibilities:

Respond promptly to customer inquiries, requests, and concerns through
 and phone, providing accurate information and timely updates.



Enter, review, process, and monitor outbound orders in the Warehouse Management System (WMS).



Verify inventory availability, SKU details, quantities, pallet IDs, and storage locations before processing orders.



Coordinate with warehouse personnel to ensure accurate and timely order fulfillment and shipment processing.



Schedule and coordinate outbound carrier appointments and follow up on shipment arrangements.



Prepare, review, and maintain shipping documentation, including Bills of Lading (BOLs), packing lists, and other required shipping documents.



Monitor order progress and shipping status to ensure orders are processed and shipped within established timelines.



Provide customers with daily shipping updates, shipment confirmations, and relevant tracking information.



Investigate order issues, inventory discrepancies, and shipping delays, coordinating with the appropriate teams to ensure timely resolution.



Maintain accurate customer account records, order details, WMS transactions, and shipping documentation.



Assist with billing-related tasks by updating charges for each transaction and preparing customer invoices on a monthly basis or as needed.



Generate inventory, order, and transaction reports to support customer updates and operational requirements.



Follow established standard operating procedures (SOPs), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and applicable food safety requirements.



Requirements:

At least 1–2 years of customer service experience, preferably in third-party logistics (3PL), warehousing, fulfillment, or supply chain operations.



Basic understanding of warehouse receiving, inventory management, order fulfillment, and shipping processes.



Hands-on experience using a Warehouse Management System (WMS); experience with Extensiv is highly preferred.



Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and other basic computer applications.



Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with customers.



Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when handling customer orders, inventory records, and shipping documentation.



Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer accounts and competing priorities.



Good problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate discrepancies and resolve customer concerns.



Ability to coordinate effectively with warehouse personnel, operations teams, and external carriers.



Strong sense of accountability, initiative, and follow-through in managing customer requests and outstanding issues.



Ability to work independently while collaborating with different teams to ensure smooth daily operations.







Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Are you the person everyone calls when things get messy?



You know the type. The one who turns a pile of random files into folders that actually make sense. The one who remembers the deadline everyone else forgot. The one who quietly writes the "how to" guide so nobody has to ask the same question twice.



If that's you, we'd love to meet you. Ascend Growth Agency is hiring a part-time Virtual Assistant to help our owner get organized and get more done.



The short version:

 - $750 USD per month, paid by Wise on the 5th and 20th + Eligible for 13th month salary after 6 months

 - 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday

 - US business hours (Central Time), which is a night shift in the Philippines

 - 10 paid days off your first year, growing to 20 the longer you stay

 - Long-term, with the ability to go full time.

- Who You'll Be Working With



Ascend Growth Agency is a US digital marketing agency with a team of 5. We help local businesses and agency partners with websites, graphic design, local SEO, CRM updates, funnels, and AI agent setups. Our clients count on us for fast, reliable work every week.



You'll work directly with the owner. He wears a lot of hats (honestly, too many), and he's ready to hand some of them to someone he can trust. Here's how he puts it:



"We treat people the way we like to be treated. If you're looking for an environment where you are treated with respect and dignity, then this is the place for you."



Here's what that looks like in real life:

- You get paid on time, every time: the 5th and the 20th, by Wise

- Paid days off: 10 in year 1, 12 in years 2 and 3, 15 in years 4 and 5, and 20 from year 6 on

- Your shift is 4 hours. When it ends, you're done for the day.

- You'll be the one building the systems. If you see a better way, say so. That's part of the job.

- We reply to every applicant, even if it's a no. You won't be left waiting and wondering.



What Your Days Will Look Like



At first, you'll shadow the owner and learn how he works. Then, little by little, you'll take things off his plate and make them run smoother than before. You'll:

- Shadow the owner and write down the work he does that you can take over

- Create SOPs (step-by-step guides) for repeat tasks

- Keep the owner organized: tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups

- Organize and clean up file systems so anyone can find what they need

- Find ways to use systems, people, and AI to automate and delegate work

- Follow up with team members and make sure work gets done on time

- Learn our CRM and set up
 sequences that send our follow-ups automatically



In a few months, you'll look back and see a calmer, more organized business that runs better because of you. That's the kind of work you can be proud of.



Your Schedule



4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, during US business hours (Central Time). You'll work one of these two shifts. We'll pick the best one together during your interview.

- 8am to 12pm Central Time (10pm to 2am Philippine time, or 9pm to 1am from March to November)

- 1pm to 5pm Central Time (3am to 7am Philippine time, or 2am to 6am from March to November)



Yes, that's a night shift in the Philippines, so please make sure it works for you before you apply.



What You Bring

- 3+ years as a Virtual Assistant for a busy entrepreneur

- Strong written and spoken English

- Comfortable with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Loom

- Available 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, during US business hours (Central Time)

- Reliable computer, webcam, headset, and fast internet, plus a backup plan if power or internet goes down (we know brownouts happen)

- A quiet place to work



You'll Fit Right In If You're...

- Organized, with an eye for detail

- A reliable communicator who gives updates without being asked

- Excited to learn new technology

- A team player

- Great at creating clear SOPs

- Great at organizing file systems

- Kind but firm. You can politely hold people accountable to getting their work done (yes, even the boss).

- Not afraid to use AI responsibly to work faster and smarter



Bonus Points For

- Experience with CRM systems

- Experience with project management systems

- Customer service experience

- Understanding of marketing

- Don't have all of these? That's OK. Apply anyway if you meet the must-haves.



Let's Be Honest: This Isn't for You If...

- You need step-by-step direction for every task

- You go quiet when you're stuck or running late (we'd much rather hear "I need help" early)

- You're not comfortable being on camera for meetings



Why You'll Love It Here

- A small team where you matter. With 5 of us, your systems will shape how the whole business runs.

- You'll keep learning. CRM automation, AI tools, and marketing systems, all on the job.



Our Hiring Steps



We keep it simple and respectful of your time:

- Fill out the application form (about 15 minutes)

- Zoom interview with our team

- Final interview with the owner

- Job offer and NDA (a privacy agreement)



Your first 60 days are a trial period, so we can both make sure it's a great fit.



How to Apply

- Fill out the application here: 
 

- Upload your resume on the form.

- Paste your Loom video links (3 minutes or less) on the form. Tell us:

  - About your experience as a Virtual Assistant for a busy entrepreneur

  - An SOP or system you created and how it helped

  - How you use AI tools in your work

- No fancy editing needed. We want to hear you, not a production.

- Then we’ll let you know next steps within 7 days.



Applications without the form, or the videos won't move forward. Little details matter in this role, and following instructions is your first chance to show us you've got this.



Salamat for reading all the way to the end. We can't wait to meet you!

title: Bookkeeper for Legal Practice
description:
JOB TITLE

Part-Time Bookkeeper – Australian Law Firm (Xero, Smokeball, Trust Accounting)



Type: Part-time, approx. 6 hours/week (flexible), long-term

Pay: $250 USD/month + 13th month pay

Schedule: Flexible, but you must check the billing inbox and bank feeds every Australian business day. Some overlap with Australian business hours is needed (Australia is 2–3 hours ahead of PHT).



THE ROLE IN SHORT

We are a small Australian legal practice looking for a reliable, detail-focused bookkeeper to take ownership of our day-to-day finances. Volume is low (about 2–5 bank transactions per day and 2–5 trust transactions per week), so accuracy and consistency matter more than speed.



Your four core responsibilities:

1. Reconcile our office accounts in Xero and our trust account in Smokeball

2. Run fortnightly payroll for one employee, including STP and superannuation

3. Manage our billing inbox and follow up unpaid client invoices

4. Keep our books BAS-ready for our registered BAS agent



MUST HAVE

- 2+ years of bookkeeping for Australian businesses using Xero

- Australian payroll experience: STP, superannuation, leave accruals

- Working knowledge of Australian GST and PAYG withholding

- Experience with Hubdoc

- Excellent written English (you will be
ing our clients)

- Reliable internet and a backup power/internet plan



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Australian legal trust accounting experience

- Experience with Smokeball or another legal practice management system (e.g. LEAP, Actionstep)



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Day-to-day bookkeeping (Xero)

- Code and reconcile bank feeds for our office bank accounts, credit cards and loans

- Process supplier invoices and receipts from Hubdoc into Xero

- Reconcile accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Reconcile the ATO Integrated Client Account

- Keep Smokeball in line with Xero (e.g. recording client payments against invoices). If you're not familiar with a legal practice management system, you'll provide a clear report so our staff can make the entries.



Billing inbox and collections

- Monitor the billing/accounts
 inbox, handle routine queries and pass on anything else

- Track overdue client invoices and follow up for payment. Your approach and any escalation will be agreed with the principal before you contact the client.



Trust account (monthly)

- Reconcile the trust account in Smokeball

- Review trust transactions and flag issues such as missing transactions, dormant balances and stale cheques

- Prepare the month-end trust report pack for the principal to review and sign



Payroll (fortnightly, one employee)

- Process the pay run in Xero and report through Single Touch Payroll (STP)

- Prepare superannuation payments in Xero each pay cycle for the principal to approve

- Process leave requests and keep leave balances accurate

- Reconcile wages payable, PAYG withholding and super payable

- Use Xero's employee onboarding for any new staff

- Help prepare end-of-financial-year STP finalisation



BAS (quarterly)

Month-end

- Complete all bank reconciliations

Annual

Your first few weeks

HOW WE WORK

- You prepare, and the principal approves and releases all payments. You will not be asked to move money.

- You'll work alongside our registered BAS agent, who reviews and lodges our BAS.

- As a law firm we handle confidential client information, so you'll sign a confidentiality agreement.

- Clear communication matters more than being online at fixed hours. Tell us early if something doesn't look right.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term, stable role with a small team

- 13th month pay

- A manageable, well-defined workload that fits alongside other part-time work

- Room to grow hours as the practice grows



------------------------------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that don't follow these steps won't be considered.



1. Start your message with the words "Office and Trust Bookkeeping"

2. Briefly describe your experience with:

   - Xero

   - Australian payroll (STP and super) and GST/BAS

   - Legal trust accounting, and which practice management system you've used

3. Answer these in a few sentences each:

   a. How do you reconcile a law firm trust account, and what do you do if it doesn't balance?

4. Confirm you're comfortable with $250 USD/month for approx. 6 hours/week

5. A screenshot of your internet speed test

title: Creator Partnerships for Medal.tv
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



This is an ops role with an outreach front end. You source creators, sign them, walk them through onboarding and warm-up, keep them posting on schedule, and make sure they get paid, across several client campaigns at once. When a campaign needs 10 or more creators posting a video a day, you are the person who knows at any moment who posted, who did not, and who is stuck.



Everything runs through 
. The best fit here is a strong ops person who is also good with people: fast, accurate, organized, and fine with strategy changing mid-contract.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Research and discovery. Find creators on discovery platforms using filters like US-based, niche, and account performance, and check whether their existing content formats match what we are actually trying to produce. Also watch TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram directly for viral formats and rising talent.

- Outreach. First contact via DM,
, or 
, pitch the opportunity, and run the relationship from there.

- Negotiation. Most UGC creators land on one of two standard rates, so day to day this is simple. On micro-influencer campaigns you will negotiate real deals creator by creator: rates, deliverables, usage.

- Onboarding and warm-up. Guide creators through onboarding in 
, including our bot-guided flow. Review warm-up videos and confirm creators are warming their accounts correctly before they post campaign content.

- Content review. Check creator content in 
 against campaign requirements, including that every video uses the right campaign hashtag so it gets tracked. Flag what needs redoing and explain why.

- Posting ops and reporting. Keep daily posting on track across every active campaign and maintain clean reporting on who posted, who did not, and who needs a nudge. Current and accurate, not reconstructed at the end of the week.

- Creator support. Be the first line for creator questions and unblock people fast. Advice has to be right and it has to be quick, since a correct answer six hours late still costs us a post.

- Payments. Run creator payouts on payment platforms like Grade and track what has been paid against what is owed.

- Spreadsheets and process. Work in our existing Google Sheets templates: updating them, fixing errors, keeping campaign data clean. If you can make our sheets run better, even better.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong ops instincts. You hold a lot of moving pieces without dropping any and always know the current state of a campaign.

- You know creator ops language (CPM, base pay, tiered bonuses, caps, deliverables) or can pick it up fast.

- You understand how social platforms actually work: hashtags and tracking, algorithms, formats, why a short-form video lands.

- Comfortable in 
. Servers, roles, channels, threads, tickets, bots.

- Great written communicator. Casual is fine, formal is not required, but it has to be clear, quick, and obviously competent with both creators and the team.

- Software-native. You use a lot of apps, pick up new ones fast on mobile and web (a PC for desktop apps helps), notice UI and UX details, and can take clean screenshots to build walkthroughs that guide a creator through an app they have never opened.

- Comfortable in Google Sheets.

- Adaptable. We work with early-stage startups where strategy gets built as contracts progress.



NICE TO HAVE

- Creator ops, influencer marketing, talent management, or community management experience

- Experience running creator payouts or working with payment platforms

- Advanced Sheets skills (formulas, automation, Apps Script) and an eye for improving process

- Familiarity with our niches: gaming, mobile consumer apps, crypto and trading

- You have created or edited short-form content yourself



THE BAR



You should be able to walk the full creator lifecycle start to finish, from sourcing to outreach to rate agreement to 
 onboarding to warm-up to posting with the right hashtag to tracking to payout, and know where any given creator sits in it at any moment.
