title: Senior E-commerce Project Manager & Team Lead (Philippines)
description:
Senior E-commerce Project Manager & Team Lead (Philippines)



Salary: USD 10.35 to 12.65 per hour, depending on experience (about USD 1,790 to 2,190 per month, full-time)

Hours: PH 13:00 to 22:00, Monday to Friday, all year. In the Netherlands that is 07:00 to 16:00 in summer time (end of March to end of October) and 06:00 to 15:00 in winter time. An afternoon and evening shift, not a graveyard shift.

Type: full-time, remote, long term

Benefits: 13th month bonus (pro rata), paid in the first week of December. HMO allowance of up to $75 per month, starting 4 months after your start date.



ABOUT VIBRIX

Vibrix is a Dutch brand for a healthy indoor climate. Our founder, Remco Lunshof, suffered from allergies and asthma for years. He tested air purifiers from the big brands, was not convinced, and in 2019 started Vibrix in Rijswijk (Netherlands) with one air purifier of his own. Johnny Ma joined as co-owner in 2023 and leads product development.



Today we sell air purifiers (PureFlow), dehumidifiers (DryFlow) and replacement filters to thousands of households through our own webshop, Bol and Amazon. We test every model ourselves before it goes on sale, customers get an answer from a real person every day, and we are rated 4.6 out of 5 on Trustpilot from more than 3,200 reviews. Our products are made by partner factories in China, and we now receive full 40HQ containers every month.



Our mission: healthy air in every home, in every season. We want to grow from the Netherlands and Belgium to more European countries, and over the next 12 to 18 months we are building a team of experienced people, most of them in the Philippines.



See who we are on our website: vibrix . nl (type it without the spaces)



You will work directly with the owners, Remco and Johnny, and with Melvin (People & Talent).



THE ROLE

You are the first lead of our Philippine team and the project manager of our operation. You are responsible for the whole team.



We are hiring four senior roles at the same time: you, a Senior Supply Chain & Demand Planner, a Senior Amazon Marketplace Manager and a Senior Creative Strategist. You are involved in hiring from the start: you help select the candidates and join the interviews.



In your first 90 days you will:

• Own our project board: every task has one owner and a deadline, and you follow up until it is done.

• Follow up with every team member: work done on time and done well, feedback, and step in when something gets stuck.

• Help select the next hires: review applications, join interviews, give your advice.

• Set up a weekly rhythm for the team: one scorecard per role, one weekly call, a daily end-of-day update.

• Write down how the work is done (SOPs), so every new hire can start without someone sitting next to them.

• Take over day-to-day operational work from the owners, so they can focus on product and market.



After a year, success looks like this:

• Every role has a weekly scorecard and the team runs on it.

• Every process and every outside agency has one clear owner.

• No more than 2 issues per week end up with the owners.



WHAT WE ASK

• At least 3 years of proven experience in this role, at one or more comparable companies of the same size or bigger.

• At least 3 years leading a team of 5 or more people.

• You have hired at least 5 people yourself: you ran the selection and made or shared the final decision.

• You will write the SOPs yourself. In your application, share one work instruction (SOP) that you wrote yourself and that a team actually used in its daily work. Tell us who used it and for what.

• In-house or agency experience, not only freelance or task-based work.

• This is your only job.

• Certificate of Employment from your last two employers. We check your years of experience with it.

• At least 15 Mbps download speed, measured on the computer and at the place you will work from. The form asks for the link to your speedtest.net result.

• A laptop with 8 GB RAM and a good headset.



Nice to have: at least 3 years of experience in e-commerce, and experience with Monday, Asana or ClickUp.



We are looking for someone who knows more than we do about building and running a team. You learn fast, figure things out yourself and want to grow with the company.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

• Not a VA or task-based role.

• Not a manager who only delegates. In the first months you do a large part of the work yourself.

• Not a graveyard shift.



HOW TO APPLY

title: HR Specialist - Clinical Marketing Agency - Remote
description:
## About CGA



We're a performance marketing agency for cash-pay healthcare clinics. We run patient acquisition for chiropractic, neurofeedback, functional medicine, HBOT, and aesthetic practices across the US. 65 active clients. Profitable, growing, and intentionally building a small team of high performers.



We're scaling from roughly 15 people toward 25 to 30. Founded 2019. Headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.



## Our Core Values



These are not posters. They are how we d
. You will screen every candidate against them, so you need to believe in them yourself.



1. **Put the Patient First.** MRR and CPL are the scoreboard. A person in need reaching a provider is the game.

2. **Own the Result.** Outcomes, not effort. Never hand over a problem with nothing attached.

3. **Be Direct.** Say the hard thing while it is still cheap to fix.

4. **Be Disciplined.** Do the work on the days you do not feel like it.

5. **Improve Something Every Day.** Today's version of the work, and of you, can be beaten.

6. **Move Fast and Own Failures.** Fail cheap, own it with zero spin, fix it the same day.

7. **Build Systems, Not Dependence.** If only you can do it, you have not finished it.

8. **Put the Team First.** Cover the gap, share the credit, bring energy.



## About This Role



**Fluent, natural English is a hard requirement for this seat.** Every candidate you interview is based in the US. They hear your voice on every call, and leadership reads your written screens, your notes, and your outreach. If English is not effortless for you, spoken and written, this is not your role and we will catch it in the first interview.



Right now when someone leaves, our founders stop what they're doing and go recruit. Sourcing, screening, first-round calls, chasing candidates. That's weeks of executive time and a seat sitting empty the entire time.



You exist so that never happens again.



Your job is to keep a warm bench of pre-interviewed A-players for every seat we run. When someone resigns, we don't start a search. We call three people you already vetted.



This is not a job-posting-and-waiting role. You source, you screen, you interview, and you keep the bench stocked whether or not a seat is open today. Most of the people you interview will not get hired this month. That's the design. You're building inventory, not filling a req.



**This role requires direct experience recruiting for a marketing agency.** Agency seats do not hire like corporate seats. A media buyer, a commission closer, and a video editor each need a different filter, and the people who are great at them rarely look great on paper the same way. We will sharpen your filter. We will not build it from scratch.



You own this function end to end: sourcing, outreach, screening, interviewing, pipeline, reporting. You work directly with leadership. There is no HR manager above you.



## You Screen For Five Different Seats



This is the part most recruiters underestimate. You are not filling one kind of role over and over. You run a bench across five distinct seats, and the filter is different for each one.



**Client Success Manager.** You're testing for retention instinct and calm under pressure. Can they hold a hard conversation with an unhappy clinic owner without caving or getting defensive? Do they read data and translate it into plain language a doctor understands?



**Media Buyer.** You're testing for technical depth and judgment, not platform vocabulary. Ask for specific accounts, specific spend, specific CPA movement, and what they did when performance dropped. Anyone can say "Meta Ads Manager." Few can walk you through a real account they turned around.



**Video Editor.** You're testing on the work, not the resume. Portfolio first, then pace, revision tolerance, and whether they can match an existing style instead of imposing their own.



**Sales Setter.** You're testing for phone presence, resilience, and tonality. This one is best screened live. Can they handle a cold objection on the call with you without folding? Volume rejection is the job, so you're looking for someone who doesn't flinch.



**Closer.** You're testing for discovery skill and real numbers. Close rates, average deal size, how they handle price resistance. You want evidence they diagnose before they pitch.



Almost every candidate you interview is US-based, and most are in sales seats. You need to read American communication norms well enough to tell confidence from arrogance and polish from rehearsal. We'll test for this in your interview.



We'll calibrate you on all five seats in your first two weeks: the scorecards, the questions that actually separate real from rehearsed, and what we've learned from the hires that worked and the ones that didn't. After that, you own the filter.



**You need direct experience hiring for these seats, or seats like them at another agency.** We'll sharpen your filter. We won't build it from scratch. If your recruiting background is corporate roles, technical roles, or one function repeated, this seat will break you by week three.



## What You'll Actually Do



### Sourcing and Outreach



- Source through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and industry communities. Active outbound every single day.

- Build the lists, send the messages, work the follow-up

- Personally handle high-value outreach. The A-player who isn't looking doesn't respond to a template.

- Test channels and report what produces hires, not what produces applications



**The interview minimum is the floor of this job: 3 qualified first-round interviews per week for every active role, and 1 per week for every non-active role on the bench.** The exception is a seat we can fill fast from scratch, and we'll tell you which ones those are. You hit this whether or not anyone has resigned.



- Review Typeform applications and Loom submissions, and kill the weak ones fast

- Score every candidate against that role's scorecard and against our core values

- Run first-rounds solo. We calibrate you in your first two weeks, then you own the filter.

- Surface only candidates worth leadership's time. Leadership spends 30 minutes on a strong person, not 3 hours filtering.



### Interviewing and Screening



### Bench Management and Candidate Experience



- Maintain a live bench of at least 3 interviewed, scored, ready-to-call candidates for every active role, and at least 1 for every non-active role

- Nobody goes dark. Every person in the pipeline knows where they stand.

- Keep the tracker clean: every candidate logged, scored, with a visible next step

- Stay in contact with bench candidates so they pick up when a seat opens

- Write rejections people respect. Everyone we decline is a future referral source or a future client.



### Reporting and Process Improvement



- Weekly pipeline report: bench depth by role, interviews run, channel performance, bottlenecks

- Flag problems with the 1-3-1: one problem, three solutions, the one you recommend

- Improve the screening questions, the outreach templates, the scorecards. You don't wait for permission.



## The Deliverable Bar



**Every week:**



- **3 qualified first-round interviews per active role**

- **1 qualified first-round interview per non-active role**, unless it's a seat we can fill fast from scratch

- Daily outbound sourcing activity

- Weekly pipeline report delivered, complete and actionable

- Tracker current, no candidate without a next step



**Every month:**



- **Bench at 3 or more ready-to-call candidates per active role**

- **Bench at 1 or more ready-to-call candidate per non-active role**

- Zero open roles sitting without qualified candidates in motion

- Zero candidates gone dark



A qualified interview means: cleared the Typeform and Loom screen, has role-relevant experience with numbers attached, and you would put them in front of leadership today.



We pull one interview recording at random each week. Padding the number to hit the number is the fastest way out of this seat.



## The Screening Filter



You're the first real gate. You're filtering for evidence, not vibes.



**Move forward:**



- Demonstrated experience in the role category with numbers attached

- Career progression that makes sense

- Clear communication, written and spoken

- Specific accomplishments, not generic skills-speak

- Evidence they actually read the job description

- Ownership language. "I built." "I missed." "I fixed." Not "we" and "they."



**Kill fast:**



- Generic applications with copy-paste energy

- Vague claims with zero proof

- Frequent short tenures with no explanation

- No measurable accomplishments anywhere

- Victim mentality. Every bad outcome was someone else's fault.

- Entitlement. They lead with what they want before they show what they do.



**Gray area, move to interview:**



- Right skills, slight experience gap

- Unclear career story but strong accomplishments

- Recent transition with relevant background



Rule of thumb: if you're unsure, interview them. The interview answers ambiguity. If it's a clear no, kill it fast and kill it warm.



## Compensation



**Base:** $2,500/month, paid monthly via invoice.



**90-Day Retention Bonus: $400 per hire.** Paid when someone you sourced and screened reaches 90 days and hits their performance milestones.



**On-target earnings: $32,000 to $34,000 annually. We expect to fill 10 seats a year at most.**



The bonus pays on one thing: the people you place are still here and performing at 90 days. Nothing else.



We don't pay for bodies through the door and we don't pay for speed. If you push someone through who washes out at day 60, you lose the money and we lose the seat. That math should shape every candidate you advance.



## Who You Are



- You've recruited before and you can show your work: roles filled, how you sourced them, whether they lasted

- You've hired agency people before. Sales, media buying, creative, and client-facing seats all live on your bench, and you've filled them for real.

- You've interviewed US-based candidates and can read American communication norms

- You have real interviewing instincts. You know which questions separate the genuine article from a well-rehearsed resume.

- You're relentless on sourcing. Outbound is the job, not the backup plan.

- You're comfortable interviewing people for seats that aren't open yet, and you stay in touch well enough that they pick up when one does

- You're organized and fast. Five role categories, dozens of candidates, nothing dropped.

- You communicate warmly and professionally. Your rejection
s don't suck.

- You're coachable. We'll say "tighten your screen" or "move faster." The right answer is "done, here's what I changed."

- You respect the bar. You don't sneak weak candidates through to look productive.



## Hard Requirements



- Location is open. We screen on English, timezone overlap, and track record, not country.

- Fluent, natural English, spoken and written. This is the single hardest requirement in the posting. You are on video with US candidates all day and your written screens go straight to leadership. A heavy accent is fine. Hesitation, grammar errors, or candidates asking you to repeat yourself is not.

- Live overlap with US Central Time sufficient to interview US-based candidates and sync with our team

- **Direct experience recruiting for a marketing agency, or for the seats agencies run: client success, media buying, paid social, commission sales, creative production.** This is a hard filter. We are not teaching you what a strong media buyer or a strong closer looks like from zero.

- Recruiting, talent acquisition, or hiring operations experience with proof attached

- Reliable internet, quiet space, working camera. You're on video all day.

- Comfortable with recruiting tools: LinkedIn (Recruiter a plus), an ATS or Airtable-style tracker, Google Workspace, Loom, Zoom, Calendly. You don't need to be an expert on day one. You need to pick things up fast.

- You run first-rounds solo by week two



## Who This Isn't For



- Your recruiting experience is all corporate, technical, or one repeated function. We need someone who has hired agency people.

- You post jobs and wait. Sourcing is the majority of this role.

- You only like interviewing for open seats. Most of your interviews feed a bench.

- You go quiet on candidates the moment there's no offer to dangle.

- You pass people through to look busy. A washout at day 60 costs you money here.

- You can't say no. Our bar is real. Your job is to enforce it warmly, not erode it.

- You go quiet when something stalls instead of flagging it with a fix.

- You get defensive about feedback.

- You're uncomfortable being measured. This role is measurable by design. That's the feature.

- You want to be a talent strategist. You're an operator who sources, screens, and moves people.

- You need a hiring manager on every first-round call.



## What We Offer Beyond Comp



**You build the engine.** The channels, the filter, the templates, the bench you create become the standard as we double the team.



**Direct founder relationship.** You work with leadership and see how hiring decisions actually get made.



**High leverage.** One person's judgment compounds across every seat in the company.



**Control over your process.** See a better way to source or screen? Implement it.



**Room to grow.** As we scale past 30, this role grows into owning the full people function: onboarding, 30/60/90 tracking, performance cadence.



## What Success Looks Like



**Month 1:**



- Calibrate with leadership on what strong looks like for all five role categories

- Audit the current pipeline and every active posting

- Run your first solo first-rounds by week two

- Stand up the tracker: every candidate logged, scored, decision path visible

- Build the weekly report template

- Start daily outbound on the two highest-priority categories



**Months 2 to 3:**



- Hit the weekly interview minimum across every active and non-active role

- Bench at 3 or more per active role, 1 or more per non-active role

- Know which channels produce hires and reallocate effort

- First placements made and tracked to their 30-day marks



**Ongoing:**



- A seat opens and we fill it fast because the people were already warm

- Improve conversion month over month: outreach to reply, reply to interview, interview to bench

- Your hires reach 90 days and hit their milestones

- Founders never touch recruiting again



## How to Apply



DO NOT APPLY THROUGH ONLINEJOBS.PH - Apply Below. 



Apply here: 



The application includes a short video submission and questions about your sourcing and interviewing process. Name the agency-side roles you've personally filled and tell us how many of those people were still in the seat at 90 days.



Incomplete applications are not reviewed.



### Quick Facts



- **Company:** Clinic Growth Accelerator

- **Founded:** 2019

- **Founders:** Nick Urso (COO), Jeff Van Kampen (CRO)

- **Headquarters:** Milwaukee, Wisconsin

- **Work Mode:** Fully remote, offshore

- **Contract Type:** Independent Contractor, full-time

- **Hiring Timeline:** 1 to 2 weeks from application to contract



## Final Thought



One wrong hire in a 15-person company is 7% of the team, and the damage doesn't stay in their lane. One empty seat for six weeks is worse.



Right now our founders are still doing recruiting. That's time not spent on strategy, clients, or building the business. You absorb all of it.



If you're good, a resignation stops being a fire drill. It becomes a phone call to someone you already vetted.



That's the win, and that's what we pay for. If you want to build a talent engine for a fast-moving company, apply and show us your work.

title: Senior Amazon Marketplace Manager (Philippines)
description:
Senior Amazon Marketplace Manager (Philippines)



Salary: USD 8.65 to 14.40 per hour, depending on experience (about USD 1,500 to 2,500 per month, full-time)

Hours: PH 13:00 to 22:00, Monday to Friday, all year. In the Netherlands that is 07:00 to 16:00 in summer time (end of March to end of October) and 06:00 to 15:00 in winter time. An afternoon and evening shift, not a graveyard shift.

Type: full-time, remote, long term

Benefits: 13th month bonus (pro rata), paid in the first week of December. HMO allowance of up to $75 per month, starting 4 months after your start date.



ABOUT VIBRIX

Vibrix is a Dutch brand for a healthy indoor climate. Our founder, Remco Lunshof, suffered from allergies and asthma for years. He tested air purifiers from the big brands, was not convinced, and in 2019 started Vibrix in Rijswijk (Netherlands) with one air purifier of his own. Johnny Ma joined as co-owner in 2023 and leads product development.



Today we sell air purifiers (PureFlow), dehumidifiers (DryFlow) and replacement filters to thousands of households through our own webshop, Bol and Amazon. We test every model ourselves before it goes on sale, customers get an answer from a real person every day, and we are rated 4.6 out of 5 on Trustpilot from more than 3,200 reviews. Our products are made by partner factories in China, and we now receive full 40HQ containers every month.



Our mission: healthy air in every home, in every season. We want to grow from the Netherlands and Belgium to more European countries, and over the next 12 to 18 months we are building a team of experienced people, most of them in the Philippines.



See who we are on our website: vibrix . nl (type it without the spaces)



You will work directly with the owners, Remco and Johnny, and with our new Team Lead.



THE ROLE

You own our Amazon accounts in Europe, starting with Amazon Netherlands and Germany. You keep the accounts healthy, run PPC and make sure the full catalog is live.



Your first project is account health: getting our European accounts in good standing and keeping them there.



After a year, success looks like this:

• The full catalog is live on Amazon Netherlands and Germany.

• PPC in Germany runs profitably (TACOS below break-even).

• We are live in France through FBA.



WHAT WE ASK

• At least 3 years of proven experience in this role, at a B2C e-commerce brand in consumer electronics or home appliances with USD 5 to 20M yearly revenue. That is the revenue of your employer itself, not of a client or a parent company. Tell us the brand and its yearly revenue, with currency.

• Experience only at large corporations, Amazon aggregators, companies with many brands or B2B companies is not what we are looking for. What counts is experience at one brand that sells electrical appliances or consumer electronics online to consumers, for example air purifiers, heaters, fans, kitchen or personal care appliances.

• At least 3 years of experience managing Amazon seller accounts.

• You have run Amazon PPC (Sponsored Products) campaigns yourself.

• You have solved an Amazon account health problem yourself, for example a suspended listing or an at-risk account.

• In-house or agency experience, not only freelance or task-based work.

• This is your only job.

• Certificate of Employment from your last two employers. We check your years of experience with it.

• At least 15 Mbps download speed, measured on the computer and at the place you will work from. The form asks for the link to your speedtest.net result.

• A laptop with 8 GB RAM and a good headset.



Nice to have: experience with Amazon Europe (for example Germany, the Netherlands, France).



We are looking for someone who knows more than we do about Amazon. You learn fast, figure things out yourself and want to grow with the company.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

• Not a listing upload or data entry role.

• Not customer service.

• Not a graveyard shift.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Apply ONLY through our application form. Messages and applications through the OnlineJobs.ph system will not be read.

2. Form: type this in your browser without the spaces: docs . google . com / forms / d / e / 1FAIpQLSdzzVAFHei0PLDwmGstGocCmUxSLnD-ncEvFyW5Umqfj8Q_7A / viewform

title: Social Media Content Creator & Manager
description:
**Custom Game Cases® | Remote Opportunity**

Custom Game Cases® is an established business specializing in premium aftermarket storage and preservation solutions for retro video games. For over 15 years, we've helped collectors protect, organize, and showcase their favorite games.



We're passionate about retro gaming, video game preservation, and delivering high-quality products to collectors around the world.



We're looking for a talented, creative, and self-motivated **Social Media Content Creator & Manager** to help expand our online presence and bring our brand to life!

 Reels, and promotional clips using existing footage, product images, and original creative concepts.

title: YouTube Video Editor + Motion Graphics (work with a 1M+ sub creator & channel)
description:
WHO WE ARE



Compound One Studios makes long-form YouTube videos for different finance and investing channels. We are the team behind New Money, one of the biggest investing channels on YouTube with over 1 million subscribers. Our work is taking a complicated money topic and making it clear and easy to watch.



THE JOB



We're hiring one full-time YouTube editor who can make good motion graphics to own videos from first cut to final export. That's around 6+ long-form videos a month, usually 10 to 25 minutes each.



You'll:



- Shape raw footage into a video people want to keep watching: the hook, the pacing, the story.

- Work out what should be on screen so a complicated money idea becomes easy to understand.

- Build charts, numbers and explainer animations, using motion graphics you build, as well as some of our templates. We don't mind if you use AI tools too, as long as the quality is high, we don't mind how we get the best results.

- Check that every number on screen is right, and speak up when something doesn't add up.

- Finish sound, colour and export to our checklists.



WHAT YOU NEED



- At least 2 years editing long-form YouTube videos (8+ minutes) for clients.

- Premiere Pro and After Effects or similar.

- Examples of graphics you made that explain something, not just templated animations that decorate the screen.

- Good YouTube retention instincts. You know why someone keeps watching and why they leave.

- Clear written and spoken English.

- Great attention to detail.

- A computer with 16 GB+ of RAM and a dedicated graphics card, plus reliable internet.

- An ability to tell us early, and communicate well if you are likely to miss a deadline or something is going to slip.



You don't need a finance background but a basic understanding of investing concepts is a big bonus. We can teach you. Curiosity and care with numbers matter more.



THE HARD PARTS



- We give a lot of detailed feedback, and every video goes through a checklist.

- Our videos are graphics heavy and the standard is high.

- This is an exclusive, full-time role of 40 hours a week. Sydney is 3 hours ahead of Manila, and we need a few hours of overlap each day with Sydney business hours.



WHAT YOU GET



- PHP 54,000 to 96,000 a month as an independent contractor. Where you start depends on the quality of your work.

- One team and steady monthly pay, instead of chasing clients.

- Regular feedback from the people behind New Money.

- Room to move up and grow (in role and in salary) as you prove yourself.

- A world-class education in how to make high-quality YouTube content working directly with one of the top creators in finance and investing.



HOW TO APPLY



Please apply through this form only. It takes about 5 minutes, and you don't need a CV or cover letter: 



Messages sent without the form won't be read. Individuals only, no agencies.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. A short unpaid edit, a few hours.

2. A paid sample, about one working day.

3. A Google Meet call or interview.

4. A real paid project on a real client video working alongside our actual team.

5. An offer.



We review applications multiple times per week.

title: Documentary & Wildlife Video Editor – Adobe Premiere Pro
description:
**Documentary & Wildlife Video Editor – Adobe Premiere Pro**



Metivier Media, an independent American video production company, is looking for a talented, creative video editor based in the Philippines to help produce wildlife adventures, human-interest documentaries, and television features.



Our stories appear on the growing YouTube channel *That's Wild with Gary Metivier*, as well as television and social media.



**We are looking for a storyteller, not just someone who knows how to edit video.** Please see our stories and see if it fits your style.



**The Work:**

- Edit 3–12-minute documentary-style stories.

- Assemble footage, voiceover, interviews, natural sound, and music into engaging narratives.

- Work from scripts, selected interview soundbites, and editorial guidance.

- Create polished, cinematic stories with strong pacing and emotional impact.

- Collaborate remotely with our American production team.



**Requirements:**

- Strong experience with Adobe Premiere Pro.

- Experience editing documentaries, wildlife, travel, news features, or human-interest stories.

- Excellent storytelling instincts and attention to detail.

- Good English communication skills.

- Reliable high-speed internet capable of downloading large video files.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.



**VERY IMPORTANT:**



All projects must be delivered with the original Adobe Premiere Pro project file, fully editable timelines, organized audio and video tracks, and properly linked media. Our supervising editor in the United States must be able to open the project and make additional changes.



 We value authentic storytelling, natural sound, beautiful images, and emotional connection.



**Compensation:**



Paid per completed project, depending on length and complexity.



- Simple 3–5-minute stories: approximately $100 USD.

- Standard 5–8-minute features: approximately $150–$200 USD.

- Longer documentaries: approximately $200–$250+ USD, depending on complexity.



Rates and scope will be agreed upon before each project.



**How to Apply:**



Please provide:



1. Links to two examples of documentary or human-interest stories you personally edited.

2. Your experience with Adobe Premiere Pro.

3. Your typical turnaround time for a 5-minute story.

4. Your internet download and upload speeds.

5. Confirmation that you can deliver complete, editable Premiere Pro project files.



We will select a few promising candidates for a paid editing test.



This is freelance, project-based work with the potential for an ongoing relationship.



We look forward to finding a creative partner who loves telling meaningful stories.

title: Funny, persuasive ghostwriter for a founder's LinkedIn and Substack (part-time, long term)
description:
I run Argo Modern. I set up Claude systems for founders and consultants so they get hours of their week back, and I run my own business the same way. My whole business is built so I own my schedule and can travel.



I need to post on LinkedIn every weekday and on Substack two or three times a week. I'm not going to do it myself. I've accepted this about me.



So I'm looking for someone who can write as me. You'd get a steady stream of my unpolished thoughts, like voice notes, rants, half sentences, screenshots of things that annoyed me. You'd turn them into posts people actually stop scrolling for.



What you'd write

- Short LinkedIn posts, mostly 100 to 200 words, one a day Monday to Friday.

- Two or three Substack articles a week, 600 to 900 words, with the full story and the real steps. Each one needs a title people can't help opening.

- The articles also go out as my LinkedIn newsletter and my own
 newsletter, so they have to hold up on their own.

- The topic every time is how to get your time back as a founder. Every post comes from something I really did or got wrong. No "buy my thing" posts, ever.



What I care about most



You're funny on the page. You can be persuasive without sounding like a sales
. You write in short lines, plain words, and you'd rather say one specific true thing than five clever general ones.



I can tell AI writing from a mile off, and so can everyone else on LinkedIn. If I can tell, the post is useless to me. Use AI tools if you like. I don't mind, as long as I can't see it.



How it works

- 20 to 25 hours a week to start, more if it goes well.

- Paid monthly.

- A short call with me once a week. The rest happens in writing.

- English has to be excellent. Native or near native.



The test (paid)



Shortlisted people get my list of LinkedIn post ideas. Pick one and turn it into a Substack article, as me, 600 to 900 words, with a title that makes people click. It has to read like a person wrote it. The test is paid whether or not you get the job.



To apply



Send me two or three things you've written that you think are great, and one line on why you want to write for someone else. Start your message with the word "bluebird" so I know you read this far. I need you to also please make sure this content you send me is not-detectable as AI.

title: Amazon Marketplace Specialist/Customer Service | Performance Analytics
description:
# Amazon Marketplace Specialist

**Customer Service | Performance Analytics | Marketplace Optimization**



**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM Pacific Time  

**Position:** Full-Time



### Job Overview



We are seeking an experienced Amazon Marketplace Specialist to support our multiple brands across Amazon FBA and FBM.



The primary focus of this position will be **Amazon customer service**, followed by performance analysis, customer feedback monitoring, and identifying opportunities to improve product listings, quality, and overall customer experience.



While full account management is not currently a daily responsibility, candidates must have comprehensive Amazon Seller Central experience and the ability to step in and support all aspects of account operations when needed.



### Key Responsibilities



**Customer Service – Primary Focus**

- Manage daily Amazon FBA and FBM customer inquiries, complaints, and escalations.

- Resolve order issues, delivery concerns, refunds, and customer dissatisfaction.

- Handle A-to-Z claims, seller feedback, and Amazon support cases.

- Coordinate with internal teams regarding product quality, returns, and fulfillment concerns.

- Maintain excellent response times and customer satisfaction.



**Data Analytics & Performance Monitoring**

- Analyze customer complaints, returns, negative reviews, and recurring product issues.

- Identify trends in customer feedback and provide actionable recommendations.

- Monitor product performance, conversion rates, and customer satisfaction metrics.

- Prepare weekly reports highlighting concerns, trends, and opportunities for improvement.



**Quality Control & Listing Improvement**

- Monitor negative reviews and identify potential product quality concerns.

- Work with QC and product development teams to address recurring issues.

- Review product listings, images, descriptions, and customer expectations for accuracy.

- Recommend improvements to product images, instructions, and listing content to reduce confusion and returns.

- Collaborate with marketing and web teams to improve product presentation and customer experience.



**Seller Central Backup Support**

- Provide backup support for Amazon Seller Central account operations when needed.

- Assist with FBA/FBM inventory, listing updates, account health, and operational troubleshooting.

- Resolve listing suppressions, compliance issues, and Amazon support cases.

- Support listing optimization, SEO, and marketplace growth initiatives as assigned.



### Qualifications

- Minimum 2 years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience.

- Strong experience with Amazon FBA and FBM customer service.

- Comprehensive understanding of Amazon account operations, listings, inventory, and account health.

- Experience analyzing reviews, returns, customer complaints, and sales performance.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets reporting skills.

- Familiarity with Amazon listing optimization and SEO.

- Excellent written English and communication skills.

- Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to work independently during US Pacific business hours.



### Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing multiple Amazon brands.

- Familiarity with Amazon Brand Registry, A+ Content, and Amazon advertising.

- Experience with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar tools.

- Background in cosmetics, beauty, or consumer products.



### How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your Amazon Seller Central experience, including customer service, data analysis, listing optimization, and account management.



We are looking for someone who can deliver excellent customer service while proactively identifying opportunities to improve product quality, customer experience, and marketplace performance.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager
description:
About Aonic

Aonic is growing Aonic Club, our membership, with a clear goal: 4,000 happy members by December 31 and 100,000 members by Q3 next year. Members come from paid Meta ads, organic social, and creators. Creators matter twice: they bring in members directly, and their best videos become the Meta ads that bring in many more.

The Role

You own Aonic's influencer channel end to end, including negotiation. We source three types of creators: UGC creators, influencers, and paid ad creators. A Creator Sourcing Marketing Associate fills your pipeline with 100 to 120 leads a day across all three. You take it from there for every type: qualify, negotiate, close, launch, coach, measure, and move the winners into paid.





The channel's main job is feeding Meta with creatives that convert. Every creator you sign posts organically and grants usage rights, so the best posts run as Meta ads through whitelisting, and paid partnership ads. Organic reach and direct sign-ups count too.





You report to Alex Dyckerhoff, who leads growth at Aonic. You negotiate every deal and present it to Alex for approval before it is signed.





You are not managing a spreadsheet of influencers. You are building an engine.

What You'll Own

Creator pipeline, from lead to signed contract. Own the pipeline for all three creator types: UGC creators who make content for our channels and ads, influencers who post to their own audiences, and paid ad creators who make videos built to run as Meta ads. Take sourced leads from the Marketing Associate and qualify them for US audience, creator type, and fit. Negotiate rates, deliverables, usage rights, and terms for each type. Present each deal to the Head of Growth for approval, then contract, brief, and launch. Together with the Associate, sign 20+ organic creators a month.





Trybe creator tests. Run creator tests on Trybe with creators spread across all of our persona groups, one or two per group rather than one niche. Brief dupe and price-comparison videos made for paid. Read the results in Meta and decide who earns a longer deal.





Retainers and weekly coaching. Offer monthly retainers to the creators whose videos perform. Coach them every week on hooks, scripts, and what converted in Meta, so each round of content beats the last.





Paid amplification. Work with performance marketing to move winning creator content into Meta via Spark Ads, whitelisting, and paid partnership ads. Lock in usage rights and creator permissions on every deal. Feed back which formats, hooks, and creator styles win.





Measurement. Track every creator from first contact to members joined and Meta performance. Cut what doesn't convert, double down on what does, and report weekly to the Head of Growth.

How You'll Work With the Team

Creator Sourcing Marketing Associate. Sources UGC creators, influencers, and paid ad creators, finds 100 to 120 leads a day, and targets 20 signed creators a month. The Associate sources all three types; you qualify, negotiate, close, launch, manage, and measure all three. You also give feedback on lead quality and the opening message so reply rates stay healthy.





Alex Dyckerhoff, Head of Growth. Your manager. You bring negotiated deals to Alex for approval, plus a weekly read on pipeline, winning creatives, and members from the channel.





Performance marketing. You supply the creatives; they scale the winners in Meta. You close the loop by coaching creators on what converted.





Organic social. Coordinate so creator content and our daily organic posts on each channel reinforce each other.

What Success Looks Like

* Members from creators: members who join through UGC creators, influencers, and paid ad creators, growing every week toward our December 31 goal.

* Creative win rate in Meta: a rising share of creator videos that beat our current ads.

* Retained creators: top performers on monthly retainers, delivering better content week over week.

* Signed creators: 20+ a month with the Associate, every one posting organically with usage rights granted.

* On-time delivery: content briefed, delivered, and posted on schedule.

What You Bring

* 3 to 5+ years of hands-on influencer marketing experience, with a track record of building creator programs that delivered measurable results. You can point to specific campaigns and outcomes.

* A strong negotiator. You have closed many creator deals on rates, deliverables, and usage rights, and you know when to walk away.

* Proven success running creator or ambassador programs: you have recruited, activated, and retained large creator networks.

* Deep knowledge of the Instagram and TikTok creator ecosystems, and how organic content translates into paid Meta ads.

* Hands-on experience with whitelisting, Spark Ads, and paid partnership ads.

* Warm, persuasive, and emotionally intelligent. Creators of all sizes want to work with you.

* Highly organized. You can manage dozens of creators and deals at once without dropping the ball.

* Data-driven. You judge creators by members and Meta performance, not vanity metrics.

* Extremely hungry and ambitious. You seek responsibility and go above and beyond.

The Profile We're Looking For

This role requires a rare mix of traits:

* Street-smart: practical judgment, commercial intuition, and the scrappiness to get big results without a massive budget.

* People-smart: a natural relationship builder. Creators trust you, like you, and want to work with you.

* Social-smart: you live and breathe the creator economy. You know who's trending, what formats work, and how the landscape is shifting.

* High-agency: you see opportunities, take ownership, and execute without waiting for instructions. You don't just manage a program; you build one.

Nice-to-Haves

* Experience with Trybe.

* Experience coaching creators on hooks and scripts for paid performance.

* Background in membership, subscription, health, wellness, or CPG brands.

* A personal network of creators you can activate quickly.

Why Join Aonic?

Build Something Massive: This is not a maintenance role. You are building Aonic's influencer engine from the ground up, with the support and resources to scale it aggressively.

Real Ownership, Real Impact: You own the influencer channel end to end: strategy, negotiation, execution, and results.

Elite, Small Team: You will work with a tight group of highly driven operators in a fast-moving, no-bureaucracy environment.

Long-Term Growth: This role has a clear path to leading a full influencer marketing team as the program scales. We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us.

Meaningful Upside: Competitive compensation, cash bonuses for great performance, and equity in a company with extreme growth ambitions.

How to Apply

If you're ready to build an influencer engine that drives real membership growth, and you have the achievements to back it up, we'd love to hear from you.

Please include in your application:

* Your resume / CV

* A brief note highlighting 2 to 3 influencer or creator campaigns you've led, including deals you negotiated and measurable results

* Links to any relevant creator programs, case studies, or portfolio examples

* 1 minute loom video explaining why they are a good fit to lead this program

Aonic is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Specialist Cybersecurity & Privacy Writer
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking an expert Cybersecurity & Privacy Writer to produce highly authoritative, research-backed content. You will be tasked with breaking down complex digital security topics—from consumer VPNs and data privacy laws to enterprise threat landscapes—into clear, engaging, and actionable guides for our readers.



**Key Responsibilities**



* **Content Production:** Research and write original, authoritative blog articles, product reviews, and threat explainers.

* **Technical Translation:** Transform complex concepts (such as encryption protocols, malware prevention, and network security) into accessible, engaging copy for both consumer and B2B audiences.

* **Search Optimization:** Apply advanced SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) principles to improve content clarity, search intent relevance, and discoverability in AI-powered search engines.

* **Fact-Checking & Sourcing:** Support all technical claims with credible primary sources, official regulatory publications (like NIS2 or CRA), and independent verification.



**How to Apply**

Please submit your CV along with a portfolio demonstrating your ability to write clear, authoritative cybersecurity or tech content.



---



## Required Skills for the Cybersecurity Niche



To thrive in this specialized sector, a writer must possess a hybrid of technical understanding and elite editorial craft:



* **Subject Matter Expertise:** A firm grounding in network security, VPN technologies, encryption standards, and digital privacy trends. While coding isn't strictly mandatory for content writers, an understanding of basic programming principles and current threat vectors is highly advantageous.

* **Technical Translation & Storytelling:** The communication skills required to take dry vulnerability assessments, compliance audits, or system specifications and turn them into compelling, readable narratives for non-experts.

* **Advanced SEO & GEO Fluency:** The ability to write not just for standard human search intent, but to structure data and explanations logically for modern AI-driven search engines.

* **Rigorous Source Verification:** Strong independent research abilities. Specialists must be able to verify technical claims, evaluate primary sources (like academic papers or government cybersecurity frameworks), and avoid repeating unsubstantiated vendor marketing fluff.

* **Audience Adaptability:** The capacity to pivot seamlessly, whether writing a high-level briefing for a C-suite executive, a tactical guide for an IT professional, or a basic digital hygiene tutorial for an everyday consumer.

description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW:

SimpleKeep is a modern US-based accounting company that values our team and creates a fun, dynamic work environment. Our goal is to provide exceptional accounting services to our clients while fostering a positive and supportive team culture. We are a remote team that leverages the latest technology to work together efficiently and effectively.



We're a great company to work for, and a small team, so you'll be able to come in and really have an impact on the way we do business. We're growing, and we’re looking to add an experienced person to our team.



POSITION OVERVIEW:

We’re seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Accounting Supervisor with proficiency in QuickBooks and Xero to join our growing remote team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in accounting, a passion for mentoring and developing staff, and a desire to work in a dynamic and supportive team environment. This is a remote position with flexible work hours.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Supervision and Leadership:

- Manage and oversee daily accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger.

- Mentor and provide guidance to junior accountants and other team members.

- Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to staff.

- Develop and maintain accounting policies and procedures.

2. Financial Reporting:

- Oversee the preparation and analysis of financial statements.

- Ensure timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

- Provide financial analysis and insights to clients.

3. Bookkeeping and Reconciliation

- Ensure accurate and timely recording of financial transactions.

- Oversee bank reconciliations, accounts payable, and accounts receivable processes.

- Ensure accurate and timely month-end and year-end close processes.

- Prepare financial statements and other financial reports.

4. Budgeting and Forecasting:

- Lead the preparation of budgets and financial forecasts.

- Monitor budget performance and report variances.

5. Tax Compliance:

- Supervise the preparation and filing of tax returns.

- Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local tax regulations.

6. Software Utilization:

- Oversee the use of QuickBooks and Xero for all accounting functions.

- Ensure data integrity and accuracy within these systems.

7. Audit and Compliance:

- Ensure compliance with internal financial and accounting policies and procedures.

- Coordinate and support internal and external audits.

8. Communication:

- Communicate effectively with clients, vendors, and financial institutions.

- Provide clear and concise reports and updates to senior management.

- Ensure excellent English communication within the team and with stakeholders.

- Provide exceptional customer service to clients.

- Collaborate with other departments to streamline processes and improve efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

- CPA certification preferred.

- Minimum of 5 years of accounting experience, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role.

- Proficiency in QuickBooks and Xero is mandatory.

- Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting.

- Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Experience in managing remote teams and working with US clients.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other accounting software.

- Efficient, personable, adaptable, and organized.



WORK ENVIRONMENT:

This is a remote position; candidates must have a reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace.



BENEFITS:

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Flexible work hours and remote work environment.

title: AI CONTENT CREATOR & VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Hey 👋



I run an AI content agency. We make short form video using AI avatars, built with Veo and Flow, for our own brands and for clients across a few different markets.



Let me be honest about who I’m looking for



I’m not looking for someone who wants a job. I’m looking for someone who actually cares about the work.



The difference shows up fast. People who are just here for the money do the minimum, ignore feedback, and plateau. People who care get obsessed with why one video hits and another doesn’t, and they get better every single week.



I already have creators like that. They’re brilliant, they push each other, and they’ve built something I’m proud of. I’m only adding people who raise that standard, not dilute it.



If that sounds intense, it probably isn’t for you. If it sounds like what you’ve been looking for, keep reading.



What you’d actually do



Create short form videos using AI avatars, working from prompts and guides I provide.



Each video takes around an hour once you’re up to speed. The minimum is 2 videos a day per account, which works out at 14 a week. Finish them early and the rest of your week is yours.



What you get that you won’t get elsewhere



I share everything. Prompts, techniques, what’s working, what’s failing. I make the videos myself first so I hit the problems before you do.



We pioneer content in this space, so there’s often a new style to learn week to week. You’ll be building skills that barely exist in the market yet.



And you’ll be alongside creators who are genuinely good. That matters more than people realise.



The one fixed commitment



Sunday group calls, 7 PM Philippines time, every week. That’s where I give feedback and we level up together. It’s the single biggest reason our standard keeps climbing, so it isn’t optional.



What I need from you



Coachable. I give real feedback and we run proper revisions. If criticism stings rather than motivates, this won’t work.



Communicative. If you’re stuck, tell me. Don’t disappear and don’t guess.



Reliable. If you say it’s coming, it comes.



Quality over volume. I’d rather have one great video than three rushed ones.



The pay will be 3$ an hour as most videos takes around that time to make whilst learning new process and techniques, after a while the time frame should shrink within 30-45mins to make.



I’m telling you this early so nobody wastes their time.



How to apply



Tell me, in your own words:



- Why AI content genuinely interests you, not a textbook answer.

Something you’ve made with AI tools, even if it’s rough. Link it



- What you’re currently working on and how many hours you could commit



- How you handle feedback when someone tells you your work isn’t good enough yet

title: Client Care & Administrative Virtual Assistant
description:
$3 USD per Hour + Additional Contract Benefits

100% Remote | Open to Applicants Worldwide

20 Hours per Week to Start | Long-Term Growth Opportunity



LOOKING FOR A VA ROLE WHERE YOU CAN LEARN, GROW, AND MAKE A DIFFERENCE?



Do you enjoy helping people, staying organized, and making someone’s day a little easier?



Are you someone who takes pride in doing a good job, enjoys learning new things, and likes finding better ways to work?



If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you!



We’re Boulder Pro Painters, a growing residential painting company in Colorado, USA.



We’re looking for a friendly, reliable, and organized Virtual Assistant who can help us provide an excellent customer experience while keeping our daily office activities running smoothly.



You don’t need to know everything about the painting industry or be an expert in every software platform.



What matters most to us is your communication skills, reliability, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.



We’re hoping to build a long-term working relationship with someone who wants to grow professionally and eventually take on greater responsibilities.



A LITTLE ABOUT US



At Boulder Pro Painters, we believe that hiring a painting company should be a positive experience for homeowners.



From the first phone call to the completion of a project, we want our customers to feel heard, respected, and confident that they’re in good hands.



That’s where you come in.



You’ll often be one of the first people a homeowner speaks with when they contact us.



Your ability to listen, ask thoughtful questions, and communicate warmly will help create the kind of experience we want our company to be known for.



You’ll work closely with Jonathan, our Founder & CEO, and have the opportunity to learn how a growing American home service business operates.



We value honesty, accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement, and treating people with respect.



WHAT YOUR DAY MIGHT LOOK LIKE



Imagine a homeowner calls because they’re thinking about repainting their living room.



Instead of simply taking their name and phone number, you take a moment to understand what they’re hoping to accomplish.



Maybe they’re getting ready to sell their home. Maybe they just moved in and want to make the space feel like their own.



You listen, ask a few helpful questions, and make scheduling an estimate easy.



By the end of the conversation, that homeowner feels comfortable, understands what happens next, and looks forward to meeting with us.



That’s the experience we’re looking for.



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



You’ll help us with:



1. Answering incoming customer calls in a friendly and professional manner.

2. Responding to homeowners who contact us through our website, phone, or online platforms.

3. Returning calls to customers who have requested painting estimates.

4. Asking thoughtful questions to understand their painting needs.

5. Scheduling and confirming estimate appointments.

6. Helping customers reschedule appointments when necessary.

7. Sending appointment reminders and routine communications.

8. Keeping customer information accurate in our CRM.

9. Organizing calendars, customer notes, and administrative records.

10. Making sure customer questions and requests receive timely attention.



This is a customer care and administrative role, not an inside sales position.



You won’t be responsible for closing sales, negotiating prices, or convincing homeowners to purchase services.



Your responsibility is to make people feel taken care of and ensure their information and appointments are handled correctly.



WE LOVE TECHNOLOGY, AND WE HOPE YOU DO TOO!



We’re always looking for ways to improve how we work.



We use software, automation, and AI tools to help us stay organized, save time, and provide better service.



One of the things we’re especially excited about is how tools like ChatGPT can help us become more productive.



But don’t worry. You don’t need to be a programmer or an AI expert!



We’re looking for someone who is curious and willing to learn.



Maybe you’ve already used ChatGPT to help write
s, organize information, or solve problems.



That’s great!



Or maybe you’re just getting started and want to learn.



That’s great too.



What matters is that you’re open to trying new things and finding better ways to work.



We believe technology should help people do their jobs better, not make things unnecessarily complicated.



As you become comfortable with the role, you’ll have opportunities to learn more about our systems and help improve our daily processes.



THE TOOLS YOU’LL GET TO LEARN



We currently use:



GoHighLevel for customer communication, scheduling, and CRM management.



Google Workspace for calendars, documents, and daily organization.



PaintScout for parts of our estimating process.



ChatGPT and other approved tools to support administrative work and process improvement.



Experience with these tools is helpful, but it isn’t required.



We’ll help you learn the systems you need for your responsibilities.



ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES AS YOU GROW



Once you’re comfortable with customer care and scheduling, we may gradually introduce other tasks, including:



1. Publishing company-provided content on
 and Instagram.

2. Helping maintain our Google Business Profile.

3. Responding to routine social media inquiries.

4. Organizing customer project information.

5. Helping coordinate routine project updates.

6. Requesting customer reviews after completed projects.

7. Preparing simple administrative reports.

8. Documenting and improving office procedures.

9. Helping maintain and test approved CRM workflows.



You won’t be expected to create graphics or edit photos and videos.



We’ll provide or approve the content you publish.



COULD YOU BECOME OUR FUTURE VIRTUAL OFFICE MANAGER?



That’s what we’d love to work toward with the right person.



We’re not looking for someone to handle everything immediately.



We want to build a strong foundation together.



You’ll begin by learning how we communicate with customers, schedule appointments, and manage our daily administrative work.



As your confidence, skills, and responsibilities grow, there may be opportunities to take on more ownership of our office operations.



Our long-term vision is to develop someone who can help manage our administrative systems, coordinate routine activities, and keep things organized as the company grows.



This isn’t a guaranteed promotion, but it’s a genuine direction we’d like to explore with the right person.



WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU A GREAT FIT?



We think you’ll enjoy working with us if you:



1. Speak and write English clearly and confidently.

2. Feel comfortable speaking with American homeowners over the phone.

3. Enjoy listening to people and helping them find answers.

4. Are friendly, patient, and respectful.

5. Pay attention to details and stay organized.

6. Take ownership of your responsibilities.

7. Follow through on what you say you’ll do.

8. Communicate when something isn’t clear.

9. Are willing to receive feedback and improve.

10. Enjoy learning new technology.

11. Are curious about AI and automation.

12. Can work independently while keeping us informed.

13. Are interested in a stable, long-term professional opportunity.



Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, customer service representative, appointment scheduler, or administrative assistant is a plus.



A college degree is welcome but not required.



We’re more interested in your ability to communicate, learn, and consistently do good work.



You’ll need a reliable computer, stable internet, a quiet workspace, a headset suitable for customer calls, and a reasonable backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS



We want you to feel supported while learning the role.



That’s why we’ll begin with a paid 30-day onboarding period.



During your first month, we’ll focus on:



1. Getting to know our company and how we serve homeowners.

2. Learning how to answer customer calls confidently.

3. Understanding our appointment scheduling process.

4. Keeping customer records accurate.

5. Becoming comfortable with our communication systems.

6. Building good daily habits and learning our expectations.



You’ll receive guidance and feedback as you improve.



We don’t expect you to know everything on your first day.



What we do expect is that you show up prepared, communicate openly, ask questions, and make an effort to get better.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



We believe in being transparent about compensation and expectations from the beginning.



Starting pay: $3 USD per hour.



Initial schedule: 20 hours per week.



Monday through Friday, generally 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Mountain Time (Denver, Colorado, USA).



WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO EARN



Hourly: $3 USD, approximately ₱191 PHP.



Weekly (20 hours): $60 USD, approximately ₱3,817 PHP.



Every two weeks (40 hours): $120 USD, approximately ₱7,634 PHP.



Average monthly: $260 USD, approximately ₱16,541 PHP.



Philippine peso amounts are estimates based on the November 17, 2026 exchange rate of $1 USD = ₱63.6205. Actual peso equivalents may change.



Boulder Pro Painters will cover the fees for sending your compensation.



You’ll be paid twice per month for your approved hours worked. Payment arrangements and any receiving or currency conversion charges will be explained before we begin.



OPPORTUNITIES FOR ADDITIONAL HOURS AND BENEFITS



After your initial onboarding period, we hope to increase your hours as you become more comfortable and capable.



Here’s how we envision the opportunity developing:



First 30 days: Approximately 20 hours per week.



Within 30 to 60 days: Potential increase to 30 to 40 hours per week, depending on performance and business needs.



Expanded schedule: Approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time, Monday through Friday, including a one-hour unpaid meal break.



After 90 days: A formal performance and compensation review.



Additional annual payment: A prorated contractual payment based on your regular compensation and time worked.



Paid time off: Contractually agreed paid time off after successfully completing the first 90 days.



Long-term growth: Opportunities to develop new skills, take on additional responsibilities, and potentially grow into a Virtual Office Manager role.



Our Mountain Time schedule observes daylight saving time, so your local working hours may change during the year.



This position is intended as an independent contractor engagement. Final terms will be documented in a written agreement, subject to applicable requirements.



WHAT YOU’LL FIND WORKING WITH US



We’re a small company with big goals, and we believe the right people make all the difference.



You’ll have the opportunity to work directly with our CEO, learn new skills, and contribute to a company that’s actively improving its systems and customer experience.



We value people who care about their work, treat others respectfully, and want to keep growing.



We also understand that everyone has a life outside work. Clear expectations, dependable communication, and mutual respect matter to us.



We’re looking for someone who wants to build a lasting working relationship where both sides can succeed.



READY TO APPLY? WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU!



If this sounds like the opportunity you’ve been looking for, we’d love to learn more about you.



Please include the following nine items in your application.



1. A SHORT COVER LETTER



Tell us a little about yourself, why this position interests you, and why you think you’d be a great fit.



2. YOUR RÉSUMÉ



Share your work experience, education, and relevant skills.



3. A SHORT VIDEO INTRODUCTION



Please record a simple, unedited one- to two-minute video introducing yourself.



Tell us why you’re interested in the position and what you enjoy about helping customers or staying organized.



You don’t need professional equipment or video editing. A simple recording is perfectly fine.



Please share a link we can access.



4. YOUR SCHEDULE CONFIRMATION



Let us know whether you can work our initial 20-hour schedule and potentially transition to expanded hours.



5. YOUR LOCATION AND TIME ZONE



Share your country, local time zone, and availability in both your local time and Denver Mountain Time.



6. YOUR COMPUTER AND INTERNET SETUP



Tell us about your computer, internet connection, and backup plan.



7. YOUR CURRENT WORK COMMITMENTS



Are you currently working with other clients or employers? If so, tell us about your schedule and how you’ll accommodate our required hours.



8. A CUSTOMER CARE QUESTION



Imagine a homeowner requested a painting estimate, but they didn’t answer when you called.



What would you do next?



We’re interested in how you approach helping people and making sure they receive a response.



9. A TECHNOLOGY AND LEARNING QUESTION



Have you used ChatGPT or other AI tools before?



If yes, tell us about something you’ve used them for.



If not, tell us how you’d approach learning a new tool that could help you do your work better.



There’s no perfect answer. We simply want to understand how you think and learn.



WHAT HAPPENS AFTER YOU APPLY?



We’ll review complete applications and invite selected candidates to a live interview.



We may also ask you to participate in a short practice phone conversation so we can get to know your communication style.



Please make sure all nine application items are included and your links are accessible.



Only complete applications will be considered.



We’re hoping to welcome the right person within the next two to four weeks.



Thank you for taking the time to learn about Boulder Pro Painters.



We look forward to hearing from you!



Jonathan Ramirez

Founder & CEO

Boulder Pro Painters

title: Full Time: Video Editor and Graphic Designer
description:
Full-time applicants only!

IMPORTANT: If you currently have another job, freelance work, or any ongoing project on the side, please do not apply.



Join Our Team as a Video Editor – Bring Stories to Life with Us!



Are you an expert in video editing/Graphic Designing with a passion for creating dynamic, impactful content? Do you have the skills to bring stories to life with your editing style, and are you looking for an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, creative environment? At Uniworld Omniport, we're on the hunt for a dynamic and driven Video Editor to join our growing team.



The ideal candidate is someone with a successful track record of building social content for a brand and has experience in successfully growing a brand’s social media presence. If you have a proven ability to craft compelling narratives through video and are up-to-date with the latest editing techniques, we’d love to hear from you!



About Us

Founded in 2006, Uniworld Omniport is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce company that owns and operates two industry-leading brands: BBO Poker Tables and Game Theory Tables. Based at the Speedway in North East Las Vegas, our global presence connects team members from around the world, united by our mission to "create unforgettable memories between friends and family." At the core of our internal culture are trust and accountability, values that are evident in the actions of our team members.



Why This Role Matters:

This isn’t measured just by the quality of the content you create, but by the impact it has on our brand and audience. As a Video Editor at BBO Poker Tables and Game Theory Tables, you’ll contribute to the bigger picture—driving customer engagement, enhancing our brand image, and fostering team collaboration. You’ll be at the forefront of creating videos that not only capture attention but also deliver tangible results.



The Perfect Video Editor We Need:

- Expertise in Key Software: Highly proficient in Adobe After Effects and/or Adobe Premiere with a solid understanding of Adobe Photoshop.

- Content Creation Mastery: Proven ability to create dynamic, high-quality videos that resonate with audiences and align with our brand image.

- Engagement-Driven: Focused on achieving and maintaining high levels of engagement across all platforms—social media, websites, and more. You’ll help elevate our content performance to the next level.

- KPI-Oriented: You’re results-driven and have experience managing performance metrics, consistently meeting or exceeding KPIs related to content engagement, social media performance, and website traffic.

- Collaborative Spirit: Able to seamlessly work with various team members to deliver content that aligns with a unified brand message and resonates with our target audience.

- Continuous Growth: Eager to learn and develop new skills, improving efficiency and mastering new tools and techniques.



What You’ll Deliver:

- Consistently produce captivating videos that resonate with our audience and align with our brand’s vision.

- Drive higher levels of interaction across social media and digital platforms, helping to boost views, shares, and brand awareness.

- Bring fresh ideas and creative solutions to the table, enhancing teamwork and contributing to a stronger, more unified creative process.



Why Work With Us?

- Creative Environment: You’ll have the opportunity to work on a variety of exciting projects that allow you to showcase your creativity and skills.

- Growth Opportunities: We believe in fostering personal and professional growth, offering training and development to help you expand your skill set.

- Supportive Team: Join a talented, collaborative team that values creativity and innovation.

- Flexible Work Environment: We offer flexible work options to support work-life balance.

- Competitive Pay & Benefits: We offer a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.



Deliverables

How Success is Measured in This Role:

In this role, success is defined by your ability to create powerful, visually engaging content that drives results and strengthens our brand. Here's what success looks like:

- Bring Still Images to Life: Use Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator to transform static images into dynamic, attention-grabbing animated ads.

- Video Editing & Motion Graphics: Take raw video footage and craft compelling narratives that speak to our audience. Combine video editing with motion graphics to produce engaging social media content and advertisements.

- Motion Graphics Design Expertise: Create stunning motion graphics that enhance video content, using your design skills to add visual appeal and depth to advertisements, social media posts, and promotional videos.

- Animate Static Assets: Transform still images and logos into dynamic animated visuals, elevating the storytelling experience and ensuring content stands out across multiple platforms.

- Graphic Design Mastery: Create visually compelling static graphics, including social media posts, website assets, and
 templates that align with our brand’s voice and aesthetic.

- Design Integration: Combine graphic design with video editing to create cohesive content, ensuring that all visual elements complement each other and enhance the storytelling experience.

- Adapt Content for Multiple Platforms: Re-edit video content into different aspect ratios for various platforms, ensuring optimal presentation and engagement.

- Collaborate with the Team: Work closely with the creative team and stakeholders to ensure your video content aligns with the brand strategy and meets project goals.

- Create Visual Masterpieces: Resize, cut out, and composite images to create eye-catching graphics that complement your video content.

- Maintain Quality: Ensure that all animations and video content are on-brand, visually appealing, and adhere to the highest standards.

- Meet Deadlines & Deliver on Expectations: Take ownership of project timelines and ensure your content is delivered on time, meeting or exceeding expectations.



What You’ll Deliver:

- Consistently produce captivating videos & graphics that resonate with our audience and align with our brand’s vision.

- Drive higher levels of interaction across social media and digital platforms, helping to boost views, shares, and brand awareness.

- Bring fresh ideas and creative solutions to the table, enhancing teamwork and contributing to a stronger, more unified creative process.



Ready to join the Team?

title: Senior Growth Media Buyer (Meta & Google Ads | D2C Apparel Brand)
description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

We are a high-growth technical athletic apparel and performance brand scaling aggressively. We are expanding our paid acquisition channels and need an elite, data-driven Media Buyer who lives and breathes high-spend performance marketing. 



If you only know how to "boost posts," manage social media calendars, or rely entirely on automated campaign setups without understanding margins, attribution, and creative hooks, this role is not for you.



**THE ROLE:**

You will take full ownership of our Meta and Google Ads accounts, managing and scaling a starting budget of $10,000+/month with the clear trajectory to scale rapidly. You will be responsible for full-funnel strategy, campaign architecture, rigorous scaling/killing protocols, tracking integrity (CAPI, GA4, attribution windows), and systematic creative testing.



**REQUIREMENTS (Do not apply unless you meet these):**

- Proven track record managing and scaling Meta 
/Instagram) and Google Ads accounts for e-commerce / direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands with budgets exceeding $10k+/month.

- Deep technical understanding of iOS18+ signal loss, server-side tracking (Meta CAPI), Google Performance Max (PMax) structuring, brand safety, and merchant center feeds.

- A relentless obsession with creative testing frameworks (hook rates, hold rates, iteration speed, and briefing video editors).

- Advanced analytical capability: You look at ROAS, CPA, MER (Marketing Efficiency Ratio), and contribution margins daily—not just dashboard vanity metrics.

- Self-managing, highly communicative, and proactive. You don't wait to be told what to test next; you bring solutions and new angles to the table.



**HOW TO APPLY:**

To prove you actually read this description and can pay attention to detail, start your application message with the exact code word: **"APEX_SHARK"**. 



In your message, briefly outline:

1. The largest monthly ad budget you have successfully managed and scaled.

2. How you structure creative testing on Meta right now.

3. A brief case study or example of how you turned around an underperforming ad account.
