title: Senior Real Estate Researcher: Chicago-Area Title, Heirs & Skip Tracing, Full-Time
description:
WHO WE ARE

We're a privately held real estate investment firm in Chicago. We buy inherited, tax-delinquent and pre-foreclosure properties in Cook and DuPage Counties, many with title problems and owners who have passed away. Every deal starts with research: who really owns the property, what's recorded against it, who the heirs are, and how to reach them.



YOUR ROLE

You'll work directly with Haaris (Principal) and our small research team. We need a senior researcher who can do the whole job, start to finish, and decide which properties are a good fit.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Check the property and the court record: foreclosure and probate dockets, sale dates, listing status and Street View.

- Run the chain of title on Cook and DuPage County properties: deeds, mortgages and releases, liens (tax, judgment, IRS/State), lis pendens, and conveyances, using each county's recorder, treasurer and court records.

- Find the people: when an owner has passed away, use obituaries, family trees, vital records and probate records to identify the heirs. Cross-check them against the court case.

- Skip trace owners and heirs to find working phone numbers. Training is provided on our tools.

- Make the call on each property: keep, remove or tier it against our written criteria, with a clear one-line reason.

- Research tax-sale redemption batches (20–40 properties) before their deadlines.

- Flag what doesn't add up: an unreleased loan, a deceased owner still on title, a lien the file doesn't show.

- Write clear notes in our CRM (GoHighLevel).

- As you grow into the role: order title reports on properties we're buying, and check them against your own research.



A TYPICAL WEEK

One tax-sale batch on deadline, plus properties from our foreclosure and probate lists. For each one: the title, your call on whether it's a good fit, and the heirs and phone numbers for the ones that are.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Your calls hold up when we spot-check them.

- Tax-sale batches are finished before their deadlines.

- For every good-fit property, every heir is found and has a working phone number.

- You catch problems before we do.



WHERE YOU'LL WORK

Cook and DuPage County recorder, treasurer and court records (including probate) · obituary and family-tree sources (Legacy.com, Find a Grave, FamilySearch, Ancestry, newspaper archives) · vital records · people-search tools · GoHighLevel.



WE'D PREFER YOU OVER OTHER CANDIDATES IF YOU HAVE

- Experience as a title examiner, abstractor or searcher, or as a probate/curative paralegal, on US property.

- Heir or genealogical research: obituaries, family trees, vital records (birth, marriage, divorce, death), probate heirship. If you don't have it yet, you must be willing to learn it. We'll invest in training for the right person.

- Skip tracing experience.

- Illinois experience (Cook, DuPage or other counties).



MUST HAVE

- You can read recorded documents and court dockets and explain what they mean.

- You think independently: you spot issues, not just gather data.

- Excellent written English. Your notes drive our buying decisions. You'll also need conversational spoken English for training calls.

- Careful, checklist-driven work.

- Full-time (40 hours a week) for the right person. We can start at 20–30 hours (pay prorated) during your first weeks if that suits you better.

- Some daily overlap with Chicago business hours (Central Time). The rest is flexible.

- A strong internet connection, and comfort with Slack, Zoom or Google Meet, and Google Workspace.

- You'll handle personal information about property owners and their families, so a confidentiality agreement is required.



PAY AND HOW WE HIRE

- $6–9 an hour, depending on your experience and your paid test result.

- Deal bonus: on top of your hourly pay, a bonus for every property that closes from a lead you researched. We'll share the details in the interview.

- A raise review at 60 days, based on accuracy, deadlines met and heirs found.

- How we hire: a short call, then a paid test on 10 real properties we've already researched (scored on what you find, records and people, and how clearly you write it up), then a screen-share where you walk us through one of them.

- A long-term role, with room to grow as our research team grows.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Put the word "Recorder" in your subject line, attach your resume, and answer these three questions in your message:

1. Tell us about a real property where you researched the title and traced the heirs: the situation, what you did, what you found, and how it helped.

2. Walk us through how you'd build the chain of title on a property: which records, in what order, and what you'd watch for.

3. The owner died in 2021 and no probate case was opened. How would you identify the heirs and find a working phone number for each?



Applications without "Recorder" in the subject line, and generic cover letters, won't be read.

title: Video Podcast Editor & Social Media Content Creator
description:
The Celestial Group (TCG)

Remote | Philippines | Part-Time | Ongoing



A Little About Us



We are The Celestial Group, a US-based strategic advisory company helping leaders build and grow modern businesses.

We're getting ready to launch The Fourth Frame Podcast, featuring thoughtful, engaging conversations about business, leadership, culture, and the world we're navigating.

We're looking for a talented video editor to help bring these conversations to life through polished podcast episodes and compelling social media content.

Our style is natural, conversational, and sophisticated. We want professional production that allows the ideas and personalities to shine without feeling overly produced.

We're a small, collaborative team and would love to find someone who brings creativity, takes ownership of their work, and is excited to grow with us.



What You'll Be Creating



Podcast Episodes: Edit recordings from three camera angles into polished, engaging episodes, typically 15–30 minutes long.

Natural Conversations: Remove pauses, restarts, repeated thoughts, and unnecessary content while maintaining the flow and personality of the conversation.

Professional Audio & Video: Select camera angles, balance audio, match colors, and ensure consistent production quality.

Social Media Clips: Identify compelling moments and create 3–5 engaging short-form clips per episode for LinkedIn, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Branded Visuals: Incorporate our existing brand assets, music, captions, titles, and graphics. Create YouTube thumbnails and supporting social visuals as needed.

Publishing-Ready Content: Prepare final videos in the appropriate formats and provide organized, editable project files for future use.

We welcome your creative ideas about what makes a great episode, which moments are worth highlighting, and how we can continually improve our content.



Who We're Looking For



Someone who:

Has experience editing multi-camera podcasts, interviews, or conversational videos.

Is comfortable using professional editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, Descript, or similar.

Has a strong sense of storytelling, pacing, and visual presentation.

Can recognize compelling moments and turn longer conversations into engaging short-form content.

Has an eye for clean, professional design and consistent branding. Experience creating or improving visual assets is a plus, but not required.

Has strong English comprehension and communicates clearly.

Is organized, dependable, and comfortable managing projects independently.

Enjoys collaborating, sharing ideas, and learning along the way.

Experience with podcast publishing, episode descriptions, or managing a content release schedule is a plus, but not required.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone with great creative judgment.

We believe great editing isn't about adding more effects. It's about knowing what to keep, what to remove, and how to make a conversation feel effortless.



How We'll Work Together



We plan to release approximately one podcast episode per week, recording 3–4 episodes at a time.

You'll receive recordings in batches and help us maintain a consistent schedule for episode releases and accompanying social content.

We'll provide the raw footage, brand guidelines, existing graphics, and music that we're licensed to use. We'll use Google Drive to share files and manage deliverables.

You're welcome to use whichever professional editing software you're most comfortable with. You'll deliver finished videos, social clips, thumbnails, and organized, editable project files.

This is a remote, part-time opportunity with flexible working hours and the potential for a long-term creative partnership.

Compensation will be based on experience, portfolio, and scope of work.



Interested? We'd Love to Hear From You!



Please share:

A brief introduction about yourself and your video editing experience.

Your portfolio: Links to 2–3 podcasts, interviews, or conversational videos you've edited, ideally featuring multiple camera angles.

Social media examples: A few short-form clips you've created from longer videos.

Your rates: Your preferred compensation structure (hourly, per episode, or monthly).

Your turnaround time: How long you typically need to edit a 15–30 minute episode and create 3–5 accompanying social clips.



We'll invite a few shortlisted candidates to complete a paid editing test using sample footage from our podcast so we can get a feel for each other's working styles.

We're excited to find someone who takes pride in their craft, brings fresh ideas, and wants to become part of what we're building.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Event Designer
description:
About Innovate Marketing Group



Innovate Marketing Group is an experiential marketing and events agency creating meaningful brand experiences that bring people together. From corporate events and conferences to experiential activations, VIP experiences, and multi-city programs, our team manages the details that turn ideas into memorable experiences.



We believe great events come from great people, thoughtful planning, strong communication, and an obsession with delivering WOW service.

 

The Role



Innovate Marketing Group is seeking a creative, detail-oriented Event Designer to translate event concepts, client objectives, and brand identities into compelling visual experiences. 



This position will work closely with our account management and production teams to develop creative concepts, event layouts, visual presentations, branded environments, activations, stages, booths, signage, and other experiential elements. 



We are looking for someone who can balance creativity with real-world event execution. The ideal candidate understands that event design is not only about creating beautiful visuals - it also requires consideration of venue dimensions, budgets, materials, production capabilities, guest flow, brand guidelines, and client feedback. 



About You



You are a creative thinker who loves bringing ideas to life through thoughtful, visually compelling event design. You understand that great event design is not just about making something look beautiful—it is about creating an experience that supports the client’s goals, tells a story, and leaves a lasting impression on guests.



You thrive in a fast-paced event agency environment where multiple projects are moving at the same time, deadlines are tight, and creative direction can evolve quickly. You are comfortable shifting between projects, incorporating feedback, making revisions, and working within real-world timelines and budgets without losing sight of the creative vision.



You have a strong eye for design, scale, proportion, color, materials, branding, and spatial flow. When you receive a creative brief, you do not simply make something visually appealing. You think about how guests will enter the space, what they will see first, how they will move through the experience, where key brand moments should happen, and how every element works together.



You understand that event design also needs to be buildable and functional. A beautiful rendering is only successful if it can actually be produced. You consider venue restrictions, dimensions, fabrication methods, materials, installation requirements, guest capacity, accessibility, sightlines, traffic flow, and budget when developing your designs.



You are resourceful and solutions-oriented. If the initial creative direction is outside the budget, you do not simply remove elements—you think creatively about how to achieve a similar look and impact through different materials, finishes, rentals, layouts, or fabrication methods.



You are also a strong researcher. You look for inspiration, emerging event and design trends, materials, furniture, décor, fabrication techniques, experiential activations, and new ways brands are engaging their audiences. You know how to take inspiration and turn it into something original and appropriate for the client rather than simply recreating what has already been done.



You pay close attention to brand guidelines and understand how to translate a brand into a physical environment. You can take a client’s colors, typography, messaging, personality, and campaign creative and thoughtfully extend them across signage, stages, activations, décor, environmental graphics, and other event touchpoints while maintaining brand consistency.



You welcome feedback and understand that revisions are a normal part of the creative process. You do not become overly attached to one idea. You listen carefully to feedback from clients, Account Managers, vendors, and leadership, ask questions when something is unclear, and use that feedback to strengthen the design.



You are detail-oriented and take ownership of your work. Before submitting a deck, rendering, floor plan, or design file, you review it carefully for spelling, alignment, dimensions, branding, consistency, and overall presentation. You understand that even small mistakes can impact client confidence or create larger production issues later.



You are proactive about communication and follow-through. If you are missing dimensions, brand assets, venue information, or other details needed to complete your work, you ask for them early rather than waiting until the deadline. If you identify a potential production challenge, you flag it and help find a solution.



Most importantly, you genuinely enjoy transforming ideas into experiences. When you are doing your job well, the team can confidently present creative concepts that excite clients, differentiate IMG, can realistically be produced, and ultimately create memorable experiences for the people attending them.



Key Responsibilities 



Event Concept & Creative Development 

• Develop creative concepts and visual directions for corporate events, experiential activations, conferences, pop-ups, exhibits, and branded experiences. 

• Translate client briefs, objectives, and brand guidelines into cohesive event environments. 

• Create mood boards, inspiration boards, color palettes, and overall design directions. 

• Brainstorm creative event elements, installations, photo moments, stages, signage, displays, and guest experiences. 



Event Renderings & Layouts 



• Develop event renderings, floor plans, layouts, elevations, and visual mockups. 

• Create realistic representations of event spaces to help clients visualize proposed concepts. 

• Design stages, booths, registration areas, lounges, product displays, branded environments, and other event elements. 

• Revise designs efficiently based on client and internal team feedback. 



Presentation & Proposal Support 



• Create polished visual materials for client presentations, proposals, pitches, and RFP responses. 

• Work with the account team to ensure creative concepts align with the project's objectives, budget, venue, and production requirements. 

• Help communicate design concepts clearly through presentations and supporting visuals. 

Production Collaboration 

• Prepare artwork, specifications, dimensions, and other design information needed by production partners. 

• Collaborate with fabricators, printers, rental companies, and other vendors to ensure designs can be realistically produced. 

• Review proofs and production materials for visual accuracy. 

• Make design adjustments when required by venue, budget, timeline, or fabrication constraints. 



What Success Looks Like



• Creative concepts are visually compelling, thoughtful, and aligned with the client’s brand, objectives, audience, and overall event strategy.

• Account Managers can confidently present your creative work to clients with minimal revisions or cleanup. 

• Initial concepts and design drafts are delivered on time and allow enough time for internal review before client deadlines. 

• Renderings, floor plans, mood boards, and presentation decks clearly communicate the creative vision and help clients understand how the experience will come to life. 

• Designs are not only beautiful but also realistic, functional, and buildable within the approved budget, venue restrictions, timeline, and production requirements. 

• Client brand guidelines are consistently and accurately reflected across event environments, signage, stages, activations, décor, and other visual touchpoints. 

• Design files are organized, clearly labeled, current, and easy for the internal team and production partners to locate and understand. 

• Revisions are completed accurately and efficiently, with feedback incorporated thoroughly rather than requiring the same corrections multiple times. 

• Vendor and fabrication partners receive clear creative direction, dimensions, specifications, reference materials, and production-ready information when required. 

• Potential design, fabrication, spatial, budget, or production challenges are identified and communicated early. 

• You proactively provide creative solutions and alternatives when an original idea is not feasible due to budget, venue, timeline, or production limitations. 

• Your work consistently demonstrates strong attention to detail, including spelling, alignment, scale, dimensions, branding, finishes, materials, and overall presentation. 

• Account Managers trust that when a creative assignment is given to you, you will take ownership of it, communicate proactively, meet the deadline, and follow it through to completion. 

• Your creative work helps IMG deliver memorable experiences, strengthen client relationships, and win new business.



Qualifications



• 2+ years of professional experience in event design, experiential design, environmental design, spatial design, production design, or a related creative field required; 3–4 years strongly preferred.

• Prior experience designing for live events, experiential marketing activations, conferences, corporate events, brand experiences, trade shows, pop-ups, or similar environments strongly preferred.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating event, experiential, spatial, environmental, or related design work.

• Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including composition, color, typography, scale, proportion, hierarchy, materials, and spatial flow.

• Ability to translate a creative brief, client objective, or initial idea into a cohesive visual concept and physical experience.

• Ability to interpret floor plans, venue dimensions, measurements, and spatial requirements.

• Understanding of real-world event production considerations, including fabrication, rentals, materials, installation, venue restrictions, guest flow, sightlines, accessibility, and budget.

• Experience creating event renderings, floor plans, elevations, mood boards, presentation decks, environmental graphics, and other visual materials used to communicate creative concepts.

• Proficiency in relevant professional design and rendering software, such as Adobe Creative Suite, SketchUp, AutoCAD, Vectorworks, or comparable programs.

• Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and/or InDesign preferred.

• Experience with 3D modeling and rendering software strongly preferred.

• Proficiency with Canva preferred.

• Experience preparing or organizing production-ready artwork and files for printers, fabricators, signage vendors, and other production partners is a plus.

• Strong visual research skills and the ability to identify relevant trends, materials, furnishings, décor, fabrication techniques, and experiential inspiration.

• Strong understanding of branding and the ability to translate brand guidelines into physical environments and experiences.

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to reviewing work carefully before internal or client presentation.

• Comfortable receiving creative direction and feedback and making multiple rounds of revisions when necessary.

• Thrives in a fast-paced agency environment with changing priorities, tight deadlines, and multiple projects moving simultaneously.

• Strong organizational, time-management, and communication skills.

• Comfortable collaborating closely with Account Managers, production partners, vendors, fabricators, and other members of the creative team.

• Resourceful and solutions-oriented, with the ability to develop creative alternatives when budget, timing, venue, or production limitations affect the original concept.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment while staying highly communicative, responsive, and accountable.

• Comfortable learning and using project management, file-sharing, event, and agency technology platforms.

Our Core Values

WOW SERVICE: We are committed to great operations. Being accountable, a trusted advisor, and results oriented.

PROACTIVE: We are proactive to take the initiative to go above and beyond our job responsibilities. We are self-motivated and seek opportunities to make a positive impact.

FUN + ENGAGEMENT: We create a positive work environment that fosters associate and client satisfaction, engagement, creativity and productivity.

GROWTH: For IMG to grow, we must each learn and grow. We are humble and open to new ideas as our world is constantly growing.

INNOVATION: We are committed to a culture of innovation, forward thinking and adaptability, which can contribute to long-term success and growth.

COMMUNITY: We give our time and resources to support each other and our communities.

title: Buyers Agency Manager
description:
Role at a Glance

Position Title: Buyers Agency Manager

Team: Buyers Agency

Reports to: Chief Operations Officer, with a direct line to the Director on strategy

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time (40 hours per week). Starts part-time (20 hours per week) during training and probation, then moves to full-time.

Working hours: Monday to Friday, within Melbourne business hours (AEST/AEDT), including the weekly Buyers Agency meeting (Tuesday, 1:00 PM Melbourne)

Start date: As soon as possible



About Charlie Property

Charlie Property is an Australian property investment business led by Director Charles Corby. We buy, renovate and hold residential property with our money partners, and our Buyers Agency helps clients buy the right property. Our team works remotely across Australia, the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia, in Leadership, Marketing, Renovations, Buyers Agency, Acquisitions, and Finance and Admin.

We celebrate differences. We value different points of view, open communication and respectful debate, because better ideas come from people who think differently. We use AI tools and clear systems every day so the whole team can work smarter.



About the Role

This role owns the Buyers Agency: its team, its client journey and its growth. The person leads a team of four across Australia, Vietnam and Indonesia, makes sure every client moves from first call to settlement without anything falling through the cracks, and sets the strategies that win more clients and better deals. Good work here means clear ownership, steady conversion, and a Director who knows exactly where the Buyers Agency stands each week. This is a non-transacting role: the manager leads and coordinates, and does not act as the buyer's agent for clients.





Key Responsibilities

- Team leadership: Lead the Buyers Agency customer Success and sales team members. Hold a 30-minute one-on-one with each team member every week, set clear weekly priorities, and give feedback early and kindly.

- Weekly Buyers Agency meeting: Run the weekly meeting (Tuesday, 1:00 PM Melbourne), and make sure every action has one owner and a due date in ClickUp.

- Role ownership: Within the first 30 days, agree and document who owns each step of the client journey across Sales and Customer Success, then keep it up to date.

- Client journey and pipeline: Review the GoHighLevel pipeline at least twice a week, chase stuck clients, and make sure every new client comes in through the application form so automations fire.

- Buyers Agency strategy: Lead the strategy for client acquisition, agent relationships and off-market deal flow, including the stale-listing agent outreach, and present one improvement or test to the Director each month.

- Cross-team coordination: Be the single point of contact for Acquisitions (lead referrals), Marketing (landing pages and deal proposals) and Finance (commitment fees, invoicing and income reporting).

- SOPs and systems: Keep Buyers Agency SOPs current and improve them as the team learns, including the AML SOP and the client expectation-setting step.

- Compliance: Work with leadership to keep the team within real estate licensing rules, and make sure client-facing work that needs a license goes to a licensed person.

- Weekly report: Send the Director a short update every Friday: pipeline by stage, clients signed, deals presented, settlements, blockers and decisions needed.





What Success Looks Like

- Client journey ownership - Ownership of each client journey step agreed and documented, and all carried-over Buyers Agency actions closed or re-planned with an owner, by day 30

- Weekly reporting - Weekly update sent to the OPS Team every week

- Pipeline conversion - Clients ready to sign moved to contract, conversion tracked by stage in GoHighLevel, and agent outreach running daily across NSW, VIC and QLD





Skills and Experience

Must have

- Based in the Philippines

- Several years working in or managing a buyers agency in Australia, and 3 or more years in Australian residential property

- 3 or more years leading or coordinating a team, ideally remote or cross-cultural

- Understands investing strategies such as buy-and-hold, renovation and flipping

- Has run a sales or client pipeline with targets

- Confident with CRM and project tools such as GoHighLevel, ClickUp and Google Workspace, and able to own and fix them

- Clear, warm and direct communication

- Available full-time in Melbourne business hours (part-time during training and probation)





Nice to have

- Real estate license or Cert IV in Real Estate Practice

- Experience running a property education course or program

- Experience with RP Data (CoreLogic) or similar

- Uses AI tools in daily work





Tools You Will Use

ClickUp (tasks and projects), Slack (team chat), Google Workspace 
, documents and meetings), Jibble (time tracking), Claude (AI assistant), GoHighLevel, RP Data (CoreLogic), Webflow (deal proposals, via Marketing).





How We Work

- Remote first: We work across time zones, so we write things down and keep our tasks updated in ClickUp.

- Daily rhythm: Clock in with Jibble, join the daily AI Hour and send your EOD report before you log off.

- Weekly check-ins: Join the weekly all-hands meeting and a weekly 1:1 with your manager.

- Learning: Team coaching sessions, AI training and the chance to build systems that make work easier.





What We Offer

- Remote, full-time role within Melbourne business hours

- A part-time start during training and probation, so you can learn our systems before moving to full-time

- A daily AI Hour to learn and use AI tools at work

- Team coaching sessions with an external coach

- $ 8 - 10 USD hourly rate



How to Apply

Send the following through the job post before the closing date:

- Your CV or resume

- A short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself and telling us why you want this role

- Your answer to this question: Tell us about a time you took over a property or sales team where ownership was unclear and actions were slipping. What did you change first, and what happened?





Our hiring process

1. Application and video review

2. Interview with the Chief Operations Officer and Director

3. Paid trial task

4. Offer and onboarding

title: Senior Supply Chain & Demand Planner (Philippines)
description:
Senior Supply Chain & Demand Planner (Philippines)



Salary: USD 9.20 to 11.50 per hour, depending on experience (about USD 1,590 to 1,990 per month, full-time)

Hours: PH 13:00 to 22:00, Monday to Friday, all year. In the Netherlands that is 07:00 to 16:00 in summer time (end of March to end of October) and 06:00 to 15:00 in winter time. An afternoon and evening shift, not a graveyard shift.

Type: full-time, remote, long term

Benefits: 13th month bonus (pro rata), paid in the first week of December. HMO allowance of up to $75 per month, starting 4 months after your start date.



ABOUT VIBRIX

Vibrix is a Dutch brand for a healthy indoor climate. Our founder, Remco Lunshof, suffered from allergies and asthma for years. He tested air purifiers from the big brands, was not convinced, and in 2019 started Vibrix in Rijswijk (Netherlands) with one air purifier of his own. Johnny Ma joined as co-owner in 2023 and leads product development.



Today we sell air purifiers (PureFlow), dehumidifiers (DryFlow) and replacement filters to thousands of households through our own webshop, Bol and Amazon. We test every model ourselves before it goes on sale, customers get an answer from a real person every day, and we are rated 4.6 out of 5 on Trustpilot from more than 3,200 reviews. Our products are made by partner factories in China, and we now receive full 40HQ containers every month.



Our mission: healthy air in every home, in every season. We want to grow from the Netherlands and Belgium to more European countries, and over the next 12 to 18 months we are building a team of experienced people, most of them in the Philippines.



See who we are on our website: vibrix . nl (type it without the spaces)



You will work directly with the owners, Remco and Johnny, and with our new Team Lead.



THE ROLE

You own the question: how much do we need to buy, and when? You build the forecast, plan the purchase orders and make sure our best-selling products stay in stock.



Your first goal is a demand forecast per SKU that we can trust and run every month.



After a year, success looks like this:

• The forecast per SKU is within 25% of actual sales, 3 months ahead (MAPE).

• Our top 10 SKUs are out of stock on less than 5% of days.

• The purchasing rhythm with our suppliers in China runs without the owner stepping in.



WHAT WE ASK

• At least 3 years of proven experience in this role, at a B2C e-commerce brand in consumer electronics or home appliances with USD 5 to 20M yearly revenue. That is the revenue of your employer itself, not of a client or a parent company. Tell us the brand and its yearly revenue, with currency.

• Experience only at large corporations, Amazon aggregators, companies with many brands or B2B companies is not what we are looking for. What counts is experience at one brand that sells electrical appliances or consumer electronics online to consumers, for example air purifiers, heaters, fans, kitchen or personal care appliances.

• At least 3 years of experience in supply chain or demand planning, for e-commerce or consumer products.

• You have built a demand forecast per SKU yourself.

• In-house or agency experience, not only freelance or task-based work.

• This is your only job.

• Certificate of Employment from your last two employers. We check your years of experience with it.

• At least 15 Mbps download speed, measured on the computer and at the place you will work from. The form asks for the link to your speedtest.net result.

• A laptop with 8 GB RAM and a good headset.



Nice to have: experience placing purchase orders with suppliers in China.



We are looking for someone who knows more than we do about forecasting and inventory. You learn fast, figure things out yourself and want to grow with the company.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

• Not a data entry or admin role.

• Not a role where someone else builds the model and you update it.

• Not a graveyard shift.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Apply ONLY through our application form. Messages and applications through the OnlineJobs.ph system will not be read.

2. Form: type this in your browser without the spaces: docs . google . com / forms / d / e / 1FAIpQLSfEmp9gYqXiU8kYh6C0rDnSXgUOiIxleLtEb7JCtbglM4Rskg / viewform

3. When applying, use 10 Apply Points.

4. Code word: anchor. You need it to complete the form, so read the full post.

title: PART-TIME B2B LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST / COLD CALLER

We're looking for a motivated and confident individual to help us find potential business customers across Australia, particularly in Victoria.



### What You'll Do:

title: Creative Strategist & Video Editor (DTC Jewelry Brand, Meta Ads)
description:
We are a jewelry brand (earrings, ear piercing jewelry, DTC on Shopify). Most of our sales come from Meta ads 
 and Instagram). We are looking for a Creative Strategist who can also edit videos.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

You find the ideas that sell, you write them, and you turn them into ads.



WHAT YOU WILL DO (BY HAND, WITH YOUR BRAIN)

This is the core of the role and we do NOT want it done by AI:

- Find angles: why would a woman buy this earring today? (gift, self-reward, ear stack, everyday wear, trend...)

- Write hooks: the first 2 seconds that stop the scroll

- Build concepts and scripts for video ads (UGC style, before/after, unboxing, "3 ways to wear", listicle...)

- Write ad copy: primary text, headlines, on-screen text

- Study what works: our winning ads, our competitors' ads (Meta Ad Library, TikTok), customer reviews and comments

- Read the numbers every week (hook rate, CTR, cost per purchase) and decide what to test next



WHAT YOU WILL ALSO DO

- Edit short video ads (9:16, 15 to 45 seconds) from raw footage: influencer videos, product shots, AI-generated clips

- Make variations fast: same video, 5 different hooks

- Use Claude Code to save time on everything that is NOT the creative work: organizing files, renaming, batch exports, pulling data, building small tools



YOU ARE A FIT IF

- You have 2+ years making ads that sold, for a DTC brand (fashion, beauty, jewelry = big plus). Show us.

- You can explain WHY an ad works, not just that it looks nice

- You edit fast and clean (or use very well AI)

- You already use Claude Code (or are very comfortable with AI tools and the terminal) and you know where AI helps and where it makes things generic

- You write excellent English

- You understand women 25 to 45 who buy jewelry for themselves or as a gift



WE OFFER

- Full-time, long-term, remote

- A small team that moves fast: your ideas go live within days and you see the results

- Paid in USD, on time, every month

- Base pay 700 to 1,000 USD per month depending on experience



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the word "EARSTACK" (we skip applications without it)

2. Send 3 to 5 ads you made, with one line on each: the angle, and the result if you know it

3. Write 3 hooks for this product: "a gold huggie earring, waterproof, 29 euros, sold as a gift"

4. Tell us in 2 lines how you use Claude Code today



Short and specific answers win. We read every application.

title: Part-Time Medical VA / Patient Care Coordinator – Calls, Scheduling & Chart Prep – U.S. Podiatry Practice
description:
We are a busy U.S. podiatry and sports medicine practice looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Patient Care Coordinator (Medical Virtual Assistant) for a part-time shift. This is a long-term role working alongside our VA and in-office team. You will handle patient calls, scheduling, chart preparation and follow-through so nothing is left open at the end of your shift.



SCHEDULE

Monday–Friday, 25 hours/week (5-hour shift) during U.S. Eastern Time business hours, between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM ET. The exact shift will be set at hiring. Please tell us which hours you are available.



PAY

$5–$6.50 USD/hour to start, based on experience. Paid training. Performance and pay review at 90 days.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Patient calls and scheduling

- Answer patient calls and return voi
s the same day

- Schedule, reschedule, cancel and confirm appointments in DrChrono following our scheduling rules

- Call new patients and web inquiries to schedule

- Confirm upcoming appointments and fill openings from the waitlist

-
 and text patients as needed

- Log every call and patient message in the EHR and our task tracker



2. New-patient intake

- Collect full legal name, date of birth, phone, insurance and reason for visit on every new-patient call

- Send intake forms through IntakeQ and follow up until they are completed

- Download completed paperwork and file it in the correct chart



3. Chart preparation

- Review the upcoming schedule and prepare charts before each visit

- Enter medications, allergies, insurance and demographics from intake forms

- Flag missing paperwork, referrals or insurance information before the patient arrives



4. Medical records and documents

- Retrieve faxes from RingCentral and DrChrono and upload them to the correct chart

- Upload
ed documents and route items that need the doctor's signature

- Request and follow up on records, imaging reports and referrals



5. Doctor requests and follow-through

- Send medication refill requests and clinical questions to the doctor the same day

- Escalate doctor-to-doctor calls and urgent clinical calls immediately

- Call patients back with the doctor's instructions before your shift ends

- Keep every task updated until it is fully resolved, not just forwarded

- Send an accurate end-of-shift report of completed and open items





REQUIREMENTS

- 1+ year answering patient calls and scheduling for a U.S. medical office or as a medical VA

- Clear, natural spoken English and strong written English

- EHR experience (DrChrono, RingCentral, IntakeQ and Google Workspace are a plus)

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently

- Reliable internet with backup power, a quiet workspace and HIPAA awareness

- Podiatry, orthopedics or sports medicine experience is a plus



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with "PART-TIME PATIENT CARE" and include:

1. Your résumé and desired hourly rate

2. The U.S. Eastern Time hours you are available Monday–Friday (morning, afternoon or both)

3. The EHR and phone systems you have used

4. Whether you have experience with prior authorizations, MRI precertifications or billing

5. A 3–5 minute voice recording answering these questions in your own words:



   a) A new patient calls with heel pain and only gives her first name, "Shelly." Walk me through everything you collect before you end the call, and what you do in the system afterward.



   b) A patient calls saying she is running low on her nerve pain medication and needs a refill. What do you do, and by when?



   c) The doctor answers three patient questions you sent her earlier, and your shift ends in two hours. What happens next?



   d) Two lines ring at once, and you already have three voi
s waiting. How do you handle it so no one falls through the cracks?



   Applications without the voice recording will not be considered. Please do not read a script or use AI-generated answers. We want to hear how you naturally communicate and solve problems.



Finalists will complete a live interview on Google Meet (camera on), followed by a paid 2-week trial period working real shifts with our team. The trial is paid at the agreed hourly rate, and successful candidates will move into the long-term role.

title: Sales & Partnerships Virtual Assistant

# Sales & Partnerships Virtual Assistant | B2B Sales & Closing Experience Required

**Location:** Philippines (Remote)  

**Schedule:** Flexible, with availability during U.S. Central Time business hours

## About The Bourg



The Bourg is a growing U.S.-based community platform helping women find their people and build their village.



We connect women through local events, shared experiences, and opportunities to discover and support businesses in the communities they call home.



What began as a local women's community in Richmond, Texas, is growing into a platform connecting women, businesses, and neighborhoods.



Learn more about us: 



## About the Role



We're looking for a confident, experienced, and results-driven Sales & Partnerships Virtual Assistant to help grow our business partnerships.



**This is a sales-first role. We're looking for someone who can close deals, not just schedule appointments.**



You'll be responsible for finding potential business partners, making outbound calls, understanding their business goals, presenting relevant partnership opportunities, and closing sales.



You'll also manage existing partner relationships, handle renewals, and identify opportunities to expand those partnerships.



We want someone who enjoys talking to people, communicates naturally, follows through consistently, and can independently manage the sales process from beginning to end.



## What You'll Be Selling



The Bourg offers several ways for local businesses to connect with our community:



- **Business Directory Listings:** Paid listings on our community platform, available in three-month and annual packages.

- **Membership Sponsorships:** Opportunities for businesses to sponsor community memberships.

- **Event Sponsorships:** Opportunities for businesses to sponsor local events and experiences.

- **Hosted Experiences:** Partnerships that bring community members into local businesses through events, classes, and other experiences.



Your job is to understand what each business wants to accomplish and recommend the right opportunity.



## Key Responsibilities



- Research and identify prospective business partners in targeted U.S. communities.

- Make outbound sales calls and conduct personalized
 outreach.

- Build relationships with business owners and decision-makers.

- Ask thoughtful discovery questions to understand business needs.

- Present partnership opportunities and clearly communicate their value.

- Handle objections, negotiate within approved guidelines, and independently close deals.

- Identify opportunities to upsell businesses into additional partnership offerings.

- Manage existing partner relationships, including ongoing communication, renewals, and satisfaction.

- Draft professional outreach
s, follow-ups, and partnership proposals.

- Maintain accurate records of leads, conversations, and sales activity in our CRM.

- Provide weekly updates on outreach activity, pipeline progress, and closed partnerships.



## Qualifications



- At least 2 years of experience in outbound B2B sales, business development, or a related sales role.

- Proven experience personally closing sales.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Experience communicating with U.S. businesses or customers.

- Strong listening, negotiation, and objection-handling skills.

- Ability to build rapport and communicate confidently over the phone.

- Strong organizational skills and consistent follow-through.

- Experience using CRM software and virtual communication tools.

- Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of results.



Experience selling sponsorships, advertising, memberships, marketing services, or similar offerings is a plus.



## Compensation & Schedule



- $7–$10 USD per hour, depending on experience.

- Starting at approximately 20 hours per week, with opportunities to increase to 40.

- Flexible schedule with availability during U.S. Central Time business hours.

- 30-day paid trial period.

- Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. company.



## How to Apply



We believe the best way to evaluate a salesperson is to experience how they sell.



**To be considered, please complete all three parts of the application.**



### Part 1: Tell Us About Your Experience



Please include the following in your application:



1. Describe your B2B sales experience. What products or services have you sold, and were you personally responsible for closing deals?

2. Tell us about a sale you're particularly proud of. What challenges or objections did you overcome?

3. What experience do you have making outbound calls to U.S. businesses?

4. What is your preferred hourly rate within our $7–$10 range?

5. What is your availability during U.S. Central Time business hours?



### Part 2: Loom Video Sales Simulation (3–5 Minutes)



Before recording, visit 
 to learn about our company and mission.



**Your scenario:**



Imagine you're calling the owner of a wellness studio in Richmond, Texas, for the first time.



The studio offers yoga, Pilates, and wellness classes. The owner wants to attract more local customers but has never heard of The Bourg.



Your goal is to introduce The Bourg, build rapport, ask questions to understand the owner's needs, and create interest in a potential business partnership.



The Bourg offers businesses opportunities to gain visibility through directory listings, sponsor community memberships, and host or sponsor local experiences.



**During the conversation, the business owner says:**



"We already spend money on advertising. I'm not sure we need another marketing expense."



Demonstrate how you would respond and move the conversation forward.



You may have someone play the business owner or simulate both sides of the conversation yourself.



We're not looking for a memorized script. We want to hear how you naturally communicate, ask questions, handle objections, and create opportunities.



**Recording instructions:**



- Record a 3–5 minute video using Loom.

- Your camera and microphone should be enabled.

- Make sure your audio is clear.

- Set your video permissions so anyone with the link can view it.

- Include your Loom link directly in your OnlineJobs.ph application.



### Part 3: Written
 Exercise



Imagine you just finished speaking with the wellness studio owner.



The owner expressed interest in learning more about The Bourg but asked you to send additional information.



**Your assignment:**



Write a short follow-up
 that:



- References the conversation naturally.

- Explains how The Bourg could help the business reach its goals.

- Introduces a relevant partnership opportunity.

- Encourages a clear next step.



Include your
 directly in your application.



## Final Submission Instructions



Your OnlineJobs.ph application should include:



1. Your B2B sales experience and answers to the five questions.

2. A viewable Loom video link.

3. Your sample follow-up
.



**Applications missing the Loom video or written exercise will not be considered.**



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a live interview and sales role-play.



We're looking for someone who can become a trusted member of our team, confidently represent The Bourg, build meaningful business relationships, and help turn opportunities into revenue.

- You can tell on a call whether a profile is fundable today or needs work first.

- Applicants without recent funding experience will not be considered.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Work new leads from Slack and GoHighLevel and keep them in the right pipeline stage.

- Schedule and confirm qualification calls; follow up with no-shows, reschedules and undecided prospects.

- Review authorized credit reports with prospects and confirm business details, revenue, time in business and funding goals.

- Qualify against our criteria and today's lender requirements, and escalate borderline files.

- Explain the service, fee, agreement and next steps clearly, without guaranteeing outcomes or timelines.

- Help qualified clients sign the agreement and pay through our approved systems.

- Complete intake records and hand off clean files to the Funding Specialist.

- Post daily calls, qualified leads, closes and collected fees in Slack.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English and strong phone and Zoom skills with U.S. clients.

- Recent business funding qualification or sales closing experience.

- Ability to read credit reports accurately and follow qualification criteria without guessing.

- Strong GoHighLevel skills (contacts, pipelines, follow-up workflows), plus Slack, Zoom and e-sign/payment links.

- Professional objection handling and organized follow-through.

- Full-time availability overlapping U.S. business hours (Eastern time).



COMMISSION

On top of base pay, you earn 0.25% of the funding secured for each client you bring in who gets funded (e.g. $10,000 funded = $25 extra).



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these will not be reviewed)

1. Subject line: FUNDING QUALIFIER - [Your Full Name]

2. Your resume and your most recent business funding role (company type, dates, what you did).

3. A prospect has a 690 score, 45% utilization, 6 inquiries in the last 6 months and an LLC that is 4 months old. Do they qualify for funding today? Explain why and what you would tell them.

4. How you handle a prospect who wants funding but is hesitant to pay the fee.

5. Your availability, time zone and start date.

title: Local SEO and Google Ads Specialist
description:
Experienced Professionals Only

I'm looking for someone who already knows exactly how to rank local service businesses on Google and can get results without training or hand holding. If you're new to local SEO or Google Ads, this role is not for you.



Job Title: Local SEO and Google Ads Specialist (Remote)



About Us

Delaware Valley AI is a US agency serving local service businesses like HVAC, plumbing, roofing, landscaping, towing, detailing and moving companies on the East Coast. I handle sales and client relationships. You run everything Google related on the back end.



What You Will Do



 1. Fully optimize and manage Google Business Profiles, including categories, services, service areas, photos, weekly posts, Q&A and review growth.

 2. Rank clients in the Google Map Pack and organic results for their service and city keywords.

 3. Build and clean up citations and keep business info consistent across directories.

 4. Build and optimize fast, mobile friendly websites with service pages and city pages.

 5. Handle on page SEO, including titles, meta descriptions, headers, schema, internal linking and page speed.

 6. Set up and manage Google Ads and Local Services Ads, including keyword research, negative keywords, ad copy, conversion tracking and budget management.

 7. Track rankings, calls and leads, and send a simple monthly report for each client.

 8. Spot problems early, like suspended profiles, dropped rankings or wasted ad spend, and fix them.



What You Must Already Know



 1. A proven process for ranking local businesses in the Map Pack.

 2. How to set up and manage Google Ads campaigns for lead generation.

 3. How to get Google Business Profiles verified and reinstated.

 4. How to set up Google Analytics, Search Console and conversion tracking.

 5. How to build and optimize websites for local search.



Requirements



 1. At least 3 years of hands-on experience in local SEO and Google Ads.

 2. A portfolio with real results, like ranking screenshots, before and after examples or campaign stats.

 3. Experience with US clients, ideally home service businesses.

 4. Strong written English.

 5. Able to work independently, manage several clients at once and hit deadlines.

 6. Available for some overlap with US Eastern Time.



Tools

I'm not tied to any specific software. If you already have tools you like and trust for rankings, citations, reporting or site building, tell me about them. I care about results, not the tool.



Pay

$6 to $10 per hour, depending on experience and proven results. Long-term work and room to grow as we add clients.



How to Apply



 1. Send your portfolio and 2 or 3 examples of local businesses you've ranked.

 2. In a few sentences, tell me the first 5 things you would do for a new plumbing company that isn't showing up on Google Maps.

 3. List the tools you use and why.



The plumbing question in step 2 is a quick way to weed people out, since experienced specialists will give a clear plan right away.

title: Amazon Specialist
description:
As an Amazon Specialist, you will be responsible for managing, optimizing, and scaling our clients' Amazon storefronts and product catalogs. Working closely with our Account Executives, Copywriters, and Creative Designers, you will ensure every ASIN is fully optimized for search visibility and conversion while keeping account health, inventory, and advertising performance running smoothly.



Key Responsibilities

Catalog & Listing Optimization (Amazon SEO): Create, audit, and optimize product listings—including titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and variation structures—using keyword research and competitor insights to maximize organic rankings and click-through rates (CTR).



A+ Content & Brand Store Management: Coordinate and upload high-converting A+ Content (EBC / Premium A+) modules and manage multi-page Amazon Brand Stores in collaboration with our creative and copy teams.



Amazon Advertising (PPC) Support & Execution: Assist in setting up, monitoring, and optimizing Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns—tracking ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, and keyword bids to maximize ad efficiency.



Account Health & Troubleshooting: Proactively monitor Seller Central performance metrics, policy notifications, pricing/Buy Box status, and suppressed listings; open and follow up on Seller Support and Brand Registry cases until resolved.



Inventory & Promotions Coordination: Track FBA stock levels to prevent stockouts, flag restock alerts, and set up promotional calendars (Coupons, Prime Exclusive Discounts, Lightning Deals, and seasonal events).



Reporting & Analytics: Pull weekly and monthly performance reports covering sales, traffic, unit session percentage (conversion rate), and ad spend, translating raw data into clear, actionable insights for Account Executives and U.S.-based clients.



Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts, ideally within an e-commerce agency or DTC brand environment (experience in beauty, skincare, wellness, or luxury is a strong plus).



Platform Mastery: Deep familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, Brand Registry, flat-file bulk uploads, variation troubleshooting, and Amazon’s compliance guidelines.



Amazon SEO & Tools: Proficiency with Amazon research and analytics tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Keepa, or DataDive.



PPC Fundamentals: Solid understanding of Amazon Ads campaign structures, keyword harvesting, and performance metrics (ACOS, TACOS, CTR, CVR).



Analytical & Spreadsheet Skills: Comfortable working with Excel / Google Sheets for catalog audits, flat files, and performance tracking.



English Proficiency: Fluent/Advanced English (written and spoken) for writing compliant copy, handling Seller Support cases, and collaborating seamlessly with internal teams and clients.



Schedule & Mindset: Full availability during PST business hours (8:30 AM – 4:30 PM PST), strong attention to detail, and proactive problem-solving skills in a fast-paced remote agency.



Nice-to-Haves

Experience with Amazon Vendor Central or Amazon DSP.



Familiarity with project management tools such as ClickUp, Notion, Asana, or Airtable.



Experience managing cross-channel marketplaces (e.g., Walmart Marketplace, TikTok Shop) or Shopify integrations.



What We Offer

100% Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere with a collaborative, creative, and international agency team.



Long-Term Growth: A stable, full-time position with clear opportunities for career advancement as our e-commerce division expands.



Standout Brand Roster: Work hands-on with exciting, design-first brands in beauty, wellness, and lifestyle.

title: Social Media Content Strategist / Creative Director
description:
About Us



We're a growing Houston, Texas-based creative agency specializing in cinematic automotive content and short-form social media marketing.



We partner with automotive dealerships to create engaging, high-quality videos that showcase vehicles, build brand awareness, and connect businesses with potential customers.



We're building a creative team and looking for someone who understands what makes content successful on social media.



We're not simply looking for someone to schedule posts. We want someone who can analyze performance, identify opportunities, develop creative ideas, and help guide our content strategy.



Your Role



You'll serve as the creative strategist behind our social media content.



You'll work directly with our videographer and video editor to plan content, develop engaging concepts, identify emerging trends, and continuously improve performance based on real analytics.



Your primary responsibility will be determining what content we should create and why.



Key Responsibilities



Content Strategy & Planning



Develop weekly and monthly content calendars for multiple automotive dealerships.



Research and propose creative video concepts tailored to each dealership's audience and brand.



Create attention-grabbing hooks, video outlines, and short-form scripts.



Plan a variety of content, including cinematic vehicle showcases, salesperson features, dealership promotions, educational videos, and trend-based content.



Provide clear creative briefs and shot lists for our videographer and editor.



Help maintain a consistent brand identity for each client.



Social Media Trends & Research



Monitor emerging trends on Instagram, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts.



Identify trending audio, music, editing styles, and video formats.



Recommend creative ways to adapt trends for automotive dealership content.



Research successful automotive creators, dealerships, and competing brands.



Identify content opportunities before trends become oversaturated.



Ensure recommended audio and music are appropriate for commercial business accounts and licensed use.



Analytics & Performance



Review social media performance metrics, including views, reach, engagement, watch time, audience retention, shares, saves, and follower growth.



Identify which content formats, hooks, and creative approaches perform best.



Analyze underperforming posts and recommend improvements.



Prepare concise weekly performance summaries and monthly reports.



Use performance data to guide future content decisions.



Track content experiments and recommend new strategies to improve results.



Creative Direction & Team Collaboration



Communicate creative direction to the videographer and video editor.



Review completed videos and provide feedback before publishing.



Recommend improvements to pacing, storytelling, hooks, captions, and overall engagement.



Help organize and manage the content production calendar.



Coordinate publishing schedules and ensure deliverables are completed on time.



Maintain a library of content ideas, successful hooks, trends, and creative references.



Requirements



At least 2 years of experience in social media content strategy, creative planning, or social media marketing.



Proven experience developing successful short-form video content.



Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



Ability to interpret social media analytics and translate insights into actionable content ideas.



Experience creating content calendars, video concepts, and short-form scripts.



Strong understanding of viral hooks, storytelling, audience retention, and viewer engagement.



Familiarity with trending music, audio, and social media content formats.



Strong written and spoken English communication skills.



Ability to work independently, stay organized, and meet deadlines.



Experience using Google Sheets, Notion, Trello, or similar planning tools.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with automotive dealerships, luxury brands, or automotive content creators.



Experience managing content strategy for multiple business accounts.



Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, Instagram Insights, TikTok Analytics, and YouTube Studio.



Understanding of U.S. consumer audiences and social media trends.



Experience creating scripts, storyboards, and production briefs.



Familiarity with AI-assisted research and content planning tools.



What We're Looking For



We want someone who is proactive, creative, analytical, and genuinely interested in social media.



Someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do but regularly comes to the team with new ideas, emerging trends, and opportunities to improve our content.



You should be comfortable answering questions like:



Why did one video receive 50,000 views while another received 500?



What could we change about the first three seconds to improve viewer retention?



Which trending content formats could work for a luxury automotive dealership?



What should we film next week based on our recent performance?



How can we turn a successful video concept into a repeatable content series?



We value creativity, initiative, and measurable improvement over simply posting content for the sake of posting.



What We Offer



Flexible remote working schedule.



Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S.-based creative business.



Opportunity to influence the creative direction of multiple automotive brands.



Collaborative environment working with a videographer and video editor.



Potential for increased hours, compensation, and leadership responsibilities as the company expands.

title: Events Administrator
description:
About Innovate Marketing Group



Innovate Marketing Group is an experiential marketing and events agency creating meaningful brand experiences that bring people together. From corporate events and conferences to experiential activations, VIP experiences, and multi-city programs, our team manages the details that turn ideas into memorable experiences.

We believe great events come from great people, thoughtful planning, strong communication, and an obsession with delivering WOW service.



The Role



The Event Administrator provides administrative, research, and project coordination support to our Accounts Department.



The primary goal of this position is simple: take ownership of repeatable, time-consuming, and process-driven work so our Account Managers can spend more time with clients, solving problems, making strategic decisions, and growing accounts.



This person will help keep projects organized, conduct initial vendor and venue research, maintain project documentation, support proposals, track outstanding items, and make sure important administrative details do not fall through the cracks.



This is not a client account management position. It is a support role designed for someone who is highly organized, resourceful, responsive, and excellent at following through.



About You



You take pride in making sure the department is organized and operations flow seamlessly. Your zone of genius is bringing order to complexity and finding ways to make processes more efficient. You naturally notice when something could be organized better, simplified, documented, or improved.



We work in a fast-paced event agency environment where multiple projects are moving at the same time, deadlines are real, and priorities can shift quickly. You will need to be comfortable managing several requests at once while staying organized, calm, responsive, and detail-oriented.



You do not just complete tasks. You think about how the work gets done. If you see the team repeating the same manual process over and over, you look for a better way. If information is difficult to find, you organize it. If a process is unclear, you help document it. If something is falling through the cracks, you create a system to prevent it from happening again.



You genuinely enjoy being the person behind the scenes who helps the entire department operate better.



You understand events and thrive in a fast-paced environment where multiple projects are moving at once, deadlines are tight, and priorities can change quickly. You know how to shift gears while staying organized, calm, and focused on the details that matter.



You are also a strong researcher. If an Account Manager asks you to research five venues, you understand that sending five website links is not enough. You gather the information needed to make a decision, including availability, capacity, location, pricing, restrictions, included services, and other important event considerations.



You are proactive about follow-through. When you are waiting on a quote, COI, W-9, contract, or answer from a vendor, you follow up without needing to be reminded.



You understand that small details can become large event problems. You take pride in being someone the team can trust to keep information organized, accurate, and moving forward.



Most importantly, you enjoy helping others work more efficiently. When you are doing your job well, Account Managers have more time to focus on their clients, solve problems, think strategically, and grow their accounts.



What You Will Own



Accounts Department Administration

Help keep the Accounts Department organized and operating consistently across projects.

• Create new project folders in Dropbox using established folder structures.

• Manage and maintain account and project folders in Dropbox, ensuring files are organized, current, and easy for the team to access.

• Archive, remove, and maintain project folders as needed.

• Maintain organized project documentation and file naming.

• Support contract administration and document organization.

• Maintain and update the agency's vendor database and vendor lists.

• Organize and maintain department SOPs, templates, and process documents.

• Help ensure teams are using the most current versions of templates and documents.

• Serve as the administrative owner of assigned department perks, policies, trackers, or recurring processes.

• Identify missing information or outstanding administrative items and follow up without waiting to be asked.

• Support new client, project, and vendor onboarding processes.

• Coordinate and track Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and other required event documentation.

• Maintain project trackers, timelines, contact lists, and administrative records.

• Assist with data entry, document preparation, scheduling, and other administrative needs.

• Help ensure project information is accurately documented and communicated internally



Goal: Create consistent administrative systems so Account Managers do not have to spend their time maintaining them.



Vendor Research & Event Logistics Support



Take the first pass at research and coordination work that can consume significant Account Manager time.

• Research venues and vendors based on project requirements.

• Research restaurants, transportation, gifting, entertainment, staffing, rentals, and other event needs.

• Research venues, caterers, rental companies, entertainment, production partners, promotional vendors, and other event resources.

• Request and organize vendor quotes, pricing, availability, and capabilities.

• Follow up with vendors and partners to obtain outstanding information and documentation.

• Gather quotes and supporting information.

• Build organized vendor and venue comparison sheets.

• Assist with vendor onboarding.

• Collect and organize Certificates of Insurance (COIs), W-9s, contracts, menus, specifications, and other required documents.

• Track vendor confirmations, deadlines, and deliverables.

• Follow up on missing vendor information and documentation.

• Assist with shipping, receiving, and inventory tracking.

• Maintain organized vendor information for future agency use.

• Flag incomplete information, missed deadlines, pricing changes, or other potential issues to the appropriate Account Manager.

• Create vendor comparison documents and research summaries.

• Assist with tracking event logistics, including shipping, deliveries, rentals, load-in/load-out, staffing, and vendor requirements.



Goal: Account Managers should be reviewing options and making decisions rather than spending hours gathering basic information.



Project & Administrative Coordination



Keep every assigned project organized and moving.

• Update project timelines, task lists, and trackers.

• Track deadlines and outstanding items.

• Follow up with internal team members and vendors on assigned deliverables.

• Schedule internal, client, and vendor meetings.

• Assist with meeting preparation, notes, recaps, and follow-up items.

• Take clear meeting notes and document next steps.

• Assign and track action items based on meeting direction.

• Organize project folders, decks, contracts, budgets, and event documents.

• Maintain project contact lists.

• Maintain event and project calendars.

• Assist with guest lists, registration information, and attendee data when needed.

• Help prepare event documents such as production schedules, staffing information, and run-of-show documents.

• Proactively identify missing information or upcoming deadlines and follow up as needed.

• Support Account Managers with day-to-day project coordination.

• Help maintain project information and updates within company systems.



Goal: Nothing falls through the cracks.



Proposal & Deck Support



Support the Accounts and Sales teams with the research and administrative work required to develop strong proposals.

• Review notes from sales and discovery calls.

• Pull key information from call notes and organize it into an initial proposal framework.

• Draft initial proposal documents for Account Manager review.

• Research vendors, venues, products, and event elements required for proposals.

• Request preliminary quotes and pricing.

• Prepare venue selection decks.

• Prepare initial event scope documents.

• Build vendor and venue comparison documents.

• Organize photos, specifications, pricing, and supporting materials.

• Update existing proposal templates.

• Organize and maintain proposal templates in Canva, Dropbox, and other agency systems.

• Check proposals for missing information, inconsistent formatting, outdated information, or incomplete sections before Account Manager review.



The Event Administrator prepares the first pass. The Account Manager remains responsible for strategy, recommendations, final pricing, client communication, and final approval.



Goal: Give Account Managers a strong starting point instead of requiring them to build every proposal and research document from scratch.



Contract & Documentation Support

• Organize client and vendor contracts.

• Track contract status and outstanding signatures.

• Maintain current versions of contracts and related documents.

• Collect required vendor documentation.

• Maintain COI records and follow up on missing or incorrect certificates.

• Collect and organize W-9s.

• Maintain menus, venue specifications, vendor specifications, and other project documents.

• Flag missing documentation before project deadlines.

• Support project closeout and document archiving.



Shipping & Inventory Support

• Create and maintain shipping trackers.

• Track shipments and delivery status.

• Maintain inventory lists for assigned projects.

• Confirm delivery addresses and receiving instructions.

• Organize tracking numbers and shipping documentation.

• Follow up on delayed or missing shipments.

• Flag shipping issues immediately to the appropriate project owner.



What This Role Does NOT Own



To keep responsibilities clear, the Event Administrator supports the work but does not replace the Account Manager or Event Manager.

• Client relationship management.

• Event strategy and creative direction.

title: Bookkeeping & Accounts Payable VA — Part-Time — $100/Week
description:
Beach Front Mechanical is an HVAC and mechanical contracting company in San Diego, California. We are hiring a detail-oriented bookkeeping assistant to organize receipts, track supplier bills, and keep material costs assigned to the correct jobs.



PAY AND SCHEDULE

US$100 per week for 10 hours of work, paid weekly. Approximately two hours per day, Monday-Friday, on an agreed schedule with some availability for Pacific Time check-ins. Additional hours require advance agreement on hours and pay.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Organize our receipt and invoice backlog, then keep new records current.

- File receipts, supplier invoices, credit memos, and payment confirmations.

- Enter expenses in Beach Front Pro and supporting spreadsheets, recording the vendor, date, invoice number, amount, tax, category, payment status, and job reference when available.

- Match receipts and invoices to provided transaction records, identify duplicates, and distinguish paid purchases from unpaid bills.

- Maintain an accounts-payable tracker showing due dates, partial payments, credits, outstanding balances, and overdue items.

- Check supplier statements against company records and flag discrepancies.

- Assign material purchases to the correct job and track returns, refunds, and supplier credits.

- Prepare a weekly bill-payment list for the owner's review and organized records for the company's accountant.



FIRST PRIORITIES AND REPORTING

Assess the backlog and propose a realistic catch-up schedule within the agreed hours. Each Friday, report receipts processed, backlog remaining, overdue bills, bills due within 14 days, pending credits, and missing information.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least one year of bookkeeping, accounts payable, or accounting assistant experience.

- Strong spreadsheet skills, written English, and attention to detail.

- Experience matching receipts, reconciling assigned records, and identifying duplicate charges.

- A reliable computer, dependable internet, and consistent communication.

- U.S. contractor experience and QuickBooks familiarity are helpful. We provide training on Beach Front Pro and our procedures.



The owner approves and releases supplier payments. This role prepares and maintains supporting records; accounting and tax decisions remain with the owner and accountant.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject “Beach Front Bookkeeping Assistant” and include:

1. Your resume and a short summary of bookkeeping/accounts-payable experience.

2. The bookkeeping programs and spreadsheet tools you have used.

3. Your availability and confirmation that US$100 per week for 10 hours works for you.

4. Your answer to this scenario: You receive 100 mixed receipts and supplier invoices. How would you organize them, identify items already paid, and avoid duplicate entries?

5. How you would handle a purchase that cannot be matched to a job.



Use fictional information for examples. Do not send confidential financial records from a previous employer.
