title: Marketing Strategist with Xero & Admin Support | Full Time | for Premium Home Builder
description:
OVERVIEW

Can you make a premium builder impossible to ignore, for the right clients, and keep the business running smoothly behind the scenes? Build Prestige Homes is a design and construct builder of premium custom homes based in Brisbane, Australia, and we are looking for an expert Marketing Strategist who can also take care of our Xero bookkeeping and administration.



Marketing is the main focus of the role. We have award-winning residences, a strong reputation built since 2010, a new website and an audience of around 42,000 followers, but our marketing has not kept pace with our work. We have a strong, established brand. The directors have prepared our marketing strategy. Your role is to learn our brand, maintain it and protect it, review the strategy and suggest improvements, then execute it with expert care.



We work with a small number of high-end clients. We do not want hundreds of leads that do not suit us. We want a smaller number of quality enquiries from the right clients.



You will also keep our Xero accounts up to date every day, support the directors with administration and turn our business coaching lessons into working systems.



Above all, we want someone who takes work off the directors' plate and never adds to it. You will be proactive, solve problems, make sensible decisions within clear limits and bring solutions, not questions.



You will work closely with the director and the general manager, with the opportunity to grow alongside the business. This is a full-time independent contractor engagement of 40 hours per week, worked Monday to Friday, with flexible hours between 8:00am and 7:00pm Brisbane time (Australian Eastern Standard Time). As a guide, about 20 hours per week are marketing, 10 hours are Xero and 10 hours are general administration, adjusted to the priorities of each day and week. All content, brand material, systems and data you create in the role belong to Build Prestige Homes.



Pay is USD $6.50 to $9.00 per hour, depending on experience, paid weekly via Wise.



We offer flexible working times, Philippine regular holidays off and paid (special non-working days are unpaid), your birthday off as a paid holiday (paid at your usual daily hours), training and support for your growth and development, the ability to grow with the team and working from home.



POSITION REQUIREMENTS

- At least 3 years of experience in digital marketing, including executing marketing strategies with measurable results

- Experience marketing premium or luxury brands, with examples of work that shows a high standard of quality

- Experience working within an established brand guide and protecting brand standards in writing, design and video

- A portfolio of social media accounts you have run, with examples of posts and the results they achieved

- Strong skills in Canva and short-form video editing for reels and stories

- Proven results in search engine optimisation (SEO) and local search

- Understanding of answer engine optimisation (AEO): how to make a business visible and accurately described in AI tools, including ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews

- Hands-on Xero experience, including bank reconciliation, entering bills, uploading invoices and preparing batch payments

- A high level of accuracy with numbers and records

- Hands-on experience with WordPress, including page updates and on-page SEO

- Confident using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar), with the judgement to check and edit everything before it is used

- Excellent written English, with a high standard of grammar, spelling and consistency

- A proven record of taking work off a manager's plate: proactive, solution focused and able to work independently with minimal supervision

- Takes feedback well and repositions work quickly when it is not landing

- Reliable computer, stable internet connection and a suitable work environment



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Brand Protection

- Learn our Brand Voice Guide and brand standards in full within your first 2 weeks

- Review our existing content, website and social channels within your first 2 weeks and flag anything that does not meet our brand standards

- Apply our brand guide to every piece of work, with no exceptions, and keep our look, tone and messaging consistent across every channel

- Check every post, page,
 and video for accuracy, spelling, grammar and consistency before it is submitted

- Suggest improvements to our brand voice and our Claude skills, for approval by the directors



Marketing Strategy

- Review the 90 day marketing strategy prepared by the directors within your first 2 weeks, and give feedback on how it can be improved

- Execute the approved strategy with expert care

- Report what the results show and recommend changes to the strategy for the directors to approve

- Focus every activity on quality enquiries from clients building premium homes over $1.2 million in South East Queensland

- Work in 2 week cycles and adjust quickly when results or feedback show something is not working



Social Media & Content

- Run our Claude marketing skills to draft captions, articles, web pages and
s, then check and finish every piece before it is submitted

- Plan and run a content calendar across Instagram,
, Pinterest, LinkedIn and Houzz, posting regularly and on schedule

- Create posts, carousels, reels and stories from our library of residence and site photographs and video

- Draft and publish journal articles, suburb and service pages, residence case studies and campaign landing pages for approval

- Maintain our website, including page updates, on-page SEO and fixing errors

- Respond to comments and messages promptly



SEO & AEO Visibility

- Make sure Build Prestige Homes is visible in Google search (SEO) and in AI answer engines, including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini and Perplexity (AEO)

- Keep our website technically sound for search: page titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, site speed and structured data (schema)

- Improve our Google rankings for high-intent local searches across our service areas

- Keep our Google Business Profile current, with regular posts and photographs

- Publish clear question-and-answer content and FAQ sections that answer engines can quote accurately

- Keep our business details identical everywhere they appear online, including directories and Houzz

- Check each month how Google and AI tools describe us, and fix anything wrong or missing



Enquiries & Referrals

- Record each new enquiry and pass genuine enquiries to the director and general manager the same day

- Support our referral program with building designers, real estate and buyers agents and other industry contacts



Xero & Bookkeeping Support

- Match every Xero bank transaction daily and upload the supporting invoice or receipt

- Enter supplier bills and prepare batch payments for the director to approve and pay

- List and politely chase missing invoices from suppliers and trades

- Raise any coding or payment queries as a decision, with a recommendation



Administration Support

- Support the director and general manager with administration tasks as agreed, including diary bookings, document preparation, research and record keeping

- Review our standard operating procedures (SOPs) as you use them and recommend changes for approval

- As you settle in and show you are ready, take on more of the directors' tasks as agreed. The role is designed to grow



The Professional Builder Implementation

- Work through our business coaching lessons (The Professional Builder) for marketing and finance

- Turn each lesson into a working procedure, checklist, template or report, for approval by the directors

- Put each approved product into daily use



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

- Directors: every daily summary leaves the directors with nothing to do

- Brand: brand guide learned and content review delivered within the first 2 weeks

- Strategy: feedback on the strategy within the first 2 weeks, then the 90 day plan delivered on schedule

- Quality Enquiries: enquiries that match our ideal client and budget, tracked by source

- Social Media: content calendar delivered on schedule, with engagement growing

- Quality: work submitted to our brand guide and standard, with minimal corrections needed

- Xero: every transaction matched with its invoice uploaded by the end of each working day

- SEO and AEO: first page Google rankings and accurate AI answers for agreed priority searches, checked monthly

- Professional Builder: one approved product put into use every 2 weeks



MEETINGS & REPORTING



Daily Update

- Post a short summary in our WhatsApp group at the end of each day covering what was completed and what is next. The summary must not leave the directors with anything to do



Twice-Weekly Meeting (15 minutes)

- Meet with the director or general manager twice a week for decisions only

- Bring each decision needed in a simple format: the problem, the options and your recommendation



Weekly Results Report

- Report each week on enquiries, content delivered, social results, search position, Xero status and progress against the 90 day plan



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

- Marketing for builders, building designers, interior designers, real estate or other premium home services

- Experience marketing to Australian clients

- Bookkeeping for an Australian business, including GST

- Photography or video skills for content



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

To show you have read this advert in full, start your application with the phrase "Pizza is perfection". Applications without it will not be considered.



Please include a link to your portfolio: social media accounts you have run, with examples of posts and the results they achieved. Portfolios that do not show premium work will not be considered.



Please also submit a short video outlining:

- Why you are interested in the position

- How you would make us visible in Google and in AI answer engines

- How your experience aligns with the position requirements and key responsibilities

- Your Xero experience and the types of businesses you have done bookkeeping for

title: Cold Caller / Lead Finder
description:
US Real Estate – Inherited & Tax-Delinquent Properties



About Us

Land Pearl Ventures is a US real estate investment company. We help families resolve inherited properties with title problems, often after a parent or relative has passed away and the property has fallen behind on taxes. We need a skilled, caring cold caller to reach these families, find the right family members to talk to, and pass promising opportunities to the owner, who handles all negotiations and closings.



What You Will Do

• Call property owners and family members from tax-delinquent lists (Texas and Louisiana) using our script

• Find out who the heirs or next of kin are, how many family members are involved, and who the key decision-makers are

• Learn the family situation: are they cooperative, has anyone tried to sell, do they understand the title issues?

• Collect contact information for other heirs when possible

• Identify interested sellers and schedule a follow-up call for the owner. You will not negotiate prices or make offers.

• Dial from JustCall, log every call, and write clear notes in Pipedrive (CRM)

• Make 60–100 dials per day



Schedule

• Part-time: 6 hours per day, Monday–Friday (30 hours per week)

• Hours: 1:00 PM – 7:00 PM US Central Time (3:00 AM – 9:00 AM Philippine time)

• 1:00–2:00 PM: prep — review the day's call list, read obituaries and family trees, update Pipedrive notes

• 2:00–7:00 PM: calling



Requirements

• At least 1 year of outbound cold-calling experience, preferably for a US real estate company

• Excellent spoken English, a clear accent, and a warm, patient phone manner. Many people we call have recently lost a loved one.

title: Creative Strategist (Meta Ads, DTC Fitness & Athletics)
description:
Creative Strategist (Meta Ads, DTC Fitness & Athletics)



Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time



About Us

ABG Media is an ecommerce growth brokerage that places talent into ecommerce marketing teams for DTC brands. You'll work inside a client's Meta creative team — alongside editors, designers and a media buyer — and report through our founder.



This seat is for one DTC fitness and strength-training gear brand (physical training products). The work is Meta ads: angles, hooks, briefs, and the feedback loop that turns tests into winners.



The role

You own the Meta creative strategy for this brand. That means you do not just write a brief and disappear. You stay in the whole process: research and angles, hooks, production-ready briefs, feedback with editors and designers, reading results with the media buyer, then iterating or killing and briefing the next test.



Volume: 20 briefs a week, consistently. This is a must-pass. If you cannot hold that cadence, do not apply.



You will

- Mine customer language (reviews, Reddit, comments, support, Ad Library) and turn it into angles and hooks for a physical fitness / strength-training product

- Write production-ready briefs for editors and designers (avatar, awareness stage, hook, offer/destination, the one metric that proves it, and what to iterate next)

- Stay engaged after the brief: notes on first cuts, hook variants, what to kill, what to scale

- Read Ads Manager performance with the media buyer and d
 ad vs page vs offer blame correctly

- Ship a steady 20-brief week, every week



You have

- Proven Meta creative-strategy experience on athletics, sports, fitness or strength-training gear, or other physical DTC products — brands, products, and proof, not claims alone

- Ads Manager spend proof for ads you strategized: screenshots or a screen-share with dates and spend. ROAS claims without proof will not be reviewed

- A real weekly output of 20 briefs, and examples that show you stay in the process with editors, designers and a media buyer

- Clear written English

- Required: available and responsive during 8am–5pm CT (US Central) business hours, Monday–Friday. This is about being reachable (Slack/calls), not a fixed shift

- You keep learning the craft, and you can say where you learned it and what you changed because of it



Before you apply — read this:

"Identify problems and solve the problems. If you can't identify a problem, you do not have a job. If you can't solve a problem, you do not keep your job. Problem-solving is the most critical mentality that every team member must have. No exceptions. If you're not a problem solver, please remove yourself and do not apply. The problems will only get harder, so you better get good at dealing with them and learn to expect them."



Process: written questions → short paid test (no account access) → interview → final with the founder.



To apply, answer every item below in your application. Applications that skip the scenario, skip spend proof, or skip the keyword will not be reviewed.



1. Which athletics, sports, fitness, strength-training gear, or other physical DTC brands have you done Meta creative strategy for? Name the products, your role (strategy vs buying vs editing), and one result with numbers. Attach Ads Manager screenshots (dates and spend visible; brand can be blurred) for ads you strategized, or say you can screen-share the same proof on a call.

2. Scenario (must-pass): A Meta product's ROAS dropped 35% over 5 days. Spend is flat, CTR is steady, CVR is down, and nobody changed the ads. What do you think the problem is, how would you confirm it, and what would you ship this week to fix it?

3. How many briefs do you write in a normal week? Walk through how you stay involved after the brief — with editors, designers and the media buyer — through feedback, results and the next test. Confirm you can hold 20 briefs a week in this seat.

4. Availability (must-pass): Will you be available and responsive (Slack/calls) during 8am–5pm CT business hours, Mon–Fri? Give your country, time zone and how quickly you typically reply.

5. Where did you learn creative strategy, and how do you keep learning the craft (courses, programs, mentors, communities, Ad Library teardowns)? If it was Ecom University or Evolve, say so. Name one thing you changed in your work in the last 90 days because of what you learned.

6. Put the words CLEAN LIFTS somewhere in your application so we know you read this.



Generic or AI-template answers without brands, numbers, or spend proof will not be reviewed.

title: Video Editor & Content Distributor
description:
Are you a video editor who can listen to a conversation, find the moment that matters, and turn it into a video people want to finish?



Can you take recorded reflections, family footage, and everyday projects from raw files to published content without needing someone to manage every step?



We’re building content for two connected platforms. One focuses on fatherhood, personal growth, self-advocacy, and helping young people build confidence and direction. The other shares family life, projects, and the lessons we learn while doing things together.



Some footage may show gardening, building, cooking, or working around the house. The activity on screen is not always the point of the video. Sometimes the message is in the audio, and the footage helps bring it to life. We need someone who can hear that message and preserve the speaker’s voice.



We’re looking for a Video Editor & Content Distributor to own the production process from raw audio and footage through editing, captions, approval, scheduling, and publication.

What you’ll do

- Listen to recordings and review raw footage to find strong stories, ideas, and moments.

- Produce 12 distinct short-form videos per week, generally 30–90 seconds long, across the two platforms.

- Edit talking-head clips, voiceovers, and everyday footage into Reels and Shorts.

- Clean up audio and add accurate subtitles, readable on-screen text, and relevant footage.

- Write and proofread video hooks, titles, post captions, and calls to action.

- Improve clarity where needed without changing what the speaker means or making the content sound generic.

- Prepare approved videos for Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

- Schedule posts, confirm they publish correctly, and track the published links.

- Keep raw footage, drafts, final videos, captions, and publishing records organized.

- Send a brief weekly update showing what went live, what is awaiting approval, what is next, and any problems that need attention.

- Flag sensitive family footage, personal stories, unclear facts, or permission concerns before anything is scheduled.

A video counts once, even when it is posted on multiple platforms. The weekly target is 12 different finished videos.

What we’re looking for

You know how to make a short video hold someone’s attention without relying on constant effects or cutting away from every meaningful pause. You can listen closely, identify the point of a story, and give it a clear beginning and satisfying ending.



You also:

- Deliver on time and communicate early if something may be delayed.

- Work independently, follow a content guide, and respond well to feedback.

- Have strong English listening, writing, and proofreading skills.

- Check names, subtitles, sound, framing, aspect ratios, and post copy before submitting work.

- Are comfortable editing in CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar software.

- Can organize work in Google Drive and use publishing tools such as YouTube Studio and Meta Business Suite.

- Have a computer and reliable internet connection capable of handling regular video editing and uploads.

Experience with transcription and AI clipping tools is helpful. Your judgment about the message and your attention to detail matter more.

Hours, pay, and growth

This is a remote, Philippines-based role starting at 20–30 hours per week, with pay of $7–$10 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated skill.



We’ll begin with a one-month paid trial. We’ll continue evaluating quality, consistency, communication, and ownership of the publishing process through the first 90 days. There is a strong possibility of full-time work after 90 days if the role is a good fit and our content needs support it.



We will provide source material and direction. You will help turn it into a reliable weekly publishing process.

To apply — please read carefully

Put COMPASS as the first word in your application subject line.



Then send:

1. Links to three short videos you personally edited. At least one should have been created from a longer conversation, interview, or recording.

2. Two or three sentences explaining how you d
 which moment from a longer recording should become a short video.

3. The editing software and scheduling tools you use.

4. Your hourly rate and weekly availability, including any overlap with U.S. Central Time.

5. A brief description of any experience scheduling and publishing content across multiple social media accounts.

Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid editing test using footage we provide, followed by a video interview.

title: Medical VA / Patient Care Coordinator – Calls, Scheduling, Chart Prep, & Billing Support – U.S. Podiatry Practicea
description:
We are a busy U.S. podiatry and sports medicine practice looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Patient Care Coordinator (Medical Virtual Assistant) for a long-term, full-time role. You will be the main link between our patients, our doctor and our in-office team, handling patient calls, scheduling, chart preparation, authorizations, billing support and follow-through from start to finish.



SCHEDULE

Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (9:00 PM–6:00 AM Philippine time), with one approved 1-hour break.



PAY

$6–$7.50 USD/hour to start, based on experience (higher end for candidates with medical billing experience). Paid training. Performance and pay review at 90 days.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Patient calls and scheduling

- Answer patient calls and return voi
s the same day

- Schedule, reschedule, cancel and confirm appointments in DrChrono following our scheduling rules

- Call new patients and web inquiries to schedule

- Confirm upcoming appointments and fill openings from the waitlist

-
 and text patients as needed

- Log every call and patient message in the EHR and our task tracker



2. New-patient intake

- Collect full legal name, date of birth, phone, insurance and reason for visit on every new-patient call

- Send intake forms through IntakeQ and follow up until they are completed

- Enter new patients (and patients not seen in over a year) into our systems

- Download completed paperwork and file it in the correct chart



3. Chart preparation

- Review the upcoming schedule and prepare charts before each visit

- Enter medications, allergies, insurance and demographics from intake forms

- Flag missing paperwork, referrals or insurance information before the patient arrives



4. Prior authorizations, MRI precertifications and referrals

- Complete prior authorizations for medications

- Complete MRI and imaging precertifications, including STAT requests (contact the facility for availability, then complete the precert with the insurance)

- Check payer portals for referrals (including Keystone First / KHPE) and request missing referrals



5. Medical records and documents

- Request and track records, imaging reports and office notes from other doctors and facilities

- Retrieve faxes from RingCentral and DrChrono and upload them to the correct chart

- Upload
ed documents and route items that need the doctor's signature

- Submit records and charts to insurance portals when requested



6. Doctor requests and follow-through

- Send medication refill requests and clinical questions to the doctor the same day

- Escalate doctor-to-doctor calls and urgent clinical calls immediately

- Call patients back with the doctor's instructions the same day

- Keep every task updated until it is fully resolved, not just forwarded

- Send an accurate end-of-day report of completed and open items



7. Billing support (as needed)

- Verify insurance eligibility and benefits before visits

- Help review and submit claims and correct rejections

- Post insurance payments and ERAs

- Follow up on denied and unpaid claims with payers

- Answer patient billing questions and help with patient balances and statements

- Enter payments and patient information in Helcim



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years in a U.S. medical office or as a medical VA, including patient calls and scheduling

- Experience with prior authorizations and imaging precertifications

- Medical billing experience (eligibility, claims, ERA posting, denials) is a strong plus

- Clear, natural spoken English and strong written English

- EHR experience (DrChrono, RingCentral, IntakeQ, Helcim and Google Workspace are a plus)

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently

- Reliable internet with backup power, a quiet workspace and HIPAA awareness

- Podiatry, orthopedics or sports medicine experience is a plus



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with "PATIENT CARE" and include:

1. Your résumé and desired hourly rate

2. Confirmation you can work 8:00 AM–5:00 PM ET, Monday–Friday

3. The EHR, phone, billing and insurance portal systems you have used

4. Your experience with prior authorizations, MRI precertifications and medical billing

5. A 3–5 minute voice recording answering these questions in your own words:



   a) A new patient calls with heel pain and only gives her first name, "Shelly." Walk me through everything you collect before you end the call, and what you do in the system afterward.



   b) A patient calls Monday at 10 AM saying she is running low on her nerve pain medication and needs a refill. What do you do, and by when?



   c) The doctor orders a STAT MRI for a patient with commercial insurance. Walk me through every step to get the patient scheduled and the precertification approved.



   d) Two lines ring at once, and you already have three voi
s waiting. How do you handle it so no one falls through the cracks?



   Applications without the voice recording will not be considered. Please do not read a script or use AI-generated answers. We want to hear how you naturally communicate and solve problems.



Finalists will complete a live interview on Google Meet (camera on), followed by a paid 2-week trial period working real shifts with our team. The trial is paid at the agreed hourly rate, and successful candidates will move into the long-term role.

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (Python/Django)
description:
Company: US-Based SaaS Startup

Position: Full-Time | 40 Hours/Week | Long-Term

Bonus: 13th-Month Bonus

Schedule: Flexible – Work Normal Philippine Daytime Hours (No Overnight US Shift)



**About the Opportunity**



We're a US-based software company building a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform that connects accounting, customer relationships, operations, workflows, and other essential business functions into one integrated system. After 18 months of development, we're looking for our first external software engineer to help complete our MVP, improve existing functionality, and prepare the product for launch. You'll work directly with a technical founder who leads the overall product vision and architecture, while taking ownership of meaningful development work. We're looking for someone who doesn't just write code to make something work, but thinks critically about how to build scalable, flexible, and maintainable systems that can evolve as the product grows.



**What You'll Do**



• Full-Stack Development: Build and improve features across our Django backend, PostgreSQL database, and HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend.

• Scalable System Design: Develop reusable, configurable, and extensible solutions rather than relying on hardcoded logic or short-term workarounds.

• Feature Ownership: Independently take features from requirements through implementation, testing, and completion.

• Architecture & Problem-Solving: Understand how different modules interact, anticipate edge cases, and recommend thoughtful technical solutions.

• DevOps & Infrastructure: Assist with AWS deployments, environment configuration, CI/CD processes, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.

• Quality & Performance: Debug complex issues, optimize queries and application performance, write automated tests, and improve security and reliability.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with the founder to evaluate approaches, identify improvements, and help prepare the platform for production.



**Our Tech Stack**



• Backend: Python, Django

• Database: PostgreSQL

• Frontend: HTML, CSS, Vanilla JavaScript

• Testing: pytest

• Background Tasks: Celery, Redis

• Infrastructure & DevOps: AWS, Git, CI/CD, deployment and monitoring tools

• Other: REST APIs, third-party integrations



**What We're Looking For**



• 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on Python/Django expertise.

• Strong knowledge of Django architecture, PostgreSQL, relational database design, and query optimization.

• Comfortable building interactive interfaces using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.

• Experience designing scalable, dynamic, and maintainable systems with reusable components and configurable business logic.

• Ability to understand and extend existing complex codebases without introducing unnecessary complexity or technical debt.

• Working knowledge of DevOps fundamentals, cloud deployments, and production application troubleshooting.

• Strong debugging, problem-solving, testing, and performance optimization skills.

• Ability to work independently, take ownership, and make sound technical decisions with minimal supervision.

• Proactive communication, attention to detail, and good written and spoken English.



**Nice to Have**



• Experience building ERP, CRM, SaaS, or other business management platforms.

• Experience with AG Grid, particularly advanced data tables, filtering, editing, and dynamic data-driven interfaces.

• Experience with Celery, Redis, background processing, and API integrations.

• Stronger AWS, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, or application monitoring experience.

• Experience helping bring early-stage software products into production.



**Why Join Us**



• Meaningful Ownership: Take responsibility for important features and contribute to how the product is built.

• Work With a Technical Founder: Collaborate directly with someone who understands software development and values thoughtful engineering.

• Interesting Technical Challenges: Build interconnected systems with complex business workflows, dynamic interfaces, and evolving requirements.

• Flexible Working Hours: Work during normal Philippine daytime hours. No overnight US shift required.

• Long-Term Growth: Join early and have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities as the product and engineering team expand.



**How to Apply**



1. Your resume/CV and a brief overview of your Python/Django experience.

2. Your GitHub, portfolio, or examples of relevant projects, if available.

3. A brief example of a complex feature or system you independently designed or developed. How did you make it scalable, flexible, or maintainable rather than relying on hardcoded solutions?

4. Your expected monthly salary (USD) and earliest availability.



We're looking for a thoughtful, dependable engineer who takes pride in building quality software, solves problems independently, and thinks beyond simply completing assigned tasks. If you enjoy building well-designed systems and want to make a meaningful impact on a growing software product, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING

This role requires previous experience calling leads for home service businesses (waterproofing, foundation repair, crawl space, concrete, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, pest control, solar, and similar). This is the minimum requirement, not a preference. If you do not have it, do not apply. Your application will not be reviewed.



ABOUT DRYSCALE

DryScale runs lead generation for waterproofing, crawl space, foundation repair, and concrete contractors across the United States. We get some of the best results in the space and are one of the fastest-growing agencies on the market. Our ads bring in homeowners with a real problem at the house (water in the basement, a cracking foundation, a sinking driveway) who have asked to be contacted. You are the person who calls them.



Because we're growing this fast, we need a high-quality, long-term partner in this CSR role, not a short-term hire. If you're looking for a few months of work, this isn't it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Dial every new B2C lead that comes in across our client accounts, fast. Speed-to-lead is the job.

- Book the homeowner for a free in-home inspection and estimate on the client's calendar in GoHighLevel.

- Work the follow-up: no-answers, callbacks, texts, and older leads that never booked.

- Confirm upcoming appointments so they actually hold.

- Keep GHL clean: correct pipeline stage, notes on every conversation, tags, and call outcomes.

- Handle multiple client accounts, each with its own services, service area, and calendar.

- Flag out-of-area requests, wrong-service leads, and anything the client's office needs to know.



REQUIREMENTS (ALL FIVE ARE REQUIRED)

1. Experience calling for home service businesses. Minimum requirement, see above.

2. Familiar with GoHighLevel (GHL): contacts, conversations, pipelines, and calendars.

3. At least 3 years of experience in previous roles (phone-based customer service, appointment setting, or inside sales).

4. Very fluent in English. You will be on the phone with US homeowners all day: clear, confident, and easy to understand.

5. Able to work a full-time position on US Eastern Time hours.



You'll also need reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset.



COMPENSATION

$1,500–$2,000 USD per month on-target earnings: base pay plus performance pay tied to the appointments you book.



HOW TO APPLY: SEND A 1-MINUTE VIDEO

There are no interviews at this stage. To apply, record a quick video (about 1 minute) of yourself reading the call script below, then send it to us.



Your video must:

- Show your face on camera.

- Start with your name and the home service industries you've called for, then go straight into the script.

- Be recorded with the headset or mic you'd actually use on calls, in the space you'd actually work from. We want to hear what homeowners would hear.

- Sound like a real call. Don't just read the words. Say it the way you would to a homeowner on the phone.



Read only your own lines. You don't need to act out the homeowner.



EXAMPLE SCRIPT: FOUNDATION REPAIR NEW LEAD CALL



"Hi, is this Mark? Hey Mark, this is [your name] with Summit Foundation Repair. You filled out a form on our site a few minutes ago about some cracks in your foundation. Did I catch you at an okay time?



Great. Just so I understand what's going on: are the cracks inside the basement, on the outside walls, or both? And have you noticed any doors sticking, or windows that don't close like they used to?



Okay, that's really helpful. That's exactly what our inspectors want to look at before it gets any worse. What we'll do is send a specialist out to the house for a free inspection. They'll show you what's causing it and give you a written estimate right there, no cost and no obligation.



I've got Thursday at 10 AM or Friday at 2 PM open in your area. Which one works better for you?



Perfect, you're all set for Thursday at 10. You'll get a text confirmation in the next few minutes. Thanks, Mark. Talk soon."



HOW TO SEND IT

Reply to this post with all four of the following:

1. A link to your video (Loom, unlisted YouTube, or Google Drive set to "Anyone with the link can view").

2. Confirmation that you meet the minimum requirements, including which home service businesses you've called for.

3. Confirmation that you can work full-time on US Eastern Time hours.

4. Confirmation that you're familiar with GoHighLevel.



If anything is missing, or the video link doesn't open, your application will not be reviewed. Consider this the first test of the job: following instructions exactly is what this role is.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

We'll watch every video and reach out directly to the applicants we think are the best fit. If you don't hear from us, you were not selected this round.



We're looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Business Funding Specialist (Recent 2025-2026 Experience Required) | Client Zoom Applications
description:
Hoodrich Credit is hiring an EXPERIENCED Business Funding Specialist. You will review client files, build a funding plan, and guide U.S. clients through their applications on live Zoom calls. This is not an entry-level role. We only want people who are doing business funding right now and know which banks and lenders are approving today.



RECENT EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED

- You have personally helped U.S. clients get business funding within the last 6 months.

- You know the current banks, credit unions and card issuers that are approving business credit cards and lines of credit right now, plus their current inquiry sensitivity, bureau pulls and approval patterns.

- You can explain what changed in the last year and which lenders no longer work.

- Applicants without recent, hands-on funding results will not be considered.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Pick up new client assignments in Slack and GoHighLevel and confirm intake info and documents are complete.

- Review authorized credit reports, business details, existing banking relationships and documents.

- Build a funding application plan (which lenders, what order, which bureaus) before every client session.

- Lead screen-shared Zoom sessions while clients complete and submit their own applications on their own devices.

- Make sure every application uses accurate, truthful information supported by the client's records.

- Record results, approval amounts, pending decisions and follow-ups in the CRM.

- Follow up on pending decisions and reconsideration calls, and escalate issues fast.

- Generate invoices per the signed agreement and keep pipeline stages current.

- Post a daily activity report in Slack.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English and confidence leading live video calls with U.S. clients.

- Proven, recent results in business funding (cards, lines of credit, term loans).

- Strong credit report analysis.

- GoHighLevel, Slack, Zoom and credit-monitoring tools.

- Full-time availability overlapping U.S. business hours (Eastern time).

- Reliable internet with a backup, and a quiet call setup.



Clients complete and submit their own applications. Approvals and amounts are never guaranteed.



COMMISSION

On top of base pay, you earn 0.25% of the funding secured for each client you help get funded (e.g. $10,000 funded = $25 extra).



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these will not be reviewed)

1. Subject line: FUNDING SPECIALIST - [Your Full Name]

2. Your resume and how long you have been doing business funding, including your most recent client funded (month/year).

3. List 5 banks or lenders you have gotten clients approved with in the last 6 months, and which bureau each one pulled.

4. Two anonymized recent results (credit profile summary, lenders used, total approved). No private client data.

5. How you prepare for a session and what you do when a client's documents don't match.

6. Your availability, time zone and start date.

description:

---

- Edit UGC-style content, testimonial ads, VSLs, and hybrid formats optimized for paid social

- Apply strong pacing, visual hooks, captions, motion graphics, and sound design to maximize retention and conversions

- Produce multiple variations and iterations of winning ads – new hooks, different CTAs, alternate formats

- Implement feedback quickly and accurately from the creative strategist – revisions are part of the process, not an afterthought

- Stay on top of new AI tools, techniques, and workflows that can improve speed and output quality

- Maintain organized project files and deliver assets in the correct specs for each platform



**What We're Looking For**



- 2+ years of experience editing video ads for supplement and/or skincare brands (non-negotiable)

- A portfolio showing direct response video ads with a clear performance focus – not brand films or corporate content

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve

- Hands-on experience with AI video and image generation tools – Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, HeyGen, Midjourney, or similar – and the ability to make AI outputs look real, not obviously generated

- Strong understanding of what makes a paid social ad perform – pacing, hooks, structure, and visual hierarchy

- Experience editing UGC-style ads, testimonials, and short-form content for Meta, TikTok, or YouTube

- Fast turnaround without sacrificing quality – you can produce volume while keeping the bar high

- Receptive to feedback and comfortable with an iterative process where ads get refined before going live

- Detail-oriented and organized – you manage multiple projects and deliverables without things slipping

- Fluent English communication – you need to understand briefs and feedback clearly



**Compensation**



$1500 USD/month



**How to Apply**



1. Put your portfolio link as the FIRST line of your application message

2. Your portfolio must include video ad work for supplement and/or skincare brands

3. Include examples of AI-generated or AI-enhanced video work you've done – we want to see how realistic your AI outputs are

4. Briefly describe which AI tools you use and how they fit into your editing workflow

Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

description:
About Us

The B2B eCommerce Agency helps manufacturers and distributors grow revenue through eCommerce. We’ve been doing this for 20 years. Our founder, Ethan Giffin, has written two books on B2B eCommerce, and they’re the foundation of our content.

- 1
 newsletter per week. You assemble and schedule The B2B eCommerce Brief in HubSpot. It goes out Fridays at 8am ET.

 and Airtable

Flag tracking issues and odd data to the account manager before the client spots them

2+ years at a digital marketing agency handling tracking or reporting for multiple clients at once. In-house or single-brand experience alone isn't a fit for this role.

About Ocean Wounds



Ocean Wounds is a growing mobile wound care organization providing specialized wound care services to patients across multiple states. We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Virtual Medical Scribe with a clinical background to support our expanding provider and scribe teams.



This position is ideal for someone with hands-on experience using WoundExpert who is comfortable working with Nurse Practitioners, reviewing clinical documentation, educating providers, and overseeing documentation quality and daily workflows.



Position Overview



The Senior Virtual Medical Scribe will play an important role in supporting our Nurse Practitioners and scribe team. This individual will assist with chart audits, documentation accuracy, provider education, workflow coordination, and team productivity.



The ideal candidate should have a clinical background and be confident communicating with healthcare professionals, identifying documentation issues, and helping providers improve their use of WoundExpert.



Previous hands-on WoundExpert experience is REQUIRED. A clinical background is also REQUIRED, with preference given to candidates holding a nursing or other healthcare-related degree or qualification.



Key Responsibilities



1. Daily Workflow & Operations Management



Develop and communicate daily workflow plans.



Assign providers and patient trackers.



Monitor daily productivity and ensure team members meet production expectations (approximately 40 charts per day).



Balance workloads and coordinate coverage during absences, PTO, and scheduling changes.



Follow up on incomplete or delayed tasks and communicate outstanding items.



Adjust assignments based on daily volume and team availability.



2. Quality Assurance & Chart Auditing



Conduct routine audits of scribe documentation and patient charts.



Review charts for accuracy, completeness, and proper documentation.



Identify recurring errors, documentation gaps, and areas for improvement.



Ensure compliance with established documentation templates and workflows.



Prepare weekly quality reports outlining trends, errors, and improvement plans.



3. Provider Education & Clinical Documentation Support



Work directly with Nurse Practitioners to provide guidance on WoundExpert.



Educate and assist providers with proper charting and documentation workflows.



Help providers understand documentation requirements and identify areas needing correction.



Answer questions and provide ongoing support with EMR navigation.



Help newer providers become comfortable and efficient with WoundExpert.



Provide guidance on clinical terminology and documentation practices within the scope of the role.



4. Team Coaching & Development



Conduct coaching sessions with scribes to review performance and address improvement areas.



Assist with training and onboarding new scribes.



Provide ongoing feedback and support to team members.



Develop improvement plans when performance or documentation issues arise.



Recognize strong performance and encourage team development.

Divergent Estates is a US short-term rental management company with 62 rentals across 10 states. We run cleaning, maintenance, guests and pricing for property owners.

title: BUSINESS CONSULTANT – SYSTEMS & OPERATIONS
description:
BUSINESS CONSULTANT – SYSTEMS & OPERATIONS

Work from Home | Long-term Opportunity



THE OPPORTUNITY

Do you have experience managing business operations, improving processes or helping business owners turn ideas into practical action? Are you confident learning software and explaining it clearly to others?

Bell Curve Solutions is looking for a Business Consultant – Systems & Operations to help Australian trade and service businesses improve how they work.

You may have developed your skills through operations management, business ownership, consulting, business analysis or a senior executive assistant role. What matters is your ability to understand how a business operates, identify what could work better and confidently guide people through change.

Bell Curve Solutions is an Australian ServiceM8 Gold Partner. We help business owners streamline their operations through practical advice, better processes and job management software.

This is an opportunity to build on your existing business experience and develop into a consultant who independently coaches clients, improves their systems and helps them achieve better results.

ServiceM8 training will be provided.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This role combines business process improvement, software coaching and consultative sales.

You’ll work directly with business owners, administration teams and field staff to understand their challenges, improve their workflows and help them use their job management system confidently.

Our primary platform is ServiceM8, which trade and service businesses use to manage enquiries, quotes, scheduling, jobs and invoicing. You’ll learn how to configure the software around each client’s needs and teach them how to use it in their daily work.

You’ll also respond to incoming enquiries, identify what prospective clients need and recommend appropriate paid services.

Initially, you’ll work alongside our founder, shadowing client sessions and learning our approach. As your knowledge and confidence grow, you’ll progress towards managing clients and delivering sessions independently.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Systems & Process Improvement

- Understand how each client’s business operates, including their current processes, challenges and priorities.

- Identify inefficiencies, double handling and gaps in workflows.

- Recommend practical improvements suited to the client’s business and technical confidence.

- Set up and review ServiceM8 accounts to support those workflows.



Client Coaching & Training

- Deliver one-hour coaching and training sessions via video.

- Train business owners, administration teams and field staff.

- Explain software and processes clearly, adjusting your approach to the person you’re teaching.

- Help clients who feel overwhelmed by technology build confidence.

- Guide clients through implementing changes and adopting better ways of working.



Enquiries & Business Development

- Respond professionally to incoming enquiries.

- Ask questions to understand client needs and recommend suitable services.

- Explain the value of our services and convert enquiries into paid bookings.

- Build strong client relationships and identify opportunities for further support.



Follow-up & Client Management

- Prepare clear session recaps and action lists.

- Complete agreed follow-up tasks and keep clients informed.

- Maintain accurate notes and manage your commitments.

- Take ownership of outstanding actions and follow through.



EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

Essential

- Practical experience supporting business operations, managing processes or coordinating work across different areas of a business.

- An understanding of how a businesses operates and the importance of systems, processes and workflows.

- Confidence using business software and learning new systems.

- Strong computer skills, including Windows and Microsoft Office.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confidence speaking directly with clients, being comfortable on camera (video calls) and explaining ideas clearly.

- The ability to ask useful questions, solve problems and make practical recommendations.

- Strong organisation, attention to detail and follow-through.

- Commercial awareness and a willingness to recommend and sell appropriate services.



Highly Regarded

- Experience in operations management, business management, consulting, business analysis or business ownership.

- Senior Executive Assistance experience involving operational responsibility and process improvement.

- Experience supporting Australian businesses, particularly trade or service businesses.

- Experience training colleagues or clients, delivering demonstrations or leading video meetings.

- Experience with job management software, CRMs, workflow tools or business automations.

- Experience in consultative sales, business development or managing incoming enquiries.

You don’t need to have held a consulting title before. We welcome applicants who can demonstrate relevant experience, sound judgement and the ability to grow into the role.



PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

We’re looking for someone who is:

- Engaging and confident: comfortable building rapport and leading client conversations.

- Curious and commercially minded: interested in how businesses work and what helps them succeed.

- Proactive: brings ideas and recommendations without waiting for detailed instructions.

- Patient and adaptable: can support people with different levels of technical confidence.

- Reliable and accountable: takes ownership and follows through on commitments.

- Ambitious and open to feedback: keen to learn, develop consulting skills and take on responsibility.

- Interested in a long-term working relationship.



WHAT’S ON OFFER

- A remote role working directly with Bell Curve Solutions.

- AUD $15+ per hour, depending on experience and suitability.

- Full-time or part-time applicants considered.

- Training in ServiceM8 and our consulting approach.

- The opportunity to shadow our founder before progressing to independent client work.

- Varied work helping Australian business owners improve their operations.

- Opportunities for greater responsibility and increased earning potential as your skills and contribution grow.



EQUIPMENT & WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS

You must have, or be willing to obtain:

- A Windows-based computer suitable for business software.

- Dual monitors for screen sharing while keeping notes visible.

- A webcam and headset suitable for professional video meetings.

Reliable internet.

- A backup power supply if your location is prone to power outages, sufficient to keep your computer and internet running during client sessions.

- A quiet, dedicated workspace.

- A comfortable desk and chair suitable for remote work.



HOW TO APPLY

Please apply through this platform using at least 5 Apply Points and include all of the following:

Applications using fewer than 5 Apply Points, missing the requested information or not following the instructions above will not be considered.

1. Resume & Relevant Experience

Provide your resume including any relevant experience relating to this role, highlighting any work involving business operations, process improvement, client training, software or sales.

2. Introduction Video

Record a 1–2 minute video introducing yourself, outlining your relevant experience and explaining why this opportunity interests you.

In your video, also respond to this scenario:

Imagine a client tells you: “I’m not very good with computers, and I’m finding this software overwhelming.”

What would you say to help them feel comfortable, and how would you approach teaching them?

Please respond as though you’re speaking directly to the client.

Be visible and speak directly to the camera. A simple phone or webcam recording is perfect; no editing is required.

3. Availability

Confirm your full-time or part-time preference, available working days and hours and earliest start date.

4. Expected Hourly Rate

State your expected hourly rate in Australian dollars (AUD) only. Please do not provide weekly or monthly rates.

5. Workstation Photos

Include at least 3 photos clearly showing your computer, equipment, desk, chair and overall workspace. If you still need to obtain any required equipment, please explain your plans.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: AI Clip Editor
description:
About Us

The Pod Place is a podcast and content studio in Las Vegas and Los Angeles, US. We record, produce and clip podcasts for creators, and we turn some of those into short-form content built to get watched, shared and saved.



We use AI to do the heavy lifting. Every episode gets an AI first pass: our system reads the full transcript, picks the strongest moments, cuts them in OpusClip and flags anything that needs a human eye. What we need now is that human eye: editors with taste who can take a strong draft and make it great.



The Role

You'll be one of two AI Clip Editors in charge of finalizing our OpusClip clips. When an episode's first pass is done, it gets posted in our Slack. You claim it, polish the clips and deliver them within 24 hours.



The AI makes a lot of the decisions for you, but not all of them. We want someone who will use their own judgment: if a clip needs a few more seconds to land, extend it. If a cut feels off, fix it. If a clip just isn't working, tell us.



What You'll Do

• Finalize AI-selected clips in OpusClip after our first pass

• Clean up every clip: remove ums, filler words, long pauses, false starts and dead air

• Make sure each clip makes sense on its own, with a clear start, a clear point and a clean ending

• Extend or trim clips when the moment needs more (or less) context

• Check captions for spelling, names and accuracy

• Use your judgment on hooks, pacing and framing to give each clip the best shot at performing

• Flag clips that should be cut, or moments the AI missed that deserve a clip

• Deliver finished clips within 24 hours of claiming a project



How Projects Work

1.  Our AI does a first pass on each episode and posts a summary in Slack listing the clips and what still needs to be done.

2.  Either the first editor to claim it takes the project, or we send it directly to one editor.

3.  If you're sent a project directly, please confirm within about 2 hours. If we don't hear back, it moves to the next editor.

4.  Once you've claimed a project, finished clips are due within 24 hours.



Because of this setup, responsiveness matters as much as editing skill. The more projects you claim and turn around well, the more work you'll get.



What We're Looking For

Must-haves

• Proven experience editing short-form clips for social media (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts)

• A strong instinct for what makes content engaging: hooks, pacing, payoff, and why some clips go viral and others don't

• Open, flexible availability, including some evenings and weekends

• Fast, reliable turnaround: you can consistently deliver within 24 hours

• Quick to respond on Slack

• Strong attention to detail (captions, names, clean cuts)

• Good written English and comfort working independently



Nice-to-haves

• Experience with OpusClip or other AI editing tools

• Experience editing podcast or interview content

• Comfort working alongside AI: reviewing its decisions, correcting them and knowing when to override them

• A portfolio of clips that performed well (views, shares, saves)



Why You'll Like Working With Us

• Fully remote and flexible

• The AI handles the tedious first pass, so your time goes into the creative calls

• Steady, recurring work from an active studio with a growing client list

• Work on real podcasts with real audiences

• Room to grow with a team that's building AI-first content systems



How to Apply

Please send:

1.  A link to your portfolio or 3–5 short-form clips you've edited (include view counts if you have them)

2.  A few sentences on what you think makes a clip go viral

3.  Your typical availability

4.  The tools you've used, especially any AI editing tools



To show us you read this far, start your application with the words "Clip ready."



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test edit: we'll send an AI first-pass project and see what you do with it.

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



This is an ops role with an outreach front end. You source creators, sign them, walk them through onboarding and warm-up, keep them posting on schedule, and make sure they get paid, across several client campaigns at once. When a campaign needs 10 or more creators posting a video a day, you are the person who knows at any moment who posted, who did not, and who is stuck.



Everything runs through 
. The best fit here is a strong ops person who is also good with people: fast, accurate, organized, and fine with strategy changing mid-contract.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Research and discovery. Find creators on discovery platforms using filters like US-based, niche, and account performance, and check whether their existing content formats match what we are actually trying to produce. Also watch TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram directly for viral formats and rising talent.

- Outreach. First contact via DM, email, or 
, pitch the opportunity, and run the relationship from there.

- Negotiation. Most UGC creators land on one of two standard rates, so day to day this is simple. On micro-influencer campaigns you will negotiate real deals creator by creator: rates, deliverables, usage.

- Onboarding and warm-up. Guide creators through onboarding in 
, including our bot-guided flow. Review warm-up videos and confirm creators are warming their accounts correctly before they post campaign content.

- Content review. Check creator content in 
 against campaign requirements, including that every video uses the right campaign hashtag so it gets tracked. Flag what needs redoing and explain why.

- Posting ops and reporting. Keep daily posting on track across every active campaign and maintain clean reporting on who posted, who did not, and who needs a nudge. Current and accurate, not reconstructed at the end of the week.

- Creator support. Be the first line for creator questions and unblock people fast. Advice has to be right and it has to be quick, since a correct answer six hours late still costs us a post.

- Payments. Run creator payouts on payment platforms like Grade and track what has been paid against what is owed.

- Spreadsheets and process. Work in our existing Google Sheets templates: updating them, fixing errors, keeping campaign data clean. If you can make our sheets run better, even better.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong ops instincts. You hold a lot of moving pieces without dropping any and always know the current state of a campaign.

- You know creator ops language (CPM, base pay, tiered bonuses, caps, deliverables) or can pick it up fast.

- You understand how social platforms actually work: hashtags and tracking, algorithms, formats, why a short-form video lands.

- Comfortable in 
. Servers, roles, channels, threads, tickets, bots.

- Great written communicator. Casual is fine, formal is not required, but it has to be clear, quick, and obviously competent with both creators and the team.

- Software-native. You use a lot of apps, pick up new ones fast on mobile and web (a PC for desktop apps helps), notice UI and UX details, and can take clean screenshots to build walkthroughs that guide a creator through an app they have never opened.

- Comfortable in Google Sheets.

- Adaptable. We work with early-stage startups where strategy gets built as contracts progress.



NICE TO HAVE

- Creator ops, influencer marketing, talent management, or community management experience

- Experience running creator payouts or working with payment platforms

- Advanced Sheets skills (formulas, automation, Apps Script) and an eye for improving process

- Familiarity with our niches: gaming, mobile consumer apps, crypto and trading

- You have created or edited short-form content yourself



THE BAR



You should be able to walk the full creator lifecycle start to finish, from sourcing to outreach to rate agreement to 
 onboarding to warm-up to posting with the right hashtag to tracking to payout, and know where any given creator sits in it at any moment.

title: Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse
description:
Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse



Home Health Experience Required



Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines-Based | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



Zeabe is a growing non-medical home care agency based in Delaware, USA. We provide dependable in-home care services and are building the clinical and operational systems needed to support continued growth while maintaining quality, compliance, and excellent client care.



We are looking for an experienced Registered Nurse with genuine Home Health/Home Care clinical operations experience to join us as our Clinical Operations Manager.



Please Read Before Applying



This is not a Virtual Assistant, Healthcare VA, Medical VA, Medical Receptionist, or general administrative position.



To be considered for this role, you must:



Be a licensed Registered Nurse.

Have worked professionally as an RN.

Have direct experience in a Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care environment.

Have meaningful experience managing, coordinating, supervising, or overseeing clinical operations.

Have been responsible for ensuring other people complete required clinical work, documentation, visits, or deadlines.



If your experience is primarily administrative or Virtual Assistant work, even within healthcare, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.



Likewise, holding an RN license alone is not enough. We are specifically looking for someone who has used their nursing background within Home Health/Home Care and understands the operational side of delivering care in the home.



About the Role



The Clinical Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of Zeabe's clinical services.



The role ensures clients move smoothly from referral through admission, ongoing supervision, recertification, required clinical visits, documentation, and ongoing service delivery while maintaining accurate records, timely follow-up, and regulatory compliance.



You will work closely with our Clinical Director and serve as the operational leader behind the clinical function.



While the Clinical Director owns overall clinical standards, quality, and clinical leadership, the Clinical Operations Manager owns much of the coordination, execution, monitoring, accountability, and follow-through required to make sure clinical work actually gets completed correctly and on time.



You will work across:



Clinical Support Team

Staffing Coordinator

PRN Registered Nurses

Client admissions

Recertifications

Supervisory visits

Clinical documentation

Clinical scheduling and assignments

Compliance-related follow-up

Operational tracking and reporting



This is primarily a Clinical Operations Management position, not a bedside nursing role.



However, your RN background is essential because you must understand the clinical work you are coordinating, recognize when something does not look right, communicate effectively with nurses, identify potential clinical risks, and understand what needs to be escalated.



Primary Objective



Build and operate a reliable clinical operating system that consistently delivers timely, compliant, accurate, and well-coordinated care.



What You Will Be Responsible For

Coordinate clinical operations from referral and admission through ongoing supervision and service delivery.

Ensure admissions, recertifications, supervisory visits, documentation, and follow-up activities are completed accurately and on time.

Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant clinical records across required systems.

Lead the Clinical Support Team and Staffing Coordinator to deliver consistent operational outcomes.

Coordinate PRN Registered Nurse assignments and monitor completion of required clinical activities.

Identify operational risks, resolve process gaps, and appropriately escalate clinical concerns.

Maintain clear visibility over outstanding clinical work so we know what needs to be completed, who owns it, when it is due, and what requires escalation.

The Experience We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who has actually worked inside Home Health or Home Care clinical operations.



Your experience may include areas such as:



Home Health or Home Care clinical operations

Managing or coordinating field nurses

Admissions or Start of Care processes

Recertifications

Supervisory or reassessment visits

Plans of Care

Clinical documentation review

Chart audits

Clinical compliance

Quality assurance

Tracking required clinical visits

Managing overdue documentation

Coordinating nurses and clinical support staff

Correcting incomplete clinical records

Following up on missed clinical requirements

Clinical scheduling

Home Health EMR/EHR systems

Medicaid, Medicare, VA, Private Duty, or other regulated home-based care environments



You do not need to have performed every item on this list.



What matters is that you have genuine clinical operations experience, rather than simply providing administrative support to people who managed clinical operations.



What This Role Really Requires



This position requires much more than maintaining a task list.



You will be expected to know:



What needs to be completed.

Who is responsible for completing it.

What is currently outstanding.

What is overdue.

What does not appear accurate.

What needs follow-up.

What needs escalation.

What recurring problems need a better system.



If a required nursing visit has not happened, we expect you to notice.



If documentation is incomplete, we expect you to identify it.



If someone tells you something is being handled but it remains unresolved, we expect you to follow it through.



If the same problem keeps occurring, we expect you to help determine why and improve the underlying process.



Leadership and Accountability



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to receive assignments.



The successful person will be comfortable:



Taking ownership of operational outcomes.

Directing and coordinating other team members.

Checking whether work has actually been completed.

Following up when deadlines are missed.

Addressing incomplete or inaccurate clinical documentation.

Asking questions when information does not appear correct.

Holding nurses and support team members accountable for agreed requirements.

Maintaining urgency around important clinical work.

Escalating concerns rather than allowing them to remain unresolved.

Following an issue through until it is fully closed.

Improving processes when the same problem repeatedly occurs.



You should be comfortable having a conversation such as:



"This was due yesterday and has not been completed. What is preventing completion, and when will it be finished?"



You can be professional and respectful while still being clear and firm about expectations.



This Role Is Likely a Good Fit for You If...

You are an RN who has genuinely worked in Home Health/Home Care.

You understand clinical operations beyond simply providing nursing care.

You have coordinated, supervised, or managed nurses or clinical support staff.

You naturally take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

You notice when a required visit, signature, document, date, or clinical item is missing.

You do not assume something has been completed just because someone says they are working on it.

You continue following up until an issue is completely resolved.

You are comfortable checking other people's work.

You address missed deadlines rather than avoiding uncomfortable conversations.

You work with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy.

You enjoy bringing structure and order to complicated clinical workflows.

You prefer clear standards, documented processes, and measurable outcomes.

You can quickly explain the current status of important outstanding items.

You question information when it appears incomplete or inconsistent.

You enjoy improving systems so the same operational problems do not continue happening.





This Role Is Probably Not for You If...

Your healthcare experience is primarily as a Virtual Assistant or Healthcare VA.

You have never worked professionally as a Registered Nurse.

You hold an RN license but have never used it professionally in Home Health/Home Care.

Your nursing background is exclusively bedside hospital nursing with no meaningful Home Health/Home Care operational experience.

You have supported a Clinical Manager but have never personally been accountable for clinical operational outcomes.

You prefer receiving clearly defined individual tasks rather than owning a process.

You avoid following up with people when deadlines are missed.

You are uncomfortable checking another nurse's documentation or work.

You tend to accept that something is being handled without verifying completion.

You regularly need your manager to tell you what to do next.

You dislike detailed documentation, compliance requirements, or structured processes.

You prioritize avoiding uncomfortable conversations over addressing an important missed requirement.

You tend to start many things but struggle to consistently close them.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



An active Registered Nurse license.

Professional experience working as an RN.

Direct Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care experience.

Clinical operations experience.

Experience coordinating, supervising, or managing nurses and/or clinical support personnel.

Experience managing documentation, clinical visits, deadlines, follow-up, or compliance requirements.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Confidence following up on late, incomplete, or inaccurate work.

The ability to distinguish routine operational issues from matters requiring clinical escalation.

Experience using healthcare technology, EHR/EMR software, Home Health software, or comparable clinical systems.

Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and cloud-based business applications.

The ability to work independently and take ownership.

Availability to work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Experience



The following experience would be particularly valuable:



U.S. Home Health experience

U.S. healthcare experience

Medicaid

VA Community Care

Medicare-certified Home Health

Private Duty/Home Care

Quality Assurance

Clinical compliance

Chart auditing

Managing remote or offshore clinical teams

AlayaCare or comparable Home Health software



These are preferred rather than mandatory unless otherwise stated above.



Systems and Technology



You may work with systems including:



AlayaCare

Microsoft Teams

SharePoint

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word



Front

Aircall

Trainual

Zoom

Claude



You are not expected to have prior experience with every system.



We are much more interested in whether you are comfortable learning technology, using structured systems consistently, and maintaining accurate information.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position working:



8:00 AM to 4:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Please consider the corresponding Philippine overnight working hours before applying.



Compensation



USD $1,800 to $2,400 per month



Compensation will depend on directly relevant experience, including:



Home Health/Home Care experience

Clinical Operations Management experience

RN experience

Leadership experience

U.S. or PH healthcare experience

Overall fit for the position





How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Clinical Operations



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.
