title: Dispatcher - Customer Service with Emergency Response Background
description:
Job description:



Remote · $10–$12/hr · Full Time · U.S. Company hiring from the Philippines



About SureFire CPR - 



SureFire CPR helps people get the lifesaving training and certifications they need, when they need them.



We run a 24/7 CPR training operation so students can get real support, complete their certification, and actually feel confident doing it.



Our mission is simple: equip people with the skills to save lives. We operate across 100+ locations and are scaling to 1,000 before 2029, which means more people who can step in when it counts, for a coworker, a patient, a stranger, a child.



When a student calls for help, the person who picks up represents everything we're trying to do.



Who We Are



We help people save lives. That's it. 24 hours a day, every day.



Three values run through everything we do, including, how we hire, how we coach, how we lead, and how we show up for students. They're not a tagline. They're non-negotiable.



We Set the Pace. We move fast, get it done, and are proud of it. We take proactive, bold action and let nothing stand in our way. We’re resourceful, methodical and curious. We take others with us. We don’t wait to be told. We just go. Because the work matters.



Make It Simple. Simple isn’t easy - it’s a choice we make on purpose. We take the extra time to remove anything that isn’t essential, and we step back often to make sure we're still focused on what matters most. Because complexity is the enemy of execution.



Care Deeply. About the impact. About doing things right. About each other. We do more - the little bit extra that surprises people and makes them feel special. We never stop at “good enough.” Because caring deeply helps save lives.



A Note from the Head of Delivery



Our students are nurses, parents, coaches, teachers, first responders. A lot of them are anxious. Some are frustrated. A few are calling during genuinely hard moments.



The person who answers sets the tone.



We need someone who can stay calm, listen well, and give clear direction without making the student feel like a burden. Someone who follows the process, communicates with care, and stays with the problem until it's solved.



You don't need CPR training experience — we'll teach you everything you need to know.



But if you've worked in healthcare support, EMS, 911 dispatch, technical support, or any environment where urgency and empathy had to coexist, you'll get up to speed fast.



Here's what we're looking for:



 You own the call. No deflecting, no passing the buck.

 You communicate clearly, even when the student is flustered.

 You follow the process and sweat the details.

 You can be kind and firm at the same time.

 You care about why this work matters, not just what the task is.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.



What You'll Do



You are the student's point of contact when something goes wrong, something is confusing, or they just need someone to walk them through it. Your job is to resolve it on that call, whenever possible.



Answer with urgency. You move first. You don't let confusion sit and turn into frustration.



Treat every call like it matters. Because to that student, it does. They may need this certification for a job, a license, a deadline.



Document everything. Accurate notes, correct dispositions, updated systems. The next person who touches that account needs to know what happened.



Bring problems forward. If you're hearing a question without a dedicated response in our system, that's a signal. You flag it so training can fix it.



What Success Looks Like



 Students leave the call knowing exactly what to do next

 Issues get resolved with you, not transferred to someone else

 Every interaction is documented accurately

 Recurring gaps in the process get surfaced and fixed

 Students get the same quality of support whether they call at 2pm or 2am



How You'll Work



This is a 24/7 operation. Shifts may include evenings, weekends, holidays, or overnight hours depending on business needs. Reliability isn't optional. Students are counting on us to pick up.



You'll work closely with the rest of the Delivery Team:



Training & QA — When you spot a recurring question or a confusing instruction, you bring it to them. They build the fixes; you give them the raw material.



Facilities — When a location issue affects a student's experience, you document it and escalate it properly.



Dispatch Team — You communicate clearly with your teammates, share context, and help maintain coverage. No student falls through the cracks because a hand off was sloppy.



What You Bring



 Strong spoken and written English

 Experience in emergency response work — Emergency response, technical support, dispatch, or similar

 A track record of helping frustrated or anxious people without getting rattled

 Attention to detail and accurate documentation habits

 Comfortable picking up new platforms and tools quickly

 The ability to follow a process closely, and to ask when something isn't clear

 An ownership mindset — you don't wait to be told to care



Helpful Background



Any of these will help you ramp faster, but none are required:



Healthcare or medical scheduling support · EMS or 911 dispatch · CPR, BLS, ACLS, or First Aid experience



What Won't Work Here



 Guessing instead of asking

 Transferring problems you could have solved

 Getting defensive with frustrated students

 Skipping documentation because it feels like extra work

 Treating this like ordinary customer service



It isn't ordinary. The standard stays the same whether it's busy, slow, or 3am.



How to Apply



Record a Loom video — 3 minutes max — answering two questions:



 Tell us about a time you helped a frustrated or confused customer. What happened, and what did you do?

 Why this role with SureFire CPR?



We're not looking for a polished pitch. We want to hear how you communicate and how you think.



Upload your resume, your Loom link, and your written responses to questions at the link below. We only take applicants who apply through this form:







In the "Anything else?" field, begin your first sentence with one of our values.



Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be reviewed.



Benefits:



 Paid training

 Work from home



Work Location: Remote

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Direct Response & AI Creative)

Company: Organics Nature

Position: Full-Time Graphic Designer

Location: Remote

Industry: DTC eCommerce / Health & Wellness



We're Building the Next Generation of Performance Creatives.



Organics Nature is a direct-to-consumer health and wellness brand focused on natural wellness products.



We're expanding our in-house creative team and looking for a talented Graphic Designer who wants to take their skills to the next level.



But we're not looking for someone who simply knows how to make graphics look good.



We're looking for designers who want to become exceptional at their craft, understand what makes advertisements perform, and eventually develop into Creative Strategists.



Your job isn't just to design graphics.



Your job is to create winning ads. Period.



Winning advertisements allow us to reach more customers, increase advertising spend profitably, and scale the business.



That's how your work directly contributes to the company's growth.



Why This Opportunity Is Different



Most graphic designers receive a brief, create a design, submit their work, and move on.



They rarely get to understand why their advertisements succeed or fail.



We're building something different.



At Organics Nature, you'll work alongside an experienced performance marketing team, gain exposure to real advertising results, and learn what makes direct-response creative successful.



We'll teach you our creative development system, helping you understand what makes advertisements convert and how to continuously improve your creative.



You'll receive access to modern AI design tools, ongoing feedback, and opportunities to develop skills beyond traditional graphic design.



Our goal is to help talented designers grow into well-rounded performance creatives who understand both execution and strategy.



Our Competitive Advantage



We believe the strongest creative teams understand their products and customers better than the competition.



At Organics Nature, every team member is expected to develop a deep understanding of our products, their ingredients, the science behind them, and the customers we serve.



We invest in product knowledge, continuous education, and creative development to build a team that knows its niche inside and out.



We want designers who are excited to learn, improve, and contribute to that standard.



What You'll Be Responsible For



Your primary responsibility is designing high-performing direct-response static advertisements for
 and Instagram.



- Design compelling static image advertisements optimized for Meta.

- Transform creative briefs, advertising angles, and copy into polished visual advertisements.

- Create multiple design variations for creative testing.

- Develop scroll-stopping visual hooks, comparison graphics, advertorial-style creatives, and product-focused advertisements.

- Use AI image generation tools to create realistic product scenes, lifestyle imagery, and supporting visuals.

- Combine AI-generated imagery, product photography, typography, and graphic elements into cohesive advertisements.

- Study winning advertisements and apply proven design concepts to new creative.

- Collaborate with creative strategists and video editors to maintain consistency across campaigns.

- Deliver consistent, high-quality creative while meeting production deadlines.

- Apply feedback and performance learnings to improve future advertisements.



Every design should serve a purpose: capture attention, demonstrate value, build trust, or drive a purchase.



What We're Looking For



- 2+ years of professional graphic design experience.

- Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or equivalent professional design software.

- Experience using AI image generation and editing tools to create advertising visuals.

- Proven experience designing static direct-response advertisements for DTC eCommerce brands.

- Strong understanding of typography, composition, color theory, visual hierarchy, and conversion-focused design.

- Ability to create compelling product imagery, comparison graphics, infographics, and promotional advertisements.

- Experience designing for
 and Instagram advertising placements, including 1:1, 4:5, and 9:16 formats.

- Ability to independently source, generate, and manipulate imagery based on creative briefs.

- Strong understanding of visual hooks and what makes an advertisement stand out in a social media feed.

- Ability to produce multiple variations of a concept efficiently without sacrificing quality.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow creative briefs accurately.

- Full-time availability and the ability to consistently meet deadlines.



What You'll Get



- Work directly with a growing DTC health and wellness brand and an experienced performance marketing team.

- Access to modern AI creative tools and professional design software.

- Training in our creative development system to help you understand what makes advertisements successful.

- Exposure to real advertising performance data and feedback on the creative you produce.

- Opportunities to expand your skill set in creative strategy, customer psychology, and direct-response marketing.

- Career growth opportunities toward Senior Graphic Designer, Art Director, or Creative Strategist.

- Full-time, long-term remote employment with a team focused on growth and continuous improvement.



Our Hiring Process



Step 1: Application Review



Submit your resume, portfolio, and examples of direct-response static advertisements you've designed.



Step 2: Graphic Design Trial Task



You'll be asked to create three complete static advertisement concepts with nine unique visual variations.



We'll evaluate your design quality, visual hierarchy, creativity, attention to detail, and ability to execute a direct-response brief.



To ensure we can rate your graphic design capabilities, please utilize any of our products for these advertisements. Utilize a 9:16 format, as well as a 4:5 format.



Step 3: Final Interview



We'll review your trial task, discuss your design process, technical capabilities, availability, and long-term fit.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume and graphic design portfolio.

2. Your three best direct-response static advertisements.

3. Examples of AI-generated imagery or AI-powered advertisements you've designed.

4. The design and AI tools you currently use.

5. Your expected monthly salary in USD.

6. Your timezone and confirmation of full-time availability.



Important: Applicants without relevant direct-response graphic design experience or hands-on AI image generation experience will not be considered.



We're not looking for designers who just make advertisements look good. We're looking for designers who want to learn how to make advertisements perform.



If you're serious about developing your skills, mastering AI-powered design, and growing into a Creative Strategist, we want to hear from you.



Apply and show us what you can create.

title: Scriptwriter & Creative Ops Associate - Davao based only
description:
Reports to: Senior Creative Director

Setup: Full-time, on-site at our Davao based Studio

Working Hours: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM Philippine Time



About the Role

We’re looking for a Scriptwriter & Creative Ops Associate to support our YouTube content production and day-to-day creative operations.

This is a hands-on, hybrid creative and operations role. Your primary responsibility will be researching and writing scripts for Shane Hummus’ YouTube content, while also helping ensure everything surrounding content production runs smoothly — including studio setup, recordings, webinars, slides, SMS campaigns, and other marketing operations.

Approximately 60% of the role is focused on scriptwriting, research, and sourcing strong examples, with the remaining time split across studio production, webinar operations, and marketing support.

This role is best suited for someone who is highly resourceful, comfortable using AI tools every day, learns quickly, notices small details, and can solve problems without waiting for step-by-step instructions.

You do not need to already know every system we use. We care more about your judgment, curiosity, ability to learn quickly, and willingness to improve through feedback.



Key Responsibilities

1. Scriptwriting & Research — Core Responsibility

Research and write approximately 6–8 YouTube scripts per week, depending on the video format and production schedule.

Source compelling examples, case studies, references, screenshots, demonstrations, and supporting material for each script.

Evaluate examples based on two key questions:

Is this strong enough to create a “wow” moment for the viewer?

Does it contextually fit the point being made in the video?

Structure scripts to be engaging, clear, easy to follow, and optimized for Shane’s delivery style.

Prepare scripts in Google Docs, formatted so they can be read directly during recording.

Research unfamiliar topics quickly and turn complex information into simple, usable content.

Support tutorial/how-to content by:

Completing or testing the process yourself.

Screen-recording the process when needed.

Turning that demonstration into a clear script Shane can follow while recording.

Use AI tools heavily for research, ideation, proof of concept, and example sourcing while applying independent judgment to verify that outputs actually make sense.

2. Studio & Recording Operations

Prepare the studio before scheduled recordings.

Set up and check cameras, microphones, audio, framing, and other recording equipment.

Identify issues such as audio crackling, hum, dropouts, poor framing, or recording problems before the shoot begins.

Troubleshoot basic production issues in real time.

QA recorded footage before handing it over to the editing team.

Confirm recordings are complete, usable, and ready for post-production.

3. Live Training & Webinar Operations

Help build and manage presentation decks for live trainings and webinars.

Review and QA slides before each session.

Make last-minute slide additions or adjustments based on feedback from Shane or the creative team.

Coordinate with team members handling delegated slide production and own the final quality check.

Moderate the weekly live webinar and VIP session every Wednesday.

Monitor attendance and help ensure the technical side of the event runs smoothly.

4. Marketing Operations

Help manage and troubleshoot SMS campaigns and related systems.

Verify that SMS messages and reminders are actually delivering correctly.

Monitor live webinar attendance and coordinate additional SMS pushes with the marketing team when needed.

Identify technical or delivery issues before they affect a campaign or live session.

Support the marketing team with campaign execution, automations, troubleshooting, and other operational needs.

5. Creative Ideation & Strategy Support

Participate in brainstorm sessions with Shane and the Senior Creative Director.

Research and pitch potential YouTube topics, formats, examples, and angles.

Provide thoughtful opinions and creative feedback rather than simply taking notes.

Help evaluate whether an idea is strong enough to pursue before significant production time is invested.

6. Client Deliverables

Occasionally support done-for-you creative or content deliverables for higher-tier clients.

Client work is not necessarily weekly and may come in short bursts depending on business needs.



Tools & Technology

Must Know or Be Comfortable Learning Immediately

Claude — used extensively for research, proof of concept, scripting support, and example sourcing.

ChatGPT and other AI/LLM tools

Google Docs

Google Drive

AI is deeply integrated into our workflow. We are looking for someone who naturally uses tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to research, test ideas, find answers, and move faster — without blindly trusting AI-generated information.

Tools You May Learn on the Job

ActiveCampaign

Twilio

GoHighLevel

Webinar/live-streaming platforms

Zoom

Google Slides

Canva

Screen-recording tools

Basic audio/video recording equipment

Slack



Nice to Have

Marketing automation experience

YouTube content or scriptwriting experience

Audio/video production experience

Experience working with creators, agencies, or content teams

Tutorial/how-to scriptwriting experience

Familiarity with webinars or online training events

We care more about tool judgment than memorizing specific software. You should be able to learn a new tool quickly, understand why it is being used, and recognize when something isn't working as intended.



Qualifications

Strong writing and research skills.

Comfortable using AI tools as part of your daily workflow.

Strong attention to detail and quality control.

Able to work independently and figure things out without constant supervision.

Strong logical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Comfortable receiving direct feedback and revising work quickly.

Able to manage both creative work and operational responsibilities.

Organized and dependable when handling deadlines, recordings, and live events.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Willingness to work on-site full-time.

Prior professional scriptwriting experience is helpful but not required if you demonstrate strong writing ability, judgment, and trainability.



Who Will Struggle in This Role

This role is likely not a good fit if you:

Need constant instructions before taking action.

Regularly wait for someone to assign your next task.

Say you understand something but don't investigate when you're unsure.

Are uncomfortable submitting drafts or making mistakes.

Expect to know every tool before you are willing to use it.

Struggle with direct feedback or detailed QA.

Only want to write and have no interest in operations or production.

Only want to handle operations and aren't comfortable writing.

Rarely use AI tools or aren't interested in making them part of your daily workflow.



Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

Consistently delivering approximately 6–8 high-quality scripts per week based on production needs.

Scripts requiring progressively fewer major revisions over time.

Strong, relevant examples sourced for each piece of content.

Recording sessions running smoothly with production issues identified before they affect usable footage.

Webinar slides and live sessions being accurate, polished, and ready on time.

SMS and webinar systems operating reliably with issues caught quickly.

Increasing ability to independently solve creative and operational problems.

Proactive contribution to video ideas, research, and team brainstorms.

Reduced need for Shane and senior creative leadership to handle routine production and operational tasks.



The Ideal Candidate

You don't need to be an expert at ten different things.

We would rather hire someone who is genuinely strong in one area — especially writing, research, or creative thinking — and has excellent judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly than someone who is average at everything.

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to become deeply involved in the operations of a high-performing YouTube and education business, develop their creative skills, and work closely with an experienced content team.

If your instinct when you encounter something unfamiliar is:

“I don't know this yet, but I'll figure it out.”

You'll probably fit in well here.

title: Creative Strategist – Supplements & Skincare Brands
description:
⚠️ READ BEFORE APPLYING:

Your portfolio link MUST be the first line of your application message. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed – no exceptions.



You MUST have direct experience working with supplement and/or skincare brands. If your portfolio doesn't show work in these categories, your application will be skipped.



---



About Us



We're a performance-driven brand house that builds, launches, and scales DTC supplement and skincare brands. We move fast, test constantly, and make decisions based on data – not guesses. Our team works across product development, creative strategy, and paid acquisition to take brands from zero to scale.



About the Role



We're looking for a Creative Strategist who lives and breathes direct response creative for supplements and skincare. You'll own the creative development process end to end – from research and concept creation to briefing creators, reviewing video ads, giving production feedback, and iterating until the ad is as strong as it can be. Your work will be measured by performance, not aesthetics.



This role is ideal for someone who gets excited analyzing why a hook worked, can turn a customer review into a winning ad angle, knows how to brief a UGC creator so the output actually converts, and won't sign off on a video until it's genuinely ready to perform.



What You'll Do



- Own the creative strategy for paid social channels, primarily Meta

- Turn customer insights, product benefits, reviews, and beauty/wellness trends into compelling creative angles

- Write persuasive hooks, scripts, headlines, and CTAs designed to stop the scroll and drive action

- Create clear, detailed briefs for video editors, designers, and UGC creators – covering the message, structure, visuals, and intended outcome

- Review video ads and give direct, actionable feedback to editors and creators – push for the highest possible quality before anything goes live

- Analyze performance at the concept, angle, hook, and format level to understand what worked, what didn't, and why

- Plan and run creative testing frameworks – then d
 what to scale, iterate, or kill

- Track competitor activity and emerging trends to find original angles that stand out

- Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, scripting, and iteration without compromising quality

- Work closely with the performance and media buying team to align creative with campaign goals



What We're Looking For



- 2–3 years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or copywriting – specifically for supplement and/or skincare brands (non-negotiable)

- A portfolio showing paid social campaigns with real performance context – not just pretty visuals

- Strong understanding of direct response advertising, conversion psychology, and funnel mechanics

- Comfortable reviewing CPA, ROAS, and other performance metrics alongside creative work

- Ability to turn complex product benefits and customer insights into clear, persuasive creative that captures attention

- Strong copywriting instincts – you can write a hook that stops the scroll

- A sharp eye for video quality – you can spot what's off in an ad and articulate exactly what needs to change

- Experience using AI tools in creative workflows

- Hands-on, well-organized, and comfortable managing multiple concepts and projects without losing attention to detail

- Fluent English with strong written communication

- Performance-first mindset – you care about results, not just good-looking ads



**Compensation**



$1500 – $2,000 USD/month



How to Apply



1. Put your portfolio link as the FIRST line of your application message

2. Your portfolio must include work for supplement and/or skincare brands

3. Include a brief note on which brands you've worked with and what your role was

4. Describe your creative strategy process – how do you go from insight to a live ad? What steps do you follow?



Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

title: Assistant Online Fitness Coach — Trainerize & Client Support
description:
We are hiring a knowledgeable, reliable and personable Assistant Online Fitness Coach to help deliver our growing online fitness membership through Trainerize.



ABOUT THE PROGRAM



The Love Your Body Program helps adults over 30 lose body fat, build strength and create sustainable fitness and nutrition habits.



Members receive structured workouts, exercise demonstrations, nutrition targets, progress tracking and accountability through the Trainerize app.



This is a long-term part-time opportunity with the potential for increased hours and responsibility as our membership grows.



THE ROLE



You will help manage the daily coaching experience inside Trainerize, ensuring every member understands their programme, remains accountable and receives helpful, professional support.



You will initially work under clear systems, templates and coaching guidelines. You will not be expected to create every programme from scratch.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Review new-member onboarding questionnaires

- Match members to the appropriate pre-built training programme

- Set up and schedule programmes correctly inside Trainerize

- Calculate calorie, protein and macro targets using our approved system

- Review completed workouts, nutrition logs, habits and progress

- Conduct structured weekly member check-ins

- Respond to member questions inside Trainerize

- Encourage members who have stopped logging workouts or become inactive

- Make appropriate programme adjustments when required

- Maintain accurate coaching notes for every member

- Flag injuries, medical concerns, disordered-eating concerns and complex cases

- Keep the Trainerize account clean, accurate and organised

- Help us improve our coaching systems as the membership grows



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Genuine fitness coaching or personal-training experience

- Strong understanding of fat loss, strength training, progressive overload, calorie deficits, protein and macronutrients

- A recognised personal-training, nutrition, sports science or related qualification

- Experience coaching adults through fat loss or body-composition goals

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Warm, encouraging and professional communication

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable internet and your own computer

- Comfortable working independently and following SOPs

- Able to identify when a client’s situation should be escalated

- Interested in a long-term role with a growing fitness brand



Trainerize experience is strongly preferred. Experience with Everfit, TrueCoach, MyFitnessPal or a similar online coaching platform will also be considered.



This role is ideal for a qualified coach who wants to work remotely, avoid spending the entire day on a gym floor and develop experience inside a growing online fitness business.



HOURS AND COMPENSATION



- Part-time — initially 10–15 hours per week

- Flexible working schedule

- Some availability during UK daytime hours

- Starting rate: Depending on experience

- Paid trial assignment for shortlisted applicants

- Performance and compensation reviews as the client base grows

- Opportunity to progress into a lead-coach position



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word ORANGE so we know you have read the full description.



Please include:



1. A short summary of your fitness and nutrition coaching experience.

2. Details of any relevant qualifications or certifications.

3. Which coaching platforms you have used, including Trainerize.

4. The highest number of clients you have managed simultaneously.

5. One example of a client you helped with fat loss, strength or consistency.

6. Your preferred hourly rate and weekly availability.

7. A link to a short 60–90 second video introducing yourself.



Please also answer this scenario:



“A member has not completed a workout for ten days. She says work has been stressful, she has lost motivation and feels as though she has failed again. Write the exact message you would send her.”



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: Customer Success Operations Associate
description:
Customer Success Operations Associate · GrowthSync

Remote · Reports to the Customer Success Operations Lead

GrowthSync helps consumer brands respond to customers on social media. You’ll manage the daily review of comments and DMs for assigned brands, make sure each conversation reaches the right team, and help improve the AI agents that draft replies and route messages.

What you’ll do

Review and route conversations. Check new comments and DMs for missed or incorrect routing. Use the original post and conversation history to determine whether the message belongs with Sales, Community, Partnerships, or the brand’s support team. Leave conversations already being handled with their current owner.

Draft and send replies. Review AI drafts for accuracy, tone, and relevance. Answer the customer’s question first, then d
 whether a public reply, a DM, or an internal handoff makes sense. Send replies within the permissions and guidelines for each brand.

Verify answers before sending. Check approved sources for prices, product details, compatibility, availability, and offers. Ask a focused follow-up when a key detail is missing. Escalate cases that need the brand’s input and include exactly what needs to be confirmed.

Improve the agents. Give specific feedback on weak drafts, add approved answers and examples to the knowledge base, and document recurring issues such as missed routing or inaccurate replies. Help test proposed changes before they go live.

Own your queue and handoffs. Keep track of what’s open, who owns it, and what should happen next. Leave concise shift notes and use approved tools to keep customer information within the right brand workspace.

What we’re looking for

Strong written English, good judgment, and attention to detail. You can write in different brand voices, find and verify the right information, and recognize when a conversation needs someone else’s help. Experience in customer support, e-commerce, social media moderation, or AI tools is a plus.

You’ll start with supervised training on a small set of brands. As you learn their products and policies, you’ll take ownership of routine queue reviews, replies, and handoffs. Success means customers get accurate answers, issues reach the right team, and fewer of the same mistakes need to be fixed by hand.

title: Online Arbitrage Sourcing VA (Keepa Product Finder and Manual Sourcing) for Amazon FBA
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



I run an established Amazon FBA business in the United States, two years in, selling online arbitrage and wholesale products. My head virtual assistant can no longer work, so I'm hiring someone to take over her sourcing role. This is a long term position for the right person.



You will work directly for me, one person, not an agency and not a team of managers. You report to me, you get feedback from me, and you grow with the business.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Source products manually from United States retail websites

• Check every lead in Keepa and SellerAmp before you submit it

• Submit leads in a Google Sheet in the format I give you

• Follow my sourcing rules on every lead:

   ○ At least two dollars profit per unit

   ○ At least thirty percent ROI

   ○ At least one hundred monthly sales

   ○ At least fourteen percent margin in SellerAmp

   ○ United States suppliers only, never overseas

• Send an end of day report every shift



BONUSES



Every lead you submit gets graded from one to five. You earn:

• Five dollars for every grade four lead I buy

• Ten dollars for every grade five lead I buy

• Five dollars every time one of your products gets reordered



Strong sourcers will earn well above the base rate, and raises go to people who find consistent winners.



MONITORING (PLEASE READ)



This is a monitored position. You will use time tracking software that records your hours, activity, and screenshots while you are clocked in. I review your time, activity, and lead quality regularly. If you aren't comfortable being monitored, please don't apply.



REQUIREMENTS



• Experience with Amazon FBA online arbitrage sourcing

• Hands on experience with Keepa (Product Finder especially) and SellerAmp

• Understands ROI, profit, BSR, sales rank history, and Amazon fees

• Detail oriented, honest, and able to work on your own once trained

• Stable internet, a reliable computer, and good written English

• Available to work consistently and communicate daily



PAY



Three dollars per hour to start, plus the performance bonuses above.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words "Keepa Sourcer" so I know you read the whole post. Then include:

1. How long you have done online arbitrage sourcing and for whom

2. Which tools you have used (Keepa, SellerAmp, others)

3. One product lead you found recently, with the ASIN, the source link, the buy cost, and the profit and ROI



I won't review any application that doesn't start with "Keepa Sourcer."

title: Sales Lead
description:
About the role:

Can you close deals yourself and make the people around you better at it? Nuvato AI helps businesses grow with websites, AI agents, automation, SOPs and custom enterprise platforms. We need a Sales Lead who sells first. You will bring in and close your own clients, carry your own revenue target, and lead from the front. Alongside your own book of business, you will strengthen our sales team by coaching, sharing what works on your calls, and setting the standard for how we sell. You don't need to be an AI engineer. You need a strong B2B closing record, your own way of finding clients, and the ability to lift a team.



Why you'll want this role:

- Earn on every deal: uncapped commission on the clients you close yourself, commission on sales from the agents you handle, and a quarterly performance bonus, with on-target earnings of up to USD 5,000 per month.

- Own your pipeline and sell five services, from websites to AI agents, to businesses that need them.

- 10 days of paid time off from year one, rising to 15 days.

- Fully remote, with a team that celebrates wins every Friday.

- A clear path to Head of Sales as we launch more sister companies.



What success looks like in 12 months:

- You hit your personal revenue target every quarter, with deals you sourced and closed yourself.

- You have built your own pipeline of B2B clients through your network, referrals and outbound prospecting.

- Your team hits its closed-deal targets, and every deal is signed, paid and handed over.

- The team sells from a playbook built on what works on your own calls.

- New sales executives ramp faster because they shadow your calls and get regular coaching.



What you will do:

- Sell: Carry a personal revenue target and close your own deals, from discovery call to signed contract and payment.

- Prospect: Bring in your own clients through your network, referrals, cold calls,
 and LinkedIn.

- Run your pipeline: Lead discovery calls, demos and proposals, and keep every deal current in the CRM.

- Lead the team: Set weekly targets, run short huddles and keep the sales executives focused on closing.

- Coach: Have new hires shadow your calls, run role plays, review recorded calls and give clear feedback.

- Help close: Join the team's key demos and negotiations to get deals over the line.

- Protect pricing: Quote from the CRM price list and get approval for any discount below floor.

- Report: Share a weekly scorecard of your own and the team's activity, pipeline and closed deals.



How you will be measured:

Your personal closed revenue, new clients you sourced, your pipeline value and win rate, the team's closed deals, pricing compliance, and team feedback on your coaching. You and your manager set the targets together in your first month.



What you need:

- At least 5 years in B2B sales, with a proven record of closing deals and hitting personal revenue targets. Bring numbers.

- Experience finding and winning your own clients through your network, referrals or outbound prospecting.

- At least 2 years leading, mentoring or coaching other salespeople.

- Hands-on CRM experience and comfort managing a full pipeline from first call to close.

- Excellent spoken and written English, and available 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Chicago time.



Nice to have:

Experience selling websites, SaaS, AI or automation services, an existing network of US or GCC business owners, or experience with structured discovery frameworks such as GROW.



What we offer:

- USD 1,000 per month base fee as an independent contractor.

- Uncapped commission on every deal you close yourself.

- Uncapped commission on each sale closed by the sales agents you handle.

- Quarterly performance bonus.

- On-target earnings of up to USD 5,000 per month, combining base fee, commission and bonus.

- Paid time off: 10 days in your first year, 12 days in years 1 to 3, and 15 days after 3 years.

- Paid in USD every two weeks through Wise.

Fill out this form

title: FULL TIME Outbound Appointment Setter – Warm Leads | Remote

Remote Outbound Appointment Setter

Castelo Portrait Art | Full-Time | Remote

$10/hour + performance bonuses | 40 hours per week paid via Wise

(We already have employees from the Philippines and we love them)



Castelo Portrait Art is looking for a confident, energetic appointment setter to join our booking team.



You’ll contact warm leads who have already responded to our advertising and expressed interest in one of our portrait projects. No cold calling.



Your role is to build a connection, discover what makes a portrait experience meaningful to each person, create excitement, answer questions, and confidently guide qualified clients toward booking.

How Success Is Measured

- Call activity and contact rate.

title: Real Estate Growth & Leasing Manager
description:
Full-Time | Remote – Philippines | ₱60,000–₱70,000 PHP Monthly + Performance Commissions

40 hours/ week, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time



About Rentercasa

Rentercasa is a growing U.S.-based property management company specializing in co-living, room rentals, single-family homes, and multifamily properties.

We are looking for an exceptional Real Estate Growth & Leasing Manager who knows how to attract qualified renters, generate leads, manage advertising campaigns, and close sales.

This is NOT a traditional virtual assistant, administrative position, or leasing coordinator role.

We need an experienced sales and marketing professional who can take ownership of our renter acquisition strategy and consistently turn vacant rooms into paying residents.



Your Mission

Your primary responsibility is simple:

Generate qualified leads, convert prospects into residents, reduce vacancies, and maximize rental revenue.

You will develop and execute strategies that generate renter leads independently of third-party platforms such as PadSplit.

We are looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, sells like a top-performing salesperson, and understands digital marketing.



Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Generation & Business Development

Develop and execute creative strategies to generate qualified renter leads.

Build lead pipelines outside of PadSplit and other existing referral channels.

Generate leads through
 Marketplace,
 Groups, Craigslist, Roomies, Roomster, Furnished Finder, and other relevant platforms.

Identify new rental advertising channels and partnership opportunities.

Develop relationships with employers, staffing agencies, relocation companies, and organizations that serve individuals needing flexible housing.

Implement outbound prospecting campaigns through phone,
, social media, and approved messaging channels.

Continuously test new strategies to increase qualified leads while lowering acquisition costs.

2. Paid Advertising & Digital Marketing

Create, manage, and optimize
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

Develop Google Ads campaigns targeting renters actively searching for housing.

Write compelling rental advertisements that generate inquiries and conversions.

Manage advertising budgets and optimize campaigns for cost per qualified lead and cost per move-in.

Conduct A/B testing of advertisements, audiences, messaging, and landing pages.

Monitor performance and recommend budget allocation based on results.

Ensure housing advertisements comply with applicable Fair Housing laws and advertising platform policies.

3. Leasing Sales & Conversion

Respond quickly to incoming rental inquiries.

Conduct persuasive sales conversations by phone, text,
, and CRM.

Understand prospects’ housing needs and recommend appropriate properties.

Confidently handle objections involving price, location, availability, and move-in requirements.

Follow up consistently with prospects who have not made a decision.

Convert qualified prospects into completed applications, approved bookings, and successful move-ins.

Identify opportunities to promote premium rooms and longer-term occupancy.

4. CRM & Sales Pipeline Management

Manage prospects and sales activities using Follow Up Boss and other company systems.

Build and optimize automated follow-up sequences.

Maintain accurate lead records, pipeline stages, and conversion reporting.

Reengage inactive leads and lost opportunities.

Track lead sources to identify which channels produce actual move-ins.

5. Revenue Growth & Performance

Develop weekly strategies to reduce vacancies.

Analyze listing performance, pricing, advertising effectiveness, and conversion rates.

Recommend improvements to increase occupancy and revenue.

Present weekly reports outlining results, challenges, and next steps.

Take full accountability for measurable leasing performance.



What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of proven experience in sales, lead generation, digital marketing, or business development.

Demonstrated ability to generate leads independently rather than relying solely on inbound inquiries.

Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns.

Strong understanding of Google Ads and lead-generation strategies.

Proven ability to close sales and overcome customer objections.

Experience managing a CRM and structured sales pipeline.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret campaign performance.

Highly organized, self-motivated, and results-oriented.

Comfortable working during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in U.S. residential real estate, property management, co-living, or room rentals.

Experience advertising rental properties on
 Marketplace and rental listing platforms.

Familiarity with Follow Up Boss, Rentvine, or similar software.

Experience with marketing automation and lead nurturing.

Experience developing partnerships and outbound prospecting campaigns.

Knowledge of U.S. Fair Housing advertising requirements.



What Success Looks Like

You will be evaluated on actual business results, including:

Qualified leads generated independently of PadSplit.

Number of completed move-ins.

Lead-to-move-in conversion rates.

Reduction in vacancy days.

Advertising cost per qualified lead and cost per move-in.

Growth in occupancy and rental revenue.

Consistency and effectiveness of prospect follow-up.

We care more about results than the number of calls made or advertisements posted.



Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: ₱60,000–₱70,000 PHP per month, based on experience and demonstrated results.

Performance Commissions: Additional earnings for successful move-ins and independently generated leads that convert.

Full-Time Remote Position: Work from home in the Philippines. 

Growth Opportunities: Opportunity to grow into a senior sales, marketing, or revenue leadership position.

Supportive Team: Work directly with the leadership of a growing U.S. property management company.



How to Apply

We are looking for a proven performer, not someone who is simply interested in learning sales or marketing.

To be considered, please submit:

Your resume and a brief introduction video (2–3 minutes).

A description of your most successful lead-generation campaign, including the strategy, budget, leads generated, and measurable results.

An example of a paid Meta or Google advertising campaign you personally managed.

Your experience closing sales, including conversion rates or other measurable achievements.

A brief explanation of how you would generate renter leads for a co-living property in Charlotte, North Carolina, without relying on PadSplit.



Application Subject Line: GROWTH MANAGER – [Your Full Name]

Applicants who demonstrate proven lead generation, paid advertising expertise, and strong sales abilities will receive priority consideration.



Join Rentercasa and help us redefine how people find flexible, affordable housing.

title: AI Software Tester
description:
AI Software Tester — TikTok Shop & E-Commerce Tools



Company: Outlandish

Type: in-person, full-time



About us



Outlandish helps brands grow through TikTok Shop, creators, livestream shopping, and e-commerce. We’re also building AI-powered tools to make these operations easier, faster, and more automated.



We’re looking for someone curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable with technology to try out our new tools, find problems, and help get them working properly.



What you’ll do



Test new tools and features by using them the way our team, brands, and creators would.

Check that things like product listings, affiliate workflows, order management, reports, and automations work as expected.

Spot errors, confusing steps, missing features, or results that don’t make sense for the business.

Reproduce problems and explain clearly what happened and what should have happened.

Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Codex to help investigate problems and make straightforward fixes where possible.

Retest after fixes to make sure the issue is actually resolved.

Work with our developers on problems that need more technical support.

Keep simple records of what’s been tested, what’s still broken, and what’s ready to use.



Who we’re looking for



You’re comfortable learning new software and figuring out why something isn’t working.

You have some hands-on experience with e-commerce, software testing, operations tools, or troubleshooting.

You’ve used AI tools to solve problems, or you’re excited to learn how to use them for debugging.

You pay attention to details and don’t give up when something breaks.

You can explain technical issues in plain English and work independently.



A big plus, but not required:



Familiarity with the TikTok Shop Seller Center backend, including listings, affiliates, orders, promotions, or seller operations.

Experience with Shopify, other marketplaces, or e-commerce integrations.

Experience with simple automation, browser testing, spreadsheets, APIs, or basic coding.



You don’t need to be a senior software engineer or have a computer science degree. We’re much more interested in someone practical, resourceful, and willing to learn.



An example of the work



Imagine we’ve built a tool that helps a brand manage its TikTok Shop creators.



You would try the tool, check that it follows the correct steps, notice where information is missing or actions fail, and use AI to help figure out the cause.



You might fix a small issue yourself or show a developer exactly what’s wrong. Then you’d test it again until the workflow works properly.



How to apply



Please send us:



A short introduction about your experience.

Any experience you have with TikTok Shop, Shopify, or other e-commerce tools.

Which AI tools you’ve used and an example of a problem you’ve solved with them.

Your availability.



We may invite shortlisted applicants to try a short, paid practical testing task.

title: IT Project Coordinator – MSP | Client Communication & Technician Accountability
description:
SkyNet Managed Technology Services is an established, growing US-based Managed IT Services Provider (MSP). We are looking for an experienced, highly organized, and assertive IT Project Coordinator to oversee project progress, hold technicians accountable, communicate with clients, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.



THIS IS NOT A BASIC VIRTUAL ASSISTANT OR DATA ENTRY POSITION.



We need someone who takes ownership, thinks independently, follows through relentlessly, and is comfortable having difficult conversations when necessary.



Our goal is simple: Projects should continue moving forward without company ownership having to constantly check on them.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Project Tracking and Coordination



Maintain an accurate overview of all active IT projects.



Track deadlines, milestones, assigned technicians, outstanding tasks, and next steps.



Ensure every project has a clear owner, next action, and target completion date.



Proactively identify projects that are stalled, behind schedule, or not receiving adequate attention.



Coordinate with technicians to remove routine obstacles and keep projects moving.



Maintain accurate project notes and statuses in our management system.



2. Technician Accountability — VERY IMPORTANT



Our technical staff are skilled professionals, but like any busy technical team, tasks sometimes get delayed, priorities shift, and projects can lose momentum.



Your job is to make sure this doesn't happen unnoticed.



Follow up with technicians on commitments, outstanding assignments, and deadlines.



Ask direct, specific questions when progress is unclear.



Do not accept vague responses such as "I'm working on it" without determining what has actually been accomplished and what happens next.



Identify missed commitments and obtain realistic recovery plans.



Document commitments and verify that they are fulfilled.



Be comfortable professionally challenging technicians, including senior technical staff.



You will have the full backing of company ownership.



When a technician repeatedly fails to provide updates, misses commitments, or cannot explain why a project is stalled, you are expected to proactively arrange a meeting or Slack huddle involving yourself, the technician, and company ownership.



You are not responsible for disciplining technicians. You ARE responsible for making sure problems are identified, investigated, and brought to management's attention when necessary.



You must have the confidence to do this without being asked.



3. Client Communication



Provide regular, proactive project updates to our American business clients.



Explain project progress, delays, upcoming milestones, and scheduling requirements clearly and professionally.



Follow up with clients for approvals, missing information, and scheduling.



Ensure clients are never left wondering what is happening with their projects.



Communicate problems honestly without creating unnecessary concern or making unverified promises.



4. Daily Management Reporting



At the end of each business day, provide a concise report showing:



Projects that made meaningful progress.



Completed tasks and milestones.



Projects that are stalled or falling behind.



Why projects are stalled and what is being done about it.



Overdue technician commitments.



Client communications completed.



Issues requiring ownership's attention.



We do not want long, unnecessary reports. We want accurate, actionable information that management can review in a few minutes.



5. Independent Problem Solving



We are specifically looking for someone who DOES NOT require constant direction.



If a technician doesn't respond, follow up.



If a project hasn't moved, investigate.



If a client needs an update, communicate.



If someone misses a commitment, determine why and establish the next step.



If a problem cannot be resolved through normal coordination, escalate it.



We do not want to spend our days answering questions that a capable coordinator could resolve independently.



You will receive training on our systems and procedures, but we expect you to bring your own organizational skills, judgment, initiative, and professional experience.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Proven experience in project coordination, project management, service delivery, or operations coordination.



EXCEPTIONAL spoken and written English, including clear pronunciation and the ability to communicate naturally and confidently with American business professionals.



Strong experience working directly with US-based clients and employees.



Extremely organized, detail-oriented, and dependable.



Confident, assertive, and comfortable holding coworkers accountable.



Ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and deadlines.



Strong independent problem-solving and decision-making skills.



Experience with project management, ticketing, or business management software.



Ability to work US Eastern Time business hours.



Reliable internet connection and professional working environment.



HIGHLY PREFERRED



Previous experience with a US-based Managed IT Services Provider (MSP).



Familiarity with ConnectWise Manage or similar PSA systems.



Experience coordinating technical employees or IT projects.



Familiarity with Microsoft 365, networking, cloud services, cybersecurity, or IT infrastructure projects.



Experience working with Slack and other remote collaboration tools.



You do not need to be a highly technical engineer, but you must understand enough about IT operations to ask intelligent questions, recognize potential problems, and coordinate technical work effectively.



THE PERSONALITY WE WANT



We are looking for someone who is:



Proactive rather than reactive.



Assertive without being rude.



Persistent without being confrontational.



Confident communicating with American employees and clients.



Comfortable delivering bad news when necessary.



Willing to respectfully challenge others, including management.



Highly self-motivated and capable of working without micromanagement.



Focused on results rather than simply completing administrative tasks.



If you are someone who prefers to wait for instructions, avoids uncomfortable conversations, or hesitates to follow up with coworkers, this position will not be a good fit.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After you have settled into this role:



Every active project has an accurate status, assigned owner, and next action.



Technicians know their commitments are being tracked and followed up on.



Stalled projects are identified quickly rather than discovered weeks later.



Clients receive consistent, professional updates.



Management receives a clear daily overview of project activity.



Problems are investigated before being escalated.



Company ownership spends significantly less time chasing technicians and checking project statuses.



POSITION DETAILS



Full-time, long-term remote position.



Schedule: Monday through Friday, during US Eastern Time business hours.



Compensation: Competitive and based on experience.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a valuable, long-term member of our team, with opportunities for additional responsibility as our company grows.



HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



To be considered, you MUST provide:



A description of your previous project coordination or service delivery experience, particularly with IT companies or US-based businesses.



Details of your experience holding employees accountable for deadlines and commitments.



A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you're a strong candidate. Excellent spoken English is essential for this role.



The project management, ticketing, or PSA software you have used.



Your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos.



REQUIRED SCENARIO QUESTION



You are responsible for coordinating 15 active IT projects.



One technician has not updated two assigned projects in three days. Another technician promised to complete a task yesterday but missed the deadline. Meanwhile, an American client has
ed asking why their project hasn't progressed.



The company owner is busy and has not given you additional instructions.



Explain exactly what you would do, in what order, including:



How you would approach the technicians.



What specific questions you would ask.



How you would communicate with the client.



At what point you would involve company ownership.



How you would handle a technician who repeatedly gives vague answers or fails to follow through.



We value specific, practical answers based on real experience.



Generic applications that do not address the requirements above will not be considered.



If you are confident, exceptionally organized, communicate extremely well, and enjoy taking ownership of getting things done, we would love to hear from you.

title: Property Manager and Operations Administrator
description:
Property Manager & Operations Administrator — Full-Time, Remote



We’re looking for an organised, proactive person to manage day-to-day administration and coordinate operations for a UK property business.



Responsibilities

- Respond to tenant enquiries and manage communications.

- Advertise available properties, follow up leads and arrange viewings.

- Coordinate applications, referencing, agreements, move-ins and move-outs.

- Arrange maintenance, inspections and contractor visits.

- Keep property records and task trackers accurate and up to date.

- Support rent reminders and payment follow-ups.

- Take ownership of tasks, follow through and escalate issues when needed.



Requirements

- Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence on calls.

- Experience in property management or a similar operations/admin role.

- Strong organisation, attention to detail and ability to work independently.

- Comfortable learning software and managing multiple priorities.

- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace.

- Availability to work UK business hours.



UK property experience is an advantage.
